izzyondroid:com.aicodix.shredpix.name: Shredpix - Encode COFDMTV
izzyondroid:com.aicodix.shredpix.summary: A coded OFDM update to SSTV to send images digitally over SSB, AM and FM radio
izzyondroid:com.aicodix.shredpix.description:
*Shredpix* converts images to COFDMTV encoded audio signals and is based on open-source software.
COFDMTV is based on COFDM (coded orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing) technology:
- 160 ms long OFDM symbols
- 6.25 Hz per sub-carrier
- 1/8 guard interval
- differentially encoded PSK (phase-shift keying) modulation
- systematic polar codes for forward error correction
Following modes are supported:
Using SPC(64800, 43072):
Mode 6: 8PSK, 2700 Hz BW and about 10 seconds long
Mode 7: 8PSK, 2500 Hz BW and about 11 seconds long
Mode 8: QPSK, 2500 Hz BW and about 16 seconds long
Mode 9: QPSK, 2250 Hz BW and about 18 seconds long
Using SPC(64512, 43072):
Mode 10: 8PSK, 3200 Hz BW and about 9 seconds long
Mode 11: 8PSK, 2400 Hz BW and about 11 seconds long
Mode 12: QPSK, 2400 Hz BW and about 16 seconds long
Mode 13: QPSK, 1600 Hz BW and about 24 seconds long
Payload must be smaller or equal to 5380 bytes.
JPEG, PNG and WebP image formats are supported.
Width and height are limited to between 16 and 1024 pixels.

izzyondroid:tech.dongdongbh.mindwtr.name: Mindwtr - GTD Task Manager
izzyondroid:tech.dongdongbh.mindwtr.summary: Clear your head: capture tasks fast, see your next step. Offline, free, GTD.
izzyondroid:tech.dongdongbh.mindwtr.description:
Your head keeps reminding you of things at the worst times. Mindwtr gives them a safe home.
 Mindwtr (pronounced "mind water") is a free, open-source to-do app built on the Getting Things Done (GTD) method. Write down every task and idea the moment it appears, sort it in seconds, and see only what you can do right now. No account, no subscription, and your data stays on your device.
 HOW IT WORKS
 Dump it. A task, an idea, a worry: type it or speak it, and it lands in your Inbox.
 Sort it. A short guided pass: do it now, schedule it, hand it off, or shelve it for someday.
 Do it. The Focus view shows only what you can act on right now, nothing else.
 Reset weekly. A guided review catches loose ends, so the list stays trustworthy and your head stays clear.
 New to GTD? The idea is simple: your head is for having ideas, not for holding them. Mindwtr walks you through every step.
 WHY MINDWTR
 Works completely offline. No account required.
 Your tasks stay on your device. Sync is optional and you choose where: Dropbox, a folder you control, WebDAV, your own server, or iCloud on Apple devices.
 The full GTD method built in: Inbox, Next, Waiting For, Someday/Maybe, Projects, Areas, Contexts, and reviews.
 Capture from anywhere: quick add, widgets, sharing from other apps, or voice.
 Plan your way: list, calendar, and kanban board views.
 Reminders, repeating tasks, checklists, Markdown notes, and attachments.
 Import from Todoist, TickTick, OmniFocus, and more.
 Free and open source. No ads or lock-in.
 SIMPLE BY DEFAULT, POWERFUL WHEN YOU NEED IT
 Fewer fields, fewer knobs, no clutter. Advanced tools, like the kanban board, automation, and an optional AI assistant that uses your own AI account, stay out of sight until you want them.
 Mindwtr means "mind like water": the calm you get when nothing is rattling around in your head.

- Blood pressure and heart rate shown together so you can see the full picture

Your data, your control:

fdroid:app.bematist.public.name: Bematist
fdroid:app.bematist.public.summary: Matches your local music's BPM to your running cadence in real time
fdroid:app.bematist.public.description:
Bematist matches the music it plays to your running cadence. It reads your steps per minute from your phone's motion sensors and picks tracks whose tempo fits the pace you're actually running, switching automatically as your pace changes. Half- and double-tempo tracks count as a match too, so a 172 BPM track suits an 86 SPM pace and vice versa.
When the step counter can't be trusted — on a treadmill, or with the phone in a bag — you can set the BPM range by hand during a run instead.
Training patterns turn a run into an interval workout with a series of timed stages, each with its own pace. Training is off by default; turn it on in Settings.
Every track is analysed for tempo on-device, directly from the audio files in your library, so matching works entirely offline once your library is scanned — no account, no network, no server.
Triage mode lets you rate tracks while you run — skip, keep or like, by an on-screen gesture or an earbud button — and sorts them into playlists afterward. Every run is logged with its cadence and track-matching detail, browsable afterward in session history.
Bematist collects nothing and has no servers. It plays music from files already on your device.
Free and open source, GPLv3 licensed.

 Log flights with date, flight number, airline, departure and arrival airports, aircraft, registration, seat, cabin class, times, distance, and notes

fdroid:io.treehouses.remote.name: treehouses remote
fdroid:io.treehouses.remote.summary: Communicate with headless Raspberry Pi mobile server running treehouses image vi
fdroid:io.treehouses.remote.description:
In order to use treehouses remote, it is required to download a custom Raspbian image that can be found [here](https://treehouses.io/#!pages/download.md) and flash it onto an SD card to be inserted into your Raspberry Pi.
With treehouses remote, you can:
* Get detailed software and hardware information of a Raspberry Pi
* Configure a Raspberry Pi through user-friendly interface
* Easily install and access services such as Nextcloud, Netdata, Transmission, MongoDB, MariaDB and Moodle on your RPi
* And utilize many more features!
Usage:
```
treehouses [command]
treehouses help [command]
```
Example Commands:
help --- gives you a more detailed info about the command or will output this
expandfs --- expands the partition of the RPi image to the maximum of the SD card
rename --- changes hostname
password --- changes the password for 'pi' user
sshkey --- used for adding or removing ssh keys for authentication
version --- returns the version of cli.sh command
image --- returns version of the system image installed
detectrpi --- detects the hardware version of a Raspberry Pi
detect --- detects the hardware version of any device
ethernet --- configures rpi network interface to a static IP address
discover --- performs network scan and discovers all Raspberry Pis on the network
wifi --- connects to a wifi network
wifihidden --- connects to a hidden wifi network
staticwifi --- configures RPi wifi interface to a static ip address
wifistatus --- displays signal strength in dBm and layman nomenclature
bridge --- configures the RPi to bridge the WLAN interface over a hotspot
container docker balena --- enables (and start) the desired container
bluetooth --- switches bluetooth from regular to hotspot mode and shows id or MAC address
ap --- creates a mobile ap, which has two modes: local (no eth0 bridging), internet (eth0 bridging)
apchannel --- sets or prints the current ap channel
timezone --- sets the timezone of the system
locale --- sets the system locale
ssh --- enables or disables the SSH service
vnc --- enables or disables the VNC server service
default --- sets a raspbian back to default configuration
wificountry --- sets the wifi country
upgrade --- upgrades cli.sh package using npm
sshtunnel --- helps adding an sshtunnel
led --- sets the led mode
rtc --- sets up the rtc clock specified
ntp --- sets rpi to host timing locally or to get timing from a remote server
networkmode --- outputs the current network mode
button --- gives the gpio pin 18 an action
feedback --- sends feedback
clone --- clones the current SDCard onto a secondary SD card or specified device
restore --- restores a treehouses image to an SD card or specified device
burn --- download and burns the latest treehouses image to the SD card or specified device
rebootneeded --- shows if reboot is required to apply changes
reboots --- reboots at given frequency | removes it if reboot task active
internet --- checks if the RPi has access to internet
services --- executes the given command on the specified service
tor --- deals with services on tor hidden network
bootoption --- sets the boot mode
openvpn --- helps setting up an openvpn client
coralenv --- plays with the coral environmental board
memory --- displays the total memory of the device, the memory used as well as the available free memory
temperature --- displays Raspberry Pi's CPU temperature
speedtest --- tests internet download and upload speed
camera --- enables camera, disables camera, captures png photo
cron --- adds, deletes a custom cron job or deletes, lists all cron jobs
usb --- turns usb ports on or off

*** Featured by Shane Whatley - "Will let you flash any of your HomeKit lights.. and either set the light back to the original state… or set it to a new state after flash. Really cool stuff!"
*** Featured on 9to5Mac.com - "as a dad of three, I need less noise in our house, so I am really enjoying using Signals for HomeKit"
*** Featured on iMore.com - “create tons of distinct signals that cover scenarios like announcing dinner time, or letting someone know that they are taking a little too much time in the shower.”

*** Featured on HomeKitHero.com - "clever way to get someone’s attention in your home"
Communication at home takes many forms — we want more of the dinner-time conversations, but we could do with less of the loud knocking on doors, banging on ceilings, and shouting up stairs. If you have a HomeKit home, why not take advantage of it, and use your lights to help communicate?
Introducing Signals for HomeKit, the best way to communicate in the home, without all the shouting.
Signals works with any of your bulbs, switches or outlets with lights attached - have a kid who plays video games with headphones on? Just tap on their light to give it a few flashes.
Take it to a new level with the Signals Plus In-App Purchase, and put some meaning behind your flashes:
- Create a Time to Go Signal to flash the kids bedroom lights, and then set their night lights green
- A Dinner Time Signal can pulse lights in the bedrooms and the office, and then set them to blue
- Even setup a “GET DOWN HERE NOW” signal, to flash the kids’ lights red, and keep them that way!
Trigger your Signals in multiple ways — in the app, with your voice or automations using Siri Shortcuts, or with our beautiful Widgets!
Whether you have kids, or someone in the family with a hearing disability, Signals for HomeKit can help quiet things down, and keep the conversations face to face, rather than shouted through the house.
Requirements
- Any HomeKit equipped light bulb, switch or outlet. Switches or outlets must be configured with a light attached. HomeKit must already be configured.
- Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch. iOS 15 required.
Usage Notes: 
- If you have a bulb or switch with a slow ramp/fade rate, try shortening this rate in the manufacturers app, if the flash isn't noticeable - if this doesn't work, please let us know at https://www.homemadeautomation.com/contact-us, so we can help find a solution!

fedora-packages:clips/clips-doc.summary: Documentation and examples for the CLIPS expert system
fedora-packages:clips/clips-doc.description: This package contains documentation for the CLIPS library as well as numerous examples. CLIPS (C Language Integrated Production System) is an expert system development tool which provides a complete environment for the construction of rule and/or object based expert systems. Created in 1985 by NASA at the Johnson Space Center, CLIPS is now widely used throughout the government, industry, and academia. The following are some of the documents in this package: - Proceedings of the Third Conference on CLIPS, 1994 (3CCP.pdf) - Application abstracts (abstract.pdf) - CLIPS Reference Manual, Volume I, Basic Programming Guide (bpg.pdf,bpg.htm) - CLIPS Reference Manual, Volume II, Adv. Programming Guide (apg.pdf, apg.htm) - CLIPS Reference Manual, Volume III, Interfaces Guide (ig.pdf,ig.htm) - CLIPS Architecture Manual (arch5-1.pdf) - CLIPS Users Guide (ug.pdf,ug.htm)

fedora-packages:conda-build/conda-build.description: You can easily build your own packages for conda, and upload them to anaconda.org, a free service for hosting packages for conda, as well as other package managers. To build a package, create a recipe. See http://github.com/conda/conda-recipes for many example recipes, and http://conda.pydata.org/docs/build.html for documentation on how to build recipes. To upload to anaconda.org, create an account. Then, install the anaconda-client and login $ conda install anaconda-client $ anaconda login Then, after you build your recipe $ conda build <recipe-dir> you will be prompted to upload to anaconda.org. To add your anaconda.org channel, or the channel of others to conda so that conda install will find and install their packages, run $ conda config --add channels https://conda.anaconda.org/username (replacing username with the user name of the person whose channel you want to add).

fedora-packages:gdouros-avdira-fonts/gdo.name: gdouros-avdira-fonts
fedora-packages:gdouros-avdira-fonts/gdo.summary: A font based on elements created by Demetrios Damilas (late 15th c.)
fedora-packages:gdouros-avdira-fonts/gdo.description: The first edition of Isocrates, edited by Demetrius Chalcondyles, was published by Uldericus Scinzenzeler & Sebastianus de Ponte Tremolo, in 1493 in Milan. It was set in letters cut in 1481 by Bonus Accursius, copying the older elements of Demetrius Damilas. A digital revival was prepared by Ralph P. Hancock for his Milan (Mediolanum) font in 2000. The font covers the Windows Glyph List, IPA Extensions, Greek Extended, Ancient Greek Numbers, Byzantine and Ancient Greek Musical Notation, various typographic extras and several Open Type features (Case-Sensitive Forms, Small Capitals, Subscript, Superscript, Numerators, Denominators, Fractions, Old Style Figures, Historical Forms, Stylistic Alternates, Ligatures). It was created by George Douros.

fedora-packages:geany-plugins/geany-plug.name: geany-plugins-geanynumberedbookmarks

It started out as part of the ConText feature parity plugin, which was split into individual plugins to better suit Geany's ethos of being as light as possible while allowing users to select which features they want to add to the core editor. The idea was taken from a Text Editor for Windows called ConText. Normally if you had more than one bookmark, you would have to cycle through them until you reached the one you wanted. With this plugin you can go straight to the bookmark that you want with a single key combination.

firefox-addons:3102247.name: Tab Suspender, Memory Saver & Ad Blocker
firefox-addons:3102247.summary: Suspend inactive tabs and free up RAM. Block ads, trackers and popups. Speed up page loading. Lightweight, privacy-first. Zero tracking.
firefox-addons:3102247.description:
Speed up Firefox and save memory. SuperchargePerformance suspends inactive tabs to free up to 95% of their RAM, blocks ads and trackers to cut active tab memory by up to 50%, and optimizes page loading — all built on Firefox's latest APIs.
Firefox's built-in tab unloading only suspends tabs. SuperchargePerformance goes further: it reduces memory on your active tabs too, by blocking the ad scripts, trackers, and third-party code that consume the most resources. A modern, safe alternative to abandoned tab-suspender extensions.
🔒 ABOUT PERMISSIONS
Firefox requires the "Access your data for all websites" permission for tab suspension and network-level blocking. SuperchargePerformance uses these permissions only to optimize performance — we never track, collect, or transmit your browsing data. Zero telemetry. Every optimization runs locally on your device.
HOW IT WORKS
SuperchargePerformance optimizes Firefox at every level — from idle tabs consuming RAM in the background, to the ads and scripts slowing down the page you're reading right now.
Suspend Inactive Tabs
Automatically frees RAM by suspending tabs you're not using. A single tab uses 50–300 MB of memory; a suspended tab drops to under 10 MB. Audio-aware — tabs playing music or video are never touched. Adjustable timing: 15-minute, 5-minute, or custom intervals.
Block Ads, Trackers & Annoyances
Intercepts ads, trackers, analytics, and malicious sites at the network level, before they load. Prevents memory-heavy ad scripts from ever loading. Three levels from common ads to maximum protection including phishing sites. Updated 2026 blocklist with 100,000+ obsolete rules purged for accuracy and speed.
Reject Cookie Banners Automatically
Detects and declines cookie consent popups on 100+ different sites. No more clicking "Reject All" on every site. Removes overlays without breaking page scrolling or layout.
Stop Video Autoplay
Prevents videos from playing automatically in the background, saving CPU and bandwidth. Two modes: Allow Common (permits YouTube and conferencing tools) or Block All (stops everything including muted hover previews).
Control Third-Party Scripts
Manages external scripts that add page weight and slow loading. Three levels from blocking social widgets and comment sections to blocking all third-party scripts with critical exceptions for login and payments.
Preload Pages on Hover
Predicts your next click and starts loading the page before you click it. Uses Firefox's native link prefetching for faster page transitions. Same-site or all-pages modes.
Safe Mode
If an optimization breaks a page, Safe Mode detects the issue and shows a one-click recovery toast. Disables optimizations for that tab so you can keep browsing — no need to disable the extension or dig through settings.
Prioritize Visible Content
Loads on-screen content first and delays off-screen images, iframes, and scripts. Pages become interactive faster because resources you can actually see are loaded first.
Optimize Web Fonts
Blocks heavy custom web fonts and substitutes fast system fonts. Reduces download size and speeds up text rendering. Three levels from removing non-essential font variants to forcing a single optimized system font.
Predictive DNS Prefetching
Resolves domain names before you need them. Pre-connects to your most-visited sites so pages start loading instantly.
WHITELIST & SLEEPING-TAB PROTECTION
Need Figma, ChatGPT, or Google Docs to stay alive in the background? Whitelisted sites bypass all optimizations AND are protected from Firefox's own tab unloading — your important tabs won't lose state or reload when you switch back. One click to whitelist.
WHO IT'S FOR
• Low-RAM laptop and tablet users on 4GB/8GB devices — stop the lag and freezes that come from too many open tabs.
• Laptop users who need longer battery life — less background activity means less heat and more runtime unplugged.
• Anyone with 20+ tabs open — your browser wasn't built for that. This extension is.
PERFORMANCE DASHBOARD
Track your impact: total RAM saved, ads blocked, scripts controlled, time saved, and pages optimized — all calculated locally from your actual browsing activity.
PRIVACY & SECURITY
SuperchargePerformance never tracks, collects, or transmits your browsing data:
• Every optimization runs locally on your device
• No browsing history, search queries, or page content is collected
• No cloud servers, no accounts, no sign-up required
• Built on Firefox's latest security model
Available in 59 languages.
Free to use. PRO available for power users who want maximum control.

firefox-addons:873070.summary:
Vim, but in your browser. Replace Firefox's control mechanism with one modelled on Vim.
This addon is very usable, but is in an early stage of development. We intend to implement the majority of Vimperator's features.
firefox-addons:873070.description:
Control your browser with your keyboard only . 
Replace Firefox's control mechanism with one modelled on VIM. This is a "Firefox Quantum" replacement for VimFX, Vimperator and Pentadactyl. Most common tasks you want your browser to perform are bound to a single key press:
 You want to open a new tab? Hit t .
 You want to follow that link? Hit f and type the displayed label. (Note: hint characters should be typed in lowercase.)
 You want to go to the bottom of the page? Hit G . Or the top? gg .
 You want to focus the text field on Wikipedia to search for another term? gi .
 Switch to the next tab? gt .
 Got trapped in a place where Tridactyl can't run? Ctrl-, 
 Go back in time? H .
 Notice that this tab is rubbish and you want to close it? d .
 Regret that decision? u restores it.
 Want to write something in Vim? Ctrl-i in a text box opens it in Vim, if you have :native working.
 Temporarily disable all that magic because you can't stand it? Shift-Insert or Ctrl-Alt-Escape .
 But how do you use your browser now? Shift-Insert or Ctrl-Alt-Escape again and we're back on.
The list could go on a bit here, but I guess you'll get the point. If you feel lost sometimes :help might help you a lot, and there's always :tutor .
 Highlighted features: 
 Follow any link on the site with just 2-3 key presses.
 Switch to any open tab by searching for its URL or title or entering its ID.
 Easy customizable search settings.
 Bind any supported command or commands to the key (sequence) of your liking.
 Great default bindings (if you're used to Pentadactyl or Vimperator).
This add-on is very usable, but is in an early stage of development. We intend to implement the majority of Vimperator's features.
You can get beta builds from our website .
 Permissions: 
Since Tridactyl aims to provide all the features Vimperator and Pentadactyl had, it requires quite a few permissions. Here we describe the specific permissions and why we need them.
 Access your data for all websites: This is Mozilla's way of saying that Tridactyl can read the content of web pages. This is necessary in order to e.g. find the links you can follow with the :hint command (bound to f by default).
 Exchange messages with programs other than Firefox: This permission is required for Tridactyl to interact with your operating system (opening your editor to edit text areas, sending links to your video player, reading a configuration file from your disk...). This is possible thanks to an external executable we provide. If you feel this gives Tridactyl too much power you can chose not to install the external executable: Tridactyl will still work but won't be able to start external programs.
 Read and modify bookmarks: Tridactyl's command line has a powerful autocompletion mechanism. In order to be able to autocomplete your bookmarks, Tridactyl needs to read them.
 Clear recent browsing history, cookies, and related data: Tridactyl implements the :sanitise command Vimperator and Pentadactyl had. It works a bit like the "Clear All History" dialog you can access by pressing Ctrl+Shift+Del on default Firefox.
 Get data from the clipboard: If your clipboard contains a URL, pressing p will make Tridactyl follow this URL in the current tab.
 Input data to the clipboard: Tridactyl lets you copy various elements to the clipboard such as a page's URL with yy , a link's URL with ;y or the content of an HTML element with ;p .
 Download files and read and modify the browser's download history: By pressing ;s , ;S , ;a and ;A you can save documents and pictures from a page to your download folder.
 Access browsing history: The URLs of websites you've visited previously can be suggested as arguments for :tabopen and similar commands.
 Access recently closed tabs: If you've accidentally closed a tab or window, Tridactyl will let you open it again with the :undo command which is bound to u by default.
 Access browser tabs: Tridactyl provides a quick tab-switching menu/command with the :buffer command (bound to b ). This permission is also required to close, move, and pin tabs, amongst other things.
 Access browser activity during navigation: This is needed for Tridactyl to be able to go back to normal mode every time you open a new page. In the future we may use it for autocommands.
 Read the text of all open tabs: This allows us to use Firefox's built-in find-in-page API, for, for example, allowing you to bind find-next and find-previous to n and N .
 Monitor extension usage and manage themes: Tridactyl needs this to integrate with and avoid conflicts with other extensions. For example, Tridactyl's contextual identity features use this to cooperate with the Multi-Account Containers extension.
 Hide and show browser tabs: Tridactyl needs this for tab group commands, which allow associating names with different groups of tabs and showing the tabs from only of those groups at a time.
 Control browser proxy settings: This allows you to set proxies for accessing different websites with :autocontain.

firefox-addons:2778287.name: Translator PoqDev
firefox-addons:2778287.summary: Translate words and phrases while browsing the web, using Google translator.
firefox-addons:2778287.description:
Translate words and phrases while browsing the web, using Google translator.
The extension will help you translate terms and phrases using Google translator when browsing the internet.
This is a quick and functional plugin for translation. Our plugin's primary aim is to help users browse the internet without language limitations. For this reason, we first adopted the concept of the reading experience of the user.
Our cool features:
* In the extension settings, you can set your language and it will automatically translate anything into that language. The translator can detect the language of the website on which you are located. As well as listening to the correct pronunciation of translated words and phrases on a new tab, users can quickly translate snippets of text.
* Highlight or right-click the text section and then click the Translate icon next to the text section to translate it into your language. The result will be opened in a new tab.
* Google Translate's API to translate terms and phrases, which to some degree guarantees the accuracy of translation outcomes. 
* Friendly side pop-up. To avoid blocking the content from impacting the reading, the pop-up display bar will force the user's reading content.
* Simple and transparent display column for the translation result, highlighting relevant information and ensuring that the attention of the user is centered on the displayed content rather than the trivial items like the display box.
* It's determine for themselves which content they need to view in the translation results. For instance, if you only want to know the word's meaning, you may choose to see only the word's common meaning. We also include the pronunciation, meaning, thorough description, example sentence, if you want to know the basic use of a word as well.
So, when you need a fast translation to another language, where do you go? A buddy or a dictionary of foreign languages? Now, if you need to translate words regularly, you can use a handy browser extension to get the most easy access to Google's online translation services with this extension.
Updates:
* no more problem with hidden style
* moved to manifest 3
* fixed small bugs

firefox-addons:835611.name: Duplicate Tab
firefox-addons:835611.summary:
Duplicates the current tab from keyboard shortcuts or when you click the icon
Source, issues: https://github.com/Skeletonxf/duplicate-tab/
firefox-addons:835611.description:
No more CTRL+L CTRL+C CTRL+T CTRL+V to get your tab open a second time!
Just use ALT+SHIFT+D to duplicate your current tab.
Shortcuts can clash with default Firefox shortcuts unfortunately, in which case Firefox's shortcut will take priority and your custom one will not work. Shortcuts can be customised at the about:addons url.
With Firefox 57 released in 2017 a duplicate tab menu option on the tab menu was added by default. You can still use the button or tab right click menu from this addon to duplicate tabs. Configuring this add on's switch focus will not affect the default Firefox duplicate menu option.
Please note that most functionality is not possible on Android at the moment due to limitations in Android's APIs (no keyboard shortcuts). Duplicate Tab is written so that if the APIs become available in later releases then the features should automatically become usable without an update to Duplicate Tab needed.
Source, issues: https://github.com/Skeletonxf/duplicate-tab

CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN

bluejetty:00078522:ios.description:
Start learning Russian with words and phrases you can listen to, read and practice at your own pace. English meanings and pronunciation guides help you connect Russian script with its sound and meaning.
CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, beginning with the alphabet, greetings and numbers. Build vocabulary for food, family, home, work, travel, transport, nature and more.
Prefer a focused route? Choose from five mini courses: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, and Health & Emergency. These bring related lessons together so you can study a useful topic.
LISTEN AND REVIEW
Listen to bundled recordings with two voice options, Ivan and Anna. Adjust playback speed and repeat words or phrases while you practice. The lesson text and bundled recordings work offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support messages require an internet connection.
PUT YOUR RECALL TO WORK
Review with flashcards, answer multiple-choice and true-or-false questions, match words with their meanings, and type answers in writing exercises. Revisit words that need more practice and check your exercise results.
MAKE STUDYING PERSONAL
Save favorite words and phrases for quick review. Follow your learning progress, record daily check-ins and set study reminders with notification permission. Choose a theme and learning appearance that suits you.
KEEP A COPY OF YOUR PROGRESS
Use manual Backup & Restore to export your favorites, progress, exercise history and included preferences to a file. Import a compatible backup when you need it. Purchases and notification permissions are not transferred in the backup.
HELP IMPROVE THE CONTENT
Use the flag beside a word to prepare a report about its audio, translation or example. You can also open Feedback & Support in Settings or contact support@dugloapps.app.
ACCESS
Some learning content is available without a purchase. Access to all lessons and premium features requires a one-time purchase or subscription. See the in-app purchase screen for available plans and terms.
Privacy Policy: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-russian/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-russian/terms/

bluejetty:00078853:ios.summary:
Tickets and tours: Colosseum, Vatican Museums and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 11 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN ROME
Entry tickets and g
bluejetty:00078853:ios.description:
Tickets and tours: Colosseum, Vatican Museums and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 11 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN ROME
Entry tickets and guided tours: Colosseum, Vatican Museums, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, St. Peter's Basilica in the Vatican, Pantheon and Mausoleum of Hadrian, booked through GetYourGuide from the page of each place.
Airport transfers, hop-on hop-off buses, food tours and cooking classes.
Day trips from Rome: Pompeii and the Amalfi Coast.
ROME AUDIO GUIDE
Tap "Listen" on any place of the guide and the app reads its story aloud, sentence by sentence, while you stand in front of it: Colosseum, Vatican Museums, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Pause, go back a sentence, change the speed. The audio guide speaks the language you read the guide in.
ROME ITINERARY BY THE TIME YOU HAVE
Tell the app how much time you have and where you start, and it plans a walking itinerary through the sights of Rome: the stops in order, the walk between them in minutes, the route on the map. Follow it step by step, stop by stop. Or save the places you like and turn them into your own walk.
MAP OF ROME
All the sights of Rome on one map: the photos of the most famous ones, the others by name as you zoom in. Tap a place for its page, its tickets and the walking directions from where you are.
THINGS TO DO IN ROME
339 places to see, each with its story, photos and the tours that visit it: Colosseum, Vatican Museums, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, St. Peter's Basilica in the Vatican, Trevi Fountain, Piazza Navona, Piazza del Popolo, Capitoline Museums and many more.
TRAVEL TIPS FOR ROME
221 answers to the questions travellers ask before and during a trip to Rome, for example:
• Skip-the-line Sistine Chapel access tips
• Best day trips from Rome to the countryside
• Rome walking itinerary for seniors
MORE IN THE GUIDE
• Day trips near Rome
• Local guides you can contact for a private tour
• Weather for the next 7 days
• Hotels in Rome on Booking.com, for tonight, the weekend or your dates
• My guide: save places with a tap and find them on the map
FREE, OR PREMIUM
The Rome guide, the audio guide, the map, the travel tips and a one-hour itinerary are free, with ads. Premium, a single purchase, removes the ads and adds longer itineraries, your own lists of places ("Day 1", "Day 2"), unlimited walking directions and the offline guide: the whole guide of Rome downloaded to your phone, to read without a connection.

bluejetty:00124146:ios.description:
Gangs, crimes, mafia - it's your life.
History:
You are a low-poly gangster in Grand Poly City. Nobody loves you and does not respect you as a person. From the very childhood, your parents forgot you for the whole day. On a summer vacation instead of a children's camp, you were sent to Colombia in the company of Spanish immigrants, bandits, and thieves. In the school years, stealing auto was just as common as necessary. All sorts of mafia bosses became your lord at that time. You ate poisoned fruit, drank water from puddles, slept in the hay or in the stolen auto. But its only a story. Now you are the boss.
Car theft:
- Well, what game about car theft can be, without riding on a theft tank or stealing citizens auto? 
- Maybe you would like to theft helicopter from a military base? 
- In Grand Poly City you can steal and do whatever you want. It could be every citizen auto, military auto or machine.

A large low polygonal city is full of chests and surprises that you must find, otherwise, you just will not become the Polygon lord of the notorious criminal underworld. Collect loot from opponents, collect coins and power-ups. For found coins, you can always buy the coolest and most dangerous weapons in the weapons shop. 
Powerful weapon:
- Machine gun
- Shotgun
- Pistol 
- Sniper rifle 
- Grenade launcher
- Hand grenade
More powerful weapon and adds:
- flammable missile launcher 
- flamethrower
- gold desert eagle
- jet-pack
So go and rule the city in your way!

bluejetty:00177430:ios.summary: Love the experience of reading a print newspaper all day long and also want the convenience of carrying it in your pocket? We have just the solution for you – The Hindu ePaper app, an exact digital replica of India’s leading national daily.
bluejetty:00177430:ios.description:
Love the experience of reading a print newspaper all day long and also want the convenience of carrying it in your pocket? We have just the solution for you – The Hindu ePaper app, an exact digital replica of India’s leading national daily.
Whether on your phone or tablet, simply download the app and flip through the pages like you would with a print newspaper. In short, enjoy the same familiar joy of reading The Hindu’s reliable news, but in a different avatar, right from the palm of your hand. Read on to discover more about The Hindu ePaper app and the many exciting offerings it brings.
COVERAGE AND CONTENT PAR EXCELLENCE
Catch up on current events with verified and reliable news at your fingertips.
Delivered straight to your devices, The Hindu newspaper is put together by leading Indian and international journalists who report the real story and express their views on the most pressing issues of the day.
Stay ahead of the times on both Indian and international updates across sections and supplements such as Regional, State, South, Editorial, News, Foreign, Business, Sports, Science, FAQ, Profiles, Text & Context, Photo Feature, Weekend, Sunday Magazine, EducationPlus, Opportunities, Classifieds and others.
Read from 17 newspaper editions in one app. From the ad-free international edition to regional editions from across India, including Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Delhi, Erode, Hyderabad, Kochi, Kolkata, Kozhikode, Madurai, Mangalore, Mumbai, Thiruvananthapuram, Tiruchirappalli, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.
Explore editorials written by the most influential voices in India and abroad, shaping the narrative of our times.
Delve into explanatory articles, quizzes, games and others with The Hindu ePaper’s Learning Corner, an exclusive interactive space focussed on current affairs, vocabulary, grammar, comprehension and more.
Bank on the ePaper app for your SSC, UPSC and other competitive exams.
The Hindu newspaper is every aspirant’s one-stop shop for accurate information, reliable reportage, eye-opening editorials and more.
Test your awareness of news and current events with the exclusive ‘Daily Quiz’ section in the ePaper app.
Receive our Editor’s Pick newsletter, which provides a detailed explanation of the day’s front-page story and its significance. You’ll also get handpicked links to recent editorials and daily reminders for our ePaper quiz.
Access 30 days of archives and catch up on news anytime, anywhere.
FEATURES AND EXPERIENCE REDEFINED
Flip through the pages or use the section-wise navigation.
Pick a font you like and choose from three different views: article view, page view and overview.
Switch to the ‘Read aloud’ option and listen to the news being read instead.
Use ‘Search’ to find topics or articles that interest you.
Download or print articles, or the entire publication for offline reading. Locate downloaded articles and publications in the ‘Downloads’ section of the app settings.
Bookmark your favourite articles and access them in the dedicated ‘Favourites’ section.
Crop, save and share articles.
Your daily hunt for trustworthy news ends here!

THG PUBLISHING PRIVATE LIMITED: The Hindu Group has been established from the times of India's colonial period and today it has a slew of print and digital publications. Some of the top publications include:

The Hindu Tamil (Tamil news daily)
The Hindu ePaper & Businessline ePaper
Businessline (Business News daily)
Frontline (Fortnightly national magazine)
Sportstar (Sports magazine)

bluejetty:00078954:ios.description:
برنامج "مقاطع" هو أداة سهلة الاستخدام لإدارة وتشغيل ملفات الفيديو على جهازك، مع واجهة بسيطة تساعدك على الوصول إلى محتواك بسرعة وتنظيمه بكفاءة.
يتيح لك التطبيق استعراض الفيديوهات المخزنة على جهازك وتشغيلها بجودة عالية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الملفات داخل مجلدات، وإدارتها بسهولة من خلال أدوات مدمجة.
تم تصميم "مقاطع" ليكون عمليًا وخفيفًا، مع التركيز على تجربة استخدام سلسة وخصوصية عالية، مما يجعله مناسبًا للاستخدام اليومي.
طريقة الاستخدام:
-استورد الفيديوهات من جهازك 
-تصفّح الملفات داخل التطبيق بسهولة.
-شغّل الفيديوهات أو نظّمها باستخدام أدوات الإدارة.
الميزات الرئيسية:
-تشغيل سلس وبسيط.
-قم بتنزيل عدة ملفات في نفس الوقت
-يمكنك بدء حفظ الملفات عبر الزر المخصص داخل التطبيق.
-احفظ الملفات المنزلة في مجلد محمي بكلمة مرور
-قم بتنزيل الفيديوهات في الخلفية.
-إمكانية ترتيب الملفات حسب الحجم أو الاسم أو النوع أو التاريخ
-مشغل فيديو يدعم صيغ متعددة.
-إدارة الملفات (حذف، إعادة تسمية، مشاركة).
-تنظيم الفيديوهات ضمن مجلدات.
- مشاركة الفيديوهات التي تم تنزيلها.

- 7x5~10x10inch 5가지 사이즈, 수십 가지 디자인

◆ 아크릴 굿즈
- 아크릴키링: 투명 PNG로 원하는 모양 그대로, 다양한 고리 선택
- 아크릴톡, 배지, 디자인키링, 유니폼키링, 자동차 번호판 키링

- 아크릴 집게, 아크릴 안전 거울

- 다양한 용지와 자유로운 사이즈
- 무광·유광·스파클·프리즘 코팅, 라운드 커팅·테두리 모양 선택
- 여러 세트 구매 시 추가 할인

- 키보드 키캡, 젤볼펜, 클립펜, 떡메모지, L홀더·미니L홀더, 노트/플래너, 마스킹테이프

bluejetty:00036941:ios.description:
Dcard is Taiwan's largest community for young adults, with over 10 million members sharing their most authentic life and workplace experiences every day!
You can choose to share your daily life with a sense of privacy, join topic-based boards, connect with like-minded people, and exchange real work experiences — all backed by clear
guidelines, active moderation, and easy-to-use reporting tools. Through themed boards and the Midnight Card Draw, find people who truly share your passions.
Looking to fit into campus life? Want to stay on top of trending topics? Or just need someone to relate to? Download Dcard and join Taiwan's most vibrant youth community!
【 Campus Chat with Classmates 】
Wondering what’s happening on campus? Ask your classmates.
Join your school’s Campus Chat for new student check-in, courses, dorm life, living costs, and campus buzz.
Explore more chatrooms, or tag people from a specific school so the right classmates can see your questions faster.
【 Talk About Work—Without Worry 】
Ever wondered what people in similar roles are really thinking?
Switch to your Professional Identity to connect while staying private and hear real experiences from people in your field.
You can also tag people in a specific profession to get answers on work, careers, salaries, and industry life faster.
【 Thousands of Topics — Real-Life Experiences! 】
* Campus Life
Entrance score analysis, major selection, cost of living, dorm essentials, and must-take courses. Ask upperclassmen on Dcard's Campus Board!
* Smart Money Management
Budgeting tips, ETFs & mutual funds, side income ideas, and bank fee comparisons. Check Dcard's Finance & Stock boards!
* Beauty & Fashion
Product unboxings, makeup tutorials, medical aesthetics reviews, and OOTD outfits for every body type. Browse Dcard's Beauty & Fashion boards!
* Food & Restaurants
Food spot maps across Taiwan, best delivery picks, and hidden menu items at your favorite chains. Explore Dcard's Food Board!
* Must-Watch Shows
Spoiler-free reviews on trending K-dramas, reality shows, and movies. Save time on Dcard's Drama & Netflix boards!
* Dating & Relationships
Dating tips, confession guides, and real couple stories. Get advice on Dcard's Relationship Board!
And more: stocks, budgeting, recipes, job hunting, convenience store finds, and beyond!
【 Midnight Card Draw — Meet Someone Who Gets You 】
Every night at midnight, Dcard recommends one person based on your school and interests. Miss it and they're gone forever. Accept the invite to start a conversation — safe and private. Block or report anyone at any time; our moderation team responds promptly.
【 Capture Daily Moments with Mini Posts 】
Post mini cards on your personal wall using your nickname — freely express yourself. Jot down daily moments or private thoughts in a safe space.
【 Safe Community, Real Connections 】
Dcard is committed to providing a safe environment for all users:
・ Age Requirement: Users must be 18 or older to register.
・ Community Guidelines: Clear rules for a respectful, inclusive space.
・ Content Reporting: Flag posts, comments, or users directly in-app.
・ Block & Mute: Full control over who can interact with you, anytime.
・ Content Moderation: AI-assisted + human review team for swift action.
【 Dcard Premium — Now Live 】
Enjoy an ad-free, distraction-free community and personalize your experience:
・ Ad-Free Experience
・ Custom Virtual Avatar
・ Personal Wall Special Effects
・ Custom App Icon
・ Early Access to New Features
【 Need Help? 】

bluejetty:00043366:ios.description:
Welcome to EasyLetter - the efficient app for the easy creation of letters and documents.
Preparing a short letter or a well-formatted business letter can be a hassle. Especially when things have to be done quickly, you don't want to worry about formatting, but just start writing.
Every day, people use EasyLetter to make their correspondence more effective while also making a professional impression.
AUTOMATIC LAYOUT
• Select one of the layouts provided and your letter will automatically follow the shape.
• DIN 5008 Form A, DIN 5008 Form B and US Letter
• Optional fold marks help when sending printed documents.
• Multi-page documents can be created with a simple click on "Insert Page".
SEND LETTERS
• Select a preferred shipping method and send your letter directly from EasyLetter
• Whether black and white or in color: printing, enveloping, franking and shipping are all from a single source and are handled by our cooperation partner PIN AG
ADD ATTACHMENTS
• Select images and PDF files when exporting or sending
• EasyLetter will merge all files into one compact PDF
• Attachments are sent with the letter
SAVE TIME WITH TEXT TEMPLATES
• Create a text template: With one click, the content of the selected document is used and saved as a template.
• Just as easily apply the saved text template to another document.
• Multiple documents can be managed through the sidebar. Text templates can easily be used by switching between documents.
PERSONALIZATION
• Add a letterhead in the letter settings to give a letter an even more professional look.
• Position an image on the left, in the middle or on the right in the upper area.
• The letterhead automatically adapts to the selected layout.
IMPORT CONTACTS
• Use contact information from the Contacts app with one click.
• Addresses are automatically formatted and inserted into the document.
EXPORT AND ICLOUD SYNCHRONIZATION
• Export the finished document as a PDF.
• Use EasyLetter on multiple devices: your letters are always up to date and can be edited from anywhere.
EASYLETTER PRO
More professionalism with the extended functions of EasyLetter.
ADD SIGNATURE
• Define a signature and use it in all your documents.
SET LETTERPAPER
• A background image for your documents: choose any image that is large enough for the best print quality.
TEXT FORMATTING
• Choose any font to personalize your documents.
• Use different font styles such as bold and italic.
• Underline text passages for more expressiveness.
• Change the font size for the entire document to improve readability.
CREATE SERIAL LETTERS
• Convert your document into a form letter with one click.
• Use the placeholders for first name, last name, street, zip code, city and country in the input fields to enrich them with data.
• When exporting, select the contact addresses for which letters are to be created.
• When exporting, a folder is created in which the serial letters created are stored.
LOCK DOCUMENTS
• Lock and unlock documents in one step to protect them from further editing.

bluejetty:00062850:ios.name: Wonderland : Little Mermaid
bluejetty:00062850:ios.summary: Welcome to wonderland! Come to meet the little mermaid’s family and friends at the underwater village. Visit the mermaids house, check out the nursery for activities and fun, take a dive through the sunken pirate ship to find hidden treasur
bluejetty:00062850:ios.description:
Welcome to wonderland! Come to meet the little mermaid’s family and friends at the underwater village. Visit the mermaids house, check out the nursery for activities and fun, take a dive through the sunken pirate ship to find hidden treasures or just relax by visiting the stores to get new outfits and costumes. Fun and adventure can be found everywhere. Wonderland is a game where children make up the story as they play, Role-play and imagination is all that is needed to create your new adventure!
FEATURES:
- 14 exciting locations and rooms to discover and explore including the mermaids house, mermaid restaurant, mermaid daycare and the pirate's sunken ship. This game is HUGE
- 9 mermaids with customizable tail, hair, and clothing.
- Lots of fun activities such as cooking, dress up and makeup is available.
- This game will connect to any other Wonderland game we shall release… yes, More games coming!
- Multi touch-enabled so you can play with friends or family on the same device.
- A stress-free environment for kids to play at. No winning or losing. Just creative gameplay and hours of it!
WE MAKE GAMES KIDS WANT TO PLAY
If you have ever written to us then you probably know that we are reading all your comments, Fan emails and Facebook message. Let us know what theme you would love to see next and if there are enough requests you will probably have a nice surprise a few months ahead. So don’t be shy, if you have an idea, a bug, a complaint or you just want to say hello, make sure to connect with us. 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
This game is perfect for Kids 4 -12, the game promotes creative thinking, imaginative gameplay and endless role-playing game time. Wonderland games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. We have No Ads, No 3rd Party Ads, and no IAP. 
ABOUT MY TOWN GAMES STUDIO
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open-ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00062412:ios.description:
NEW! Even more cool surprises, fun locations and cute cats! Become friends with a robot kitty! Visit brand new music and car shops. Play basketball and have fun with a bubble machine! Find a piñata and discover more secrets of Little Kitty Town!
Little Kitty Town is a purrfect game for boys and girls who love cute animals, surprises and experiments. Explore this meowtastic city and find adventures on every corner! Create your own stories with the fluffy citizens of Little Kitty Town!
In Little Kitty Town kids can:
· Collect more than 40 unique cats — from cute chubby kittens to panda cats to even unicorn kitties! New cats are always arriving at the airport!
· Find hidden cat creatures: a superhero cat, meowmaid, robot cat, purrgasus and kitty ghosts!
· Create crazy pet hairstyles and fun outfits for cats. Mix and match clothes and accessories as they want!
· Show off your musical talent in a brand new music shop!
· Harvest crops, go fishing and cook food!
· Care for, wash and feed the cats!
· Try out a magic teleport!
· Visit a car shop and drive fun cars and boats — even a police car or a firetruck! Fly a helicopter!
· Dance to pawsome music with the party cats!
· Clean up the cat city and keep it tidy!
· Interact with 40+ characters, 15+ locations and 100+ objects freely!
· Make up their own unique stories as they play!
Play Little Kitty Town — a cute and simple game for kids that sparks curiosity, encourages creative thinking and lets little ones become visual storytellers!

bluejetty:00155566:ios.description:
We empower anyone to discover, organize, and play hockey. Whether you’re a complete beginner or a seasoned vet, HC will elevate your hockey experience.
PLAY HOCKEY
Find nearby hockey games, drop-ins, stick and puck sessions, public skating, and more. Select an event that suits you based on date/time, location, skill, and cost.
ORGANIZE EVENTS
Quickly and easily organize hockey games. Have an ice time you need to fill? Set up your game within seconds and let us track the players and payments for you.
REQUEST A GOALIE
HC will notify hundreds of goalie around you to help you find a goalie.
JOIN THE PLATFORM FOR HOCKEY PLAYERS
Connect with other hockey players and enthusiasts nearby. Ask the community for advice, recommendations, or just share moments from your hockey life.
For players:
• Join local hockey games, pay online, then just show up to play
• Invite your friends to play hockey
• Request a goalie
• Find a team that’s a match through position/skill level on Team Finder
For managers:
• Set up your hockey game in seconds
• Create a group to easily invite your regulars and past players with one button
• Collect online payments and track which players have paid
• Set and post balanced teams based on player skill level with one button
• Create a recurring event to save time

bluejetty:00185075:ios.description:
The Focal & Naim app gives you total control of your entire Focal & Naim ecosystem. It brings streaming, radio, and your personal music library together in one beautifully simple interface.
Your Focal & Naim Account
Create your free account to register your products, access local Internet Radio, and receive exclusive benefits such as extended warranties and enhanced customer support.

Ready your new Naim & Focal devices with our intuitive product setup process.
Total Control
Manage every aspect of your system — speakers, streamers, and settings — all from your phone or tablet.
Whole-Home Sound
Stream music perfectly in sync across rooms or set a unique mood in each of your spaces with Naim Multiroom technology.
Stream Without Limits
Access high-resolution playback up to 24-bit/96 kHz from your favourite streaming services. Enjoy thousands of internet radio stations, including Naim Radio, now also available locally on your mobile device.

Stay Connected Anywhere

Compatible with all current Focal & Naim network-connected music players (some legacy products not supported).

bluejetty:00131541:ios.description:
No editing skills needed — just tap and go viral.
[ AI Tools for Your Next Video ]
Turn your clips and photos into awesome videos faster with KineMaster’s built-in AI tools! Create captions, generate voices, remove backgrounds, add incredible visual effects, and more!
• AI Auto Captions: Add subtitles instantly from video or audio
• AI Text-to-Speech: Create spoken audio from text with one tap
• AI Voice: Make your audio unique with AI Voices
• AI Music Match: Get song recommendations fast
• AI Magic Removal: Cut out the background around people and faces
• AI Noise Removal: Zap distracting sounds in your video or audio
• AI Vocal Separator: Split a song into vocals and music
• AI Tracking: Make your text and stickers follow moving objects
• AI Upscaling: Boost the resolution of low-resolution media
• AI Style: Add artistic effects to your videos and images
• AI Templates: Get a template recommended for your next awesome video!
[ Professional Video Editing for Everyone ]
KineMaster makes advanced tools easy to use.
• Keyframe Animation: Adjust the size, position, and rotation of every layer
• Chroma Key (Green Screen): Remove backgrounds and combine videos like the pros
• Speed Control: Reverse, slow down, or turn your videos into time-lapse masterpieces
[ Jumpstart Your Creativity ]
Pick a template, replace its photos and videos, and you’re done!
• Thousands of Templates: Build your own from pre-made video projects
• Mix: Save your video project as a template to share with KineMaster editors everywhere
• KineCloud: Back up personal projects to the cloud to continue editing on another day or another device
[ Make Your Video Stand Out with Assets ]
The KineMaster Asset Store has tens of thousands of resources to make your next video amazing! Effects, stickers, music, fonts, transitions, and VFX: everything is ready to use.
• Effects & Transitions: Enhance your videos with amazing visuals
• Stickers & Clip Graphics: Add graphic animations and design elements
• Music & SFX: Make a video that sounds as good as it looks
• Stock Videos & Images: Get pre-made green screen effects, free stock footage, and tons of video backgrounds
• Variety of Fonts: Apply design-ready stylish fonts
• Color Filters: Choose from a huge variety of color filters for the perfect look
[ High-Quality Output or Optimized Video: You Decide ]
Save your edited videos in high resolution or dial the quality to make them load fast on social media.
Incredible 4K 60 FPS: Produce videos in 4K and 60 frames per second
Optimized for Social Media Sharing: Save videos that are ready to upload to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and more
Transparent Background Support: Make videos ready for compositing for use with other videos
[ The Best Tools for Fast, Precise Editing ]
KineMaster is loaded with tools that make editing fun and easy.
• Offers both portrait and landscape editing, the best of both worlds
• Lots of layers: Add and stack photos, videos, and GIFs to all play at once
• Tablet/Chromebook Support: Provides an editing environment optimized for wide screens
• Multiple Undo (and Redo): Revert or reapply your editing history
• Magnetic Guides: Align elements to guides and snap layers in place on the timeline
• Full-Screen Previews: See your edits full screen before saving
• Multi-Selection: Save time by selecting and aligning, duplicating, or repositioning more than one video project layer at a time

What Workit Health offers:
Progra
bluejetty:00089030:ios.description:
Quit drinking or recover from opioid use from the privacy of home. Workit Health offers flexible programs that include medication support to help you take your life back from alcohol, opioids, and kratom.
What Workit Health offers:
Programs for opioids, kratom, or alcohol are designed by people in recovery and backed by scientific research.
- Online video appointments with licensed medical providers
- Modern medications like Suboxone or naltrexone, prescribed as appropriate
- Judgment-free care that fits your goals
- Discreet treatment that you access through your phone
- Track your progress with integrated health metrics
- Regular check-ins and guidance to help you stay on track
- Peer recovery groups and a supportive online community
- Help for co-occurring conditions like anxiety, insomnia, or depression
- Convenient at-home drug screening for opioid and kratom treatment
Download the app, select your program, and schedule your first appointment.
Whether your goal is to cut back or quit completely, Workit Health offers confidential, personalized care that fits your life.
Workit Health is a good fit for:
- Anyone seeking comprehensive recovery care with zero judgment
- People who want medication, plus the support of groups, regular outreach, and community
- Busy professionals, parents, or caregivers who need flexible, online care
- People with co-occurring issues like anxiety, insomnia, or depression
- Those looking for insurance-covered, affordable treatment
How does it work?
1. Sign up and schedule an appointment
Download the app, share your recovery goals, and choose a time to meet with a provider. It only takes a few minutes.
2. Meet your provider
Connect via video with a licensed clinician who listens without judgment. If appropriate, they’ll prescribe medication to your local pharmacy.
3. Get ongoing support
Join follow-up appointments with your provider and care team. Build recovery skills and get support from others on a similar path.
Is insurance accepted?
Yes, Workit Health accepts many commercial plans, plus Medicaid and Medicare in select states. Self-pay is available as well.
Where is Workit Health available?
Our 100% online, app-based treatment is available in select states.
Who are the Workit Health providers?
Workit Health’s providers are licensed clinicians devoted to harm reduction, so they really listen and support all recovery goals. They are able to prescribe medications to treat opioid and alcohol use, as appropriate. Because there are many conditions that frequently go hand-in-hand with addiction, our clinicians also treat co-occurring anxiety, depression, hepatitis C, HIV prevention, and more.
Is it legal and legit to receive addiction treatment online?
Yes. Workit Health is LegitScript-certified and our clinicians are licensed in the states they serve.

- Suboxone treatment near me
- Naltrexone for alcohol cravings
- How to stop drinking at home
- At-home alcohol taper
- Online opioid treatment
- Quit drinking without rehab
- Get sober at home
- Alcohol and anxiety treatment
- Addiction recovery app
- Sobriety support
- Quit kratom or 7-OH

bluejetty:00078199:ios.description:
Business Empire: RichMan is more than just a passive business game simulation where players make investments and watch their earnings grow. It's an interactive online or offline business game simulator that allows players to make strategic business decisions and take calculated risks to build their business empire.
Install Business Empire: RichMan and discover a variety of options to build your empire and reach new heights of success. You can choose to open businesses in six different categories, including retail stores, restaurants, and banks. With the ability to hire employees and make strategic decisions, you can grow your businesses and increase profits.
For those of you who prefer to invest in the stock market, Business Empire: RichMan allows players to buy virtual shares in famous companies and monitor their investments to maximize their virtual earnings. Alternatively, players can invest in real estate in the most elite areas of the world, generating passive income and increasing their net worth. Other than buy and sell stocks, players are welcome to also invest in cryptocurrencies.
Luxury items are also available for purchase in the game, including high-end vehicles and private jets. With the ability to expand your own fleet and hangar, you can travel in style and enhance your status and prestige.
Overall, Business Empire: RichMan is a highly interactive game that provides players with a realistic and engaging business management experience. 
Whether you want to open your own business - a store or a bank, become an investor, or purchase luxury items, Business Empire: RichMan has something for everyone. The simulation game's immersive and interactive gameplay provides endless possibilities for players like you to build your empire and become a true RichMan.

Our patent-pending, state-of-the-art passport suit changer enables the user to change their passport suit in a few clicks and find the perfect combination that suits their individual style. - A range of passport suit styles

- Multiple passport photo background templates

- Standard print paper sizes
With Vivid Passport Photo Maker, you can now print your passport photos in different standard paper sizes. Combine standard passport, ID, or VISA photos into a single sheet of standard print paper sizes：3’’x4’’, 4’’x4’’, 4’’x6’’, 5’’x6’’, or A4.
- Automatic adjustment without manual operation
To produce passport photos, a photo can be taken from the camera or loaded from the album. The portrait will be automatically resized, cropped, and converted to the perfect size with face-centered. No need to manually resize like traditional online digital passport/visa photo editors.

Here’s what else you can do with Genesee Valley FCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Genesee Valley FCU app, you must be enrolled as a Genesee Valley FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00019457:ios.description:
"Stranded Without A Phone" is a desert island survival game, on a distant planet similar to Earth.
WARNING! This is a challenging game that requires thinking. It is not an action/arcade game.
You must use your survival skills to stay healthy and get rescued. Build shelter, find food and drink, and collect salvageable parts from the wreckage that wash ashore. Use the parts to build a space radio and call for a rescue team to win the game.
Search for natural resources, then use them to create other items using various combinations.
Features include the ability to play as different characters, find and craft several items, and multiple save slots.
Features:
- Familiar RPG-style inventory system.
- Over 80 different items.
- Randomly generated map with each new game.
- Day/night cycle.
- Fishing.
- Boar hunting & trapping.
- Befriend a wild dog as your companion.
*** Hints ***
-Search dirt areas for small boulders to build a fire pit.
-Use coconuts as an immediate source of nutrition and hydration, but also find fish in shallow water.
-Boar meat provides the best nutrition and health.
-Search beaches often for useful items from the shipwreck.

bluejetty:00118839:ios.name: Buddy Punch
bluejetty:00118839:ios.summary:
This app is for use with a paid Buddy Punch account.
Buddy Punch is an employee time tracking app that's so easy to use that your grandma could do it. With our web and mobile apps, employees can clock in and out from anywhere. Combine that
bluejetty:00118839:ios.description:
This app is for use with a paid Buddy Punch account.
Buddy Punch is an employee time tracking app that's so easy to use that your grandma could do it. With our web and mobile apps, employees can clock in and out from anywhere. Combine that with the power of geofencing, GPS tracking, and photo clock-ins, and you'll always know your employees are where they're supposed to be when they're on the clock.
MAIN FEATURES
Time Tracking: Employees can clock in and out using any internet-connected device (computer, tablet, or phone). 
Flexible Punching: Employees don't need unique email addresses to use Buddy Punch. They can clock in/out using usernames and passwords, PINs, QR codes, or even facial recognition.
Automatic Calculations: All punch data is compiled into timesheets with regular hours, overtime, and pay automatically calculated for you, making running payroll faster and easier than ever.
Employee Scheduling: Create your work schedules in Buddy Punch to take advantage of even more features like attendance tracking, punch limiting, and automatic clock outs.
PTO Tracking: Automatically calculate PTO accruals, deduct used PTO from balances, and add taken PTO to timesheets so employees get paid for their paid time off.
Job Costing: Set up department codes in Buddy Punch to track the total time spent on specific jobs and projects, then run reports to help with budgeting and invoicing.
Payroll Integrations: Send your timesheet data to QuickBooks, Gusto, Paychex, SurePayroll, and more in just a few clicks to make running payroll faster than ever before.
ACCOUNTABILITY FEATURES
GPS on Punch: Capture employees' locations when they clock in and out, then review those locations on their timesheets to ensure they were on-site when they punched.
Geofencing: Create virtual borders around each of your job sites. With geofencing enabled, employees can only clock in and out when they're within the boundaries of a geofence.
Real-Time GPS Tracking: Track employees' locations across the entire workday. See where they're located on a map at any given moment, and view breadcrumb trails of everywhere they traveled over the course of a day.
Photos on Punch: Require employees to take a picture of themselves when they clock in and out to prevent buddy punching. All photos can be reviewed on employees' time cards.

listings.name: Buddy Punch
listings.description:
This app is for use with a paid Buddy Punch account.

Buddy Punch is an employee time tracking app that's so easy to use that your grandma could do it. With our web and mobile apps, employees can clock in and out from anywhere. Combine that with the power of geofencing, GPS tracking, and photo clock-ins, and you'll always know your employees are where they're supposed to be when they're on the clock.

MAIN FEATURES

Time Tracking: Employees can clock in and out using any internet-connected device (computer, tablet, or phone). 

Flexible Punching: Employees don't need unique email addresses to use Buddy Punch. They can clock in/out using usernames and passwords, PINs, QR codes, or even facial recognition.

Automatic Calculations: All punch data is compiled into timesheets with regular hours, overtime, and pay automatically calculated for you, making running payroll faster and easier than ever.

Employee Scheduling: Create your work schedules in Buddy Punch to take advantage of even more features like attendance tracking, punch limiting, and automatic clock outs.

PTO Tracking: Automatically calculate PTO accruals, deduct used PTO from balances, and add taken PTO to timesheets so employees get paid for their paid time off.

Job Costing: Set up department codes in Buddy Punch to track the total time spent on specific jobs and projects, then run reports to help with budgeting and invoicing.

Payroll Integrations: Send your timesheet data to QuickBooks, Gusto, Paychex, SurePayroll, and more in just a few clicks to make running payroll faster than ever before.

ACCOUNTABILITY FEATURES

GPS on Punch: Capture employees' locations when they clock in and out, then review those locations on their timesheets to ensure they were on-site when they punched.

Geofencing: Create virtual borders around each of your job sites. With geofencing enabled, employees can only clock in and out when they're within the boundaries of a geofence.

AI TOOLS

bluejetty:00179384:ios.description:
Fine is the all-in-one photo and video editor. Pro color tools, powerful AI and a complete creative studio, in one app. Edit photos, RAW files, videos and Live Photos, then design collages and posters, without switching apps.
AI TOOLS
• AI Erase: tap to remove objects, people and text, or fix spots with Heal and Clone
• AI Relight: add new light to a photo after it's taken, in 2D or 3D
• Retouch: natural skin, face reshaping, eyes, makeup and Liquify
• AI Enhance: upscale, sharpen, denoise and restore photos and videos
• Replace Sky, DSLR Bokeh and one-tap Cutout
PRO COLOR
• Light, Color, Details, HSL, Color Grading, Levels, Black & White and more
• Six kinds of curves: RGB, Hue, Lab, CMYK, Saturation and Luminance
• Masks for every tool: AI selection of subject, sky, face and hair, plus brush, gradients and color range
• RAW Editor for ProRAW and camera RAW files
• Import your own LUTs (.cube) and save your own presets
FILTERS & EFFECTS
• 1,500+ filters in the Filter Shop
• 160+ artistic effects: anime, sketch, watercolor, mosaic, glitch, glass and more
• Color Match copies the look of any photo
CREATE & DESIGN
• Layers with 27 blend modes, Harmonize and text behind the subject
• Text with templates, glow, warp and your own fonts
• 3D Text in glass, ice and metal, with real lights and shadows
• Shapes, stickers and a full brush engine for doodles
• 500+ poster templates, 99 collage layouts and photo stitching
VIDEO & LIVE PHOTOS
• Multi-track timeline: trim, split, speed curves and keyframes
• 200+ transitions, text animations, music and AI voice noise reduction
• Edit Live Photos with filters, stickers, text and animation, and save them as Live Photos
• Export up to 4K
BUILT FOR REAL WORK
• Non-destructive history: go back to any step and change it
• Batch edit: edit one photo and sync the edits to the rest
• Copy and paste edits, save versions, and pick up any project later
• Manual camera with RAW capture and live filters
• Export as JPG, PNG or HEIC with full quality control
FINE VIP
Fine VIP unlocks all premium tools, filters, effects and templates, with monthly and yearly subscription options. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://fine.youthpe.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fine.youthpe.com/privacy

bluejetty:00170210:ios.description:
Codehub is a mobile code learning platform that empowers millions of programming enthusiasts, students, and professional developers to lead inspiring careers in technology. Codehub’s innovative, scalable approach to online coding education allows anyone to master the skills needed to succeed in our tech-enabled workforce. Codehub is currently offering hundreds of coding challenges on Python and will offer hundreds of challenges across ten programming languages by the end of the year.
The Codehub app allows users to practice various programming languages and concepts through short, interactive coding challenges and quizzes. Challenges are written with the beginner in mind, so anyone with little or no coding experience can join and practice their skills through the bit-sized coding exercises. 
“I’m a beginner, never done anything like this, and I’ve used apps trying to learn but draw a complete blank when thinking of implementing any of it. Codehub is a game changer” - beta user.
Codehub mobile code learning platform offers the following to its users.
• Bit-sized coding challenges
• The best coding experience on mobile
• Community support and much more
We will be happy to guide you along your coding journey if you join us and practice coding.
———————
HOW DOES IT WORK?
After you decide to begin your journey and download the app, you can start a free trial.
Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial, you will be automatically charged a price indicated on the payment screen for a chosen subscription period.
The premium subscription renews automatically at the end of each period (each week, month, 6 months, year, or otherwise, depending on the selected option) until you cancel. Canceling your subscription means the automatic renewal will be disabled. However, you will still have access to all your subscription features for the remaining time of your then-current period.
Note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscriptions.
———————
Our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service are available at https://codehub.ninja/privacy/
If you have any questions, don't hesitate to get in touch with us at support@codehub.ninja

The game supports multiple languages, including Simplified Chinese, English, Russian, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese.

bluejetty:00026899:ios.description:
Use OurPact parental control app to:
• View – Capture automated periodic or on-demand views of your children’s online activity, all encrypted for safety
• App Blocker – Block internet, text messages, and apps with a single tap
• App Rules – Block & allow specific apps
• Block/Allow Websites – Prevent access to specific websites, including adult content, for safe internet browsing
• Block Texting – Block access or set rules for texting apps
• New App Alerts – Receive alerts when new apps are installed on your child’s device
• Block Schedules – Automate your family’s daily routine
• App Permissions – Custom rules to exclude specific apps from being blocked by any schedule
• Screen Time Allowance – Set daily screen time limits for your kids
• Geofencing with Places – Create GPS geofences around specific locations and receive real-time alerts when kids leave and arrive at home, school, or any set place
• Family Locator – Locate family members and devices using geolocation and geofences
OurPact allows parents to foster healthy habits and manage their child's screen time using screen time allowance, blocking specific apps, blocking texts, and scheduling daily screen time for a child's daily routine. OurPact is the most comprehensive parental control app and family locator, perfect for families of any size.
Block apps like social media and games and have peace of mind knowing you can see your kid’s location and have insight into their online activity. 
By pairing your family's iPads, iPhones, iPods, or other device platforms with OurPact's parental control app, you have the power to manage your entire family's screen time & device locations from one powerful application.
Recommendations:
• Use OurPact's app blocker and parental control app solution to reinforce agreements and healthy boundaries regarding screen time limits and mobile device use with your child.
• Use OurPact parental control app to block social media or games with a single touch while leaving apps that help your children learn and grow.
• Use OurPact’s View function for spot-check monitoring of your child’s online content.
• Set daily screen time allowance and teach your children how to budget their screen time effectively.
• Set one-time or recurring schedules to manage your child’s screen time even when they are not with you.
• Find your family or locate lost or stolen items using Family Locator.
OurPact offers Premium and Premium+ monthly auto-renewing subscriptions charged to your iTunes account. Try 14 days free! You'll be billed monthly within 24 hours of the end of the current billing period. You may cancel or turn off auto-renewal of your OurPact subscriptions at any time by going to Account Settings. To avoid being billed for an additional period, subscriptions must be canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
For more information, visit:
ourpact.com/privacy
ourpact.com/terms
If you have any questions or need technical support, do not hesitate to reach us via email: support@ourpact.com
