bluejetty:00063317:ios.description:
"Episode lets you LIVE your stories with love, romance, adventure, and drama. Wouldn’t it be amazing if YOU were a character in your favorite story? Episode lets you do just that with over 150,000 gripping stories, where you make choices that matter.
With billions of reads and 150,000+ stories, Episode is an immense collection of interactive stories where YOU choose your destiny. Or become a creator and write your own!
How does it work?
Customize your avatar and design your outfit
Develop relationships with your favorite characters - will they be rivals or Romeos?
Change fate through your choices
Discover all of the different endings
Immerse yourself in thousands of diverse worlds, the options are endless!
Not only can you read your favorite stories, you can also write your own! Write and publish your very own interactive stories on Episode’s platform, amassing millions of reads yourself.
Find your favorite Book Club, join in on a reading challenge with your book club members, and earn rewards!
Not only can you read your favorite stories, you can also write your own! Write and publish your very own interactive stories on Episode’s platform, amassing millions of reads yourself.
Some of our favorites reads:
DON’T HATE THE PLAYER: You're looking for love in a house full of singles! The catch? Not all of them are here for the right reasons. Will you fall for the person of your dreams or walk away getting played?
RULE BREAKER: Find out what happens when you start crushing on someone who’s technically “off limits”. Will you pursue that romantic spark?
THE SOULMATE GAME: Experts have found your perfect match! Find him and you’ll go home with $1 million AND a husband. The catch? You won’t get to know whether he’s THE one until you’re both at the altar.
BOYFRIEND FOR RENT: What’s worse than receiving an invitation to your ex's wedding? Showing up dateless! Thank goodness, your best friend is here to save you! Can you resist his charm while fake-dating?
THE PRINCE’S BRIDE: Determined to marry for love, the Prince of Castile invites you to compete to be his bride. Can you beat the other brides and claim his heart or will the crown divide you forever?
PLUS… more new stories EVERY WEEK!
PRETTY LITTLE LIARS and all related characters and elements © & ™ Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. 
PLEASE NOTE: Episode lets you purchase items within the game for real money. Please disable in-app purchases on your device if you do not want this feature to be accessible.
EPISODE VIP SUBSCRIPTIONS:
You can subscribe for VIP access to Episode content
The subscriptions are $14.99 monthly*
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
*Prices are equal to the value that ""Apple's App Store Matrix"" determines is the equivalent subscription price in $USD
Your use of this application is governed by the Terms of Service available at http://pocketgems.com/episode-terms-of-service/. Collection and use of your data are subject to the Privacy Policy available at http://pocketgems.com/episode-privacy-policy/."

bluejetty:00042328:ios.description:
Aces Poker Run is the only mobile app built specifically to organize and manage poker run fundraisers, rallies, and fun-run style events — whether by boat, bike, sled, cart, or on foot. From registration to card dealing to real-time leaderboards, Aces simplifies the entire event experience for both organizers and participants.
Eliminate the hassle of paperwork, spreadsheets, and manual check-ins. Aces lets you:
Create and publish events in minutes
Offer digital registration, waivers, and Stripe payments
Deal cards via QR code, GPS arrival, or scheduled time
Track progress with live hand rankings and leaderboards
Assign and transfer hands via QR scan or mobile delivery
Sell extras like shirts, meals, and donations in-app
Manage offline ticket sales with built-in tools
Support multi-day and choose-your-route formats
Whether you're raising money or building community, Aces makes it easy, fun, and fully digital.

bluejetty:00120921:ios.summary: Create, customize and battle your BEYBLADE BURST tops in the BEYBLADE BURST App. Challenge your friends in over 90 countries worldwide to global multiplayer online* matches, with leaderboards, personalized profiles, an enhanced digital top
bluejetty:00120921:ios.description:
Create, customize and battle your BEYBLADE BURST tops in the BEYBLADE BURST App. Challenge your friends in over 90 countries worldwide to global multiplayer online* matches, with leaderboards, personalized profiles, an enhanced digital top selection and the capability of earning achievements to level up from Rookie to ultimate BEYBLADE Master! Compete to win matches and unlock virtual pieces! The BEYBLADE BURST App brings the excitement and energy of BEYBLADE BURST to your own personal device!
BATTLE LEAGUE: CREATE A LEAGUE OF YOUR OWN 
-START A LEAGUE WITH YOUR FRIENDS: Create a league, invite your friends, and BATTLE in multi-round tournaments for the title of top Blader.
-CHOOSE A SEASON: Choose season lengths of 1 day, 1 week, or 1 month.
-YOUR SCOREBOARD: Earn points by challenging your friends to 2 different types of battles:
1. COMPETE ONLINE WITH DIGITAL BATTLES: Challenge your friends to digital battles that add points to your Blader score.
2. COMPETE FACE-TO-FACE WITH TOY BATTLES: Battle your friends face-to-face with your Beyblade Burst top toys, then enter the results into your Battle League! 
-GATHER YOUR LEAGUE FOR TOURNAMENT DAY: Create a 1 day season and host a bracketed toy tournament party! 
CONTROL RC BLUETOOTH ENABLED BEYBLADE BURST TOPS!**
-Scan a BEYBLADE BURST Energy Layer to unlock BLUETOOTH enabled digital controls within the BEYBLADE BURST app. 
-Swipe left or right onscreen to change spin direction and speed of your BLUETOOTH enabled BEYBLADE BURST top
-Charge up power during battle and unleash mighty Avatar attacks!
BEYBLADE BURST HYPERSPHERE!
CLIMB AND DROP ATTACK: Faceoff in intense battle clashes to build power and launch your digital HYPERSPHERE top up the HYPERSPHERE BEYSTADIUM walls, speed along the brink, and drop onto your opponent with a devastating attack!
GIFT WITH FRIENDS TO EARN DIGITAL FRIEND REWARDS
-Send your scanned Beyblade Burst tops on BATTLE TRACK battles to earn virtual Beycoins in the app you can gift to your Blader friends!
-Gift BATTLE TRACK virtual Beycoins or add new friends to earn FRIEND REWARDS to unlock exclusive digital content within the app.
USEFUL TIPS:
This app requires access to your device’s camera to scan the code on your BEYBLADE BURST products. Visit your device's privacy settings to enable the camera. 
**BLUETOOTH enabled BEYBLADE BURST tops sold separately. Not available in all languages or markets. BEYBLADE BURST™ app works with select iPhone®, iPad® and iPod touch® devices. Updates affect compatibility. Check apps.hasbro.com for details and device compatibility. *Features such as multiplayer online, friends leaderboard and progress restore require an internet connection. Ask a parent first.
Supported Devices running iOS 8+
- iPod Touch 5th Gen+
- iPhone 4S+
- iPad 2+
- iPad Mini+

bluejetty:00118908:ios.summary:

• Create your
bluejetty:00118908:ios.description:
Free conference call rooms instantly, allowing anyone to call in and join your conference. With no signup, conference rooms are available with 1 tap after installing the App.
From within the App, Conference NOW allows you to:
• Create your own free conference call room
• Share the call-in number and PIN with anyone
• Call-in from your iPhone (or any phone)
• Manage your conference to see and mute participants
• See the history of your past conference calls
OVERVIEW
Conference NOW gives you the ability to create instant free conferences:
• Completely Free
• No signup required
• 1 tap to create a conference
• Conference call numbers provided in United States + Canada
• 1 tap to call-in and enter PIN on the iPhone
• Generate multiple conference rooms
• Label your conferences
SHARING
Share your conference number with anyone from within the App via:
• iMessage / SMS
• Email
• 3rd party Apps (Twitter, Facebook, Skype, etc.)
• Copy and paste anywhere
VIEW / MANAGE
You can view and manage your conference:
• See who's in the conference
• See who's speaking
• Mute / un-mute a participant or all participants
• When all participants are muted, others that join will automatically be muted
• Call-in as a moderator, and moderator(s) won't be muted when muting everyone
• Participants can press * on their phone to raise their hand (use to identify people to un-mute)
• Optionally enable contacts access and see the name of a participant if they're in your contacts (data used locally only, we don't have access to your contacts)
• Disable entry/exit tones that are played when people join/leave the conference (great for when you have lots of participants)
• View your conference call history including dates/times/durations, and information on each participant
• Save participants to your contacts, and call a participant back within the app
ACCESS NUMBERS
Call-in numbers you’re assigned are:
• Telephone numbers in the United States + Canada
• Can be reached from any phone worldwide
• Allow unlimited conference length (some carriers may disconnect calls after 6 to 8 hours, you can always just call back)
• Free to call for callers with unlimited calling to the USA or Canada (standard calling rates to the United States / Canada apply for those not on unlimited calling plans)
OTHER
Since there’s no signup required for Conference NOW, keep the following in mind:
• Conference call-in numbers and PINs are deleted automatically 30 days after creation
• Every time anyone calls in, your call-in number and PIN expiration is extended by 30 days
• Create new conference rooms anytime
• There's no signup, email, phone number or anything else required to use the app
••• Like Conference NOW? Please leave a positive review for our app!

listings.description:
Free conference call rooms instantly, allowing anyone to call in and join your conference. With no signup, conference rooms are available with 1 tap after installing the App.

From within the App, Conference NOW allows you to:
• Create your own free conference call room
• Share the call-in number and PIN with anyone
• Call-in from your iPhone (or any phone)
• Manage your conference to see and mute participants
• See the history of your past conference calls

OVERVIEW
Conference NOW gives you the ability to create instant free conferences:
• Completely Free
• No signup required
• 1 tap to create a conference
• Conference call numbers provided in United States + Canada
• 1 tap to call-in and enter PIN on the iPhone
• Generate multiple conference rooms
• Label your conferences

SHARING
Share your conference number with anyone from within the App via:
• iMessage / SMS
• Email
• 3rd party Apps (Twitter, Facebook, Skype, etc.)
• Copy and paste anywhere

VIEW / MANAGE
You can view and manage your conference:
• See who's in the conference
• See who's speaking
• Mute / un-mute a participant or all participants
• When all participants are muted, others that join will automatically be muted
• Call-in as a moderator, and moderator(s) won't be muted when muting everyone
• Participants can press * on their phone to raise their hand (use to identify people to un-mute)
• Optionally enable contacts access and see the name of a participant if they're in your contacts (data used locally only, we don't have access to your contacts)
• Disable entry/exit tones that are played when people join/leave the conference (great for when you have lots of participants)
• View your conference call history including dates/times/durations, and information on each participant
• Save participants to your contacts, and call a participant back within the app

ACCESS NUMBERS
Call-in numbers you’re assigned are:
• Telephone numbers in the United States + Canada
• Can be reached from any phone worldwide
• Allow unlimited conference length (some carriers may disconnect calls after 6 to 8 hours, you can always just call back)
• Free to call for callers with unlimited calling to the USA or Canada (standard calling rates to the United States / Canada apply for those not on unlimited calling plans)

OTHER
Since there’s no signup required for Conference NOW, keep the following in mind:
• Conference call-in numbers and PINs are deleted automatically 30 days after creation
• Every time anyone calls in, your call-in number and PIN expiration is extended by 30 days
• Create new conference rooms anytime
• There's no signup, email, phone number or anything else required to use the app

bluejetty:00140657:ios.description:
We spent many years creating the best period and ovulation tracker. We implemented all features requested by our users and put a lot of heart into the app.
Features:
• Automatically predicts menstruation periods. 
• Keeps history of your menstrual cycles. 
• Full integratation with the Health app (uses HealthKit framework).
• Spotlight Search: find your notes, symptoms or even the date of your next period.
• Includes a Home Screen widget.
• Can track up to four different symptoms (e.g. migraine or abdominal pain).
• Symptom names may be changed.
• Calendar colors may be changed.
• Can track body temperature (in Fahrenheit and Celsius degrees). 
• Displays basal body temperature charts. 
• Text notes (e.g. about period, taken medications, mood, friends) may be attached to each day. 
• Automatically predicts probable ovulation days. 
• The user interface is easy to use and looks good. 
• Password protection (if you forgot your password, please enter: passwordrecovery111). 
Why should you choose our application? 
• It has a modern and elegant look and is easy to navigate. 
• We constantly add new features and listen to you. 
• The application is universal: it works on all your iOS devices (e.g. iPhone, iPod Touch, iPad) and on your Apple TV.

bluejetty:00131875:ios.description:
Harvest smiling faces with self-discipline. Even small dreams require daily effort.
The Smile List adheres to the minimalist and fresh design of Emmo Corp. There are no flashy ICONS, only a clear daily list.
There is no noisy socializing here, face yourself, know yourself.
It is very easy to punch in here. Plan your daily activities in advance. You just need to swipe right or gently press the habit, and your punch is finished.
Shake, switch different punching styles.
You can, of course, add a clock log, which will make it more intuitive when you review your schedule.
When you complete more than 60 percent of your daily habits, you get a smiley face, a nice card that you can click on and write your thoughts on the back of your life, and a cute Tracker to save or share your smile with your friends.
I can't wait to see your smiling faces. Let's work together to make a better life with a little effort and self-discipline.

Voxy is the world’s first personalized language learning app that adapts to students’ and employees’ unique learning needs in real-time. Join over 3 million learners in more than 21 countries and discover how our efficient methodology and powerful technology will change the way you learn English.
Working with English-speaking clients? Preparing for the TOEFL? Traveling soon? Voxy works on your computer, tablet and smartphone. Your course will be synched and up to date across all of these devices.
How it Works
Rather than teaching phrases that are not relevant to our learner’s needs like “Janie kicks the ball”, we deliver real English content that is updated daily. Voxy’s learners study in context with videos of people accomplishing daily tasks, audio recordings of real-life situations, karaoke-style music lessons and up-to-date news stories from leading media companies like the Associated Press.
Premium Features
- Multiplatform: Learn everywhere on any device: mobile, tablet or computer
- Lessons updated daily: Learn from fluent speakers accomplishing real world tasks
- Private tutoring: Schedule a session & receive feedback. 
- Unlimited Access & Real time progress tracking

bluejetty:00137875:ios.description:
Welcome and get ready to challenge your mind with 2244, the ultimate puzzle game! Merge number blocks and strategize your moves to conquer each level of the number game. Are you ready to play 2244 and take on the mind-blowing challenges?
Step up & enter a world of number games with strategy. Merge matching numbers to create long links and reach the coveted infinity tiles for the highest scores. Unlock new tiles or blocks by merging the right numbers and dominate the puzzle game.
In 2244, you can merge matching numbers on a grid to create higher numbers, eventually aiming to reach the "infinity tile" with a value of 2048 at level 1. However, strategic merging is essential to free up space on the grid and create larger numbers like 4096 to 8192 & 16384 till infinity.
As this mind game progresses, new tiles are unlocked, increasing the complexity and challenge for you. The ultimate objective is to achieve the highest score possible by merging numbers efficiently.
The number block game is easy to learn but hard to master. Now test your memory & score your IQ level with this puzzles game. The block puzzle game offers a fun and challenging experience. It also provides you the best chance to dominate or climb the global & regional leaderboards, and become a master of numbers. You can change the avatar & wallpapers of your choice for each level, creating a perfect display for yourself.
Features — 2244 Number Puzzle
► Addictive number twist & linking mechanics
► Play endlessly & test your IQ level
► Build pressure and challenge your skills
► Offline Game! No popup on the go
► Mind-blowing avatars for you
► Changing wallpapers to refresh your mind
► Unique map for stage selection
► Dominate Global & Regional leagues
► Autosave Achievements & Coins
► Combos with exciting boosters
How To Play 2244 Puzzle Game
► Swap and merge numbers left, right, up, and down
► Create shapes with identical and 2x numbers to form long links
► Merge numbers to find infinity tiles with high scores
► Unlock tiles & get amazing boosters
► Claim daily rewards and spin the wheel for additional rewards
► Use map to select your stage of progression
► Customize your avatar and wallpapers to enhance your gameplay experience
Play and enjoy an exciting block puzzle game experience with relaxing number links and challenging levels of leagues. So, why wait? Download and immerse yourself in this amazing, mind-relaxing number game, featuring fun elements, and test your memory and numerical skills.

Welcome to Find Differences: Spot It, the classic and free puzzle game designed for detail-seekers and puzzle lovers.
Try to spot all the hidden differences between two nearly identical pictures, during which you can relax your brain and ease your mind! 
Can you become a master of Find Differences: Spot It? 
Come to challenge yourself now!

- Featuring Levels: Explore more than 10,000 high-quality puzzle levels.

- Compare two nearly identical pictures.
- Tap the spot when you find a hidden difference.
- Spot all differences (usually 15) to solve the puzzle.

bluejetty:00124412:ios.description:
Start your vacation! Welcome to My Town Grand Hotel, play as a Doorman, Receptionist or guest, visit a restaurant, get the best room or relax in the Spa! Explore all locations and create amazing stories!
Have a welcome drink in the hotel lobby, check if your room is available, grab the apartment key and let the doorman help you with luggage! Try the elevator, check all rooms as each room has a different theme and have fun! Check why My Town has the best roleplaying games in the world!
PACK YOUR BAGS - VACATION HAS STARTED!
Dress up as a doorman in a new uniform and help with bags! Check the spa area and relax next to a swimming pool. Choose a perfect swimming suit for your character and have fun! 
Visit all the dollhouse rooms in this Grand Hotel and other locations like Restaurant, Lobby, Rooms, and Playroom for kids with Pirate ship and let the doorman show you how the elevator works. This resort offers endless opportunities to create your own vacation hotel stories!
MY TOWN HOTEL GAMES FEATURE:
• 7 locations to explore: Lobby, Rooms, Restaurant...
• Meet Hotel staff, Family with kids and other guests
• Customize characters in many outfits
• Discover a Pirate Ship in the Playroom for kids
• Many Themed Rooms: Pink room, Safari room, Family room ...
• Get some snacks in the hotel Restaurant
• Clean the guest room
• Enjoy, relax and for fun!
• Bring other characters to the Grand Hotel
BE A DOORMAN, RECEPTIONIST OR ENJOY AS A GUEST!
You can roleplay with all dollhouse characters and create your own hotel story. Our Hotel games allow you to dress up all your dolls and make the vacation stories you want! Be a Grand Hotel Doorman, take a trolley with bags to the room, or dress up the entire family in the resort outfit. Visit the swimming pool and Playroom! Our Family Hotel Playroom is perfect for small kids to play mini-games and meet pirates and their pirate ships. Our Grand Hotel is not like other hotels; it is all about you here!
CHECK ALL ROOMS IN THIS GAME: 
• PINK ROOM
See a Grand Hotel Pink room. A fantastic resort hotel room with heart-shaped furniture. This will be a favorite room for girls!
• SAFARI ROOM
Tell the Doorman to take the trolley with bags to this fantastic resort suite. Experience Africa once you enter the room. Check animal pattern bedding or a green wall! Both girls and boys will love it very much!
• FAMILY ROOM
Unpack the suitcases you brought on the vacation and relax with your family. Find a big wardrobe to play dress-up games for kids all day! Big resort room perfect for parents with kids! Enjoy in this family hotel where you can create cool stories.
• MY TOWN RESTAURANT
Go to My Town Restaurant and eat cookies, pasta, crab, sandwiches, and drink delicious juice. The best restaurant you've ever been to!
• SWIMMING POOL
Visit a pool and relax! Swim, order drinks and enjoy your vacation! Download the game today and see why My Town games are the best dollhouse games in the world! 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Our hotel game is perfect for kids 4-12. The game is safe even when parents are out of the room.
ABOUT MY TOWN
My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse games that promote creativity and open-ended play for kids. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For help visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00114666:ios.description:
The apocalypse has arrived. The last war has begun – can you survive?
Dive into Hazard Days, a heart-pounding, day Z and pixel survival game. A mysterious alien civilization visited Earth, using biological weapons and seizing resources they needed. Now that they have left this planet - humanity is virtually destroyed. Days after a brutal post apocalypse unfolds in a world ravaged by war, radiation, and outbreak. As one of these last survivors in this dark wasteland, you must scavenge, craft, fight to endure last days of civilization. Step into a post-apocalypse world ravaged by nuclear war, where only the strongest survive. Every decision matters in this extraction shooter and survival games, meets unforgettable experience.
Gameplay Mechanics 
1. Loot & Equip
In this brutal game, every item counts. Raid abandoned bunkers, last shelter outposts, zombie-infested forests to:
Gather resources for survival craft
Find rare blueprints to upgrade your pixel gun arsenal
Manage inventory weight – carry too much, you’ll be too slow to escape
2. Fight & Survive
Engage in intense extraction shooter battles against zombie hordes, human raiders (armed with dark war tactics). Use stealth or go guns-blazing and don’t ignore radiation, or you’ll face a last day on earth scenario
3. Escape & Progress
Complete extraction missions to unlock new zones: zombi forest, swamp, city and others. Fail the raid, and you lose everything – this is the day Z level punishment.
4. Character Progression
Upgrade your skills, combat, or tactics. Develop your character, because you will have to kill zombies, vicious dogs and other enemies.
5. Escalating Challenges
The difficulty increases, as it does a few days after a cataclysm. The first difficult tasks turn into sieges of this "last refuge" for survival against hordes. Dynamic battles with enemies make this game unpredictable.
It isn’t just another survival game - it is the ultimate test of your win-or-die instincts. This passage of this game is complicated by strong opponents. Manage your inventory wisely; greed weighs you down, but empty hands won’t survive the outbreak
Key Features 
1. Stylized Pixel Art Apocalypse
A grim pixel gun aesthetic – where every blood splatter tells a story
Retro meets modern: dungeon shooters inspired environments with dynamic lighting
2. Intense Extraction Shooter
Infiltrate, loot, escape before this zombie apocalypse swallows you
Last day on earth survival tension in every raid
3. Deep Loot System
Survival craft
Legendary pixel gun variants
4. Diverse Enemy Types
Zombie survival foes:
- Scary zombies
- Rabid animals
- Vicious raiders
5. Brutally Challenging Mechanics
Remember that you must:
Overcome isolation health effects
Complete ultimate challenges
Fight enemies in the last war survival
Why Players Love It:
- Combines the best of zombie survival games
- Deep survival craft mechanics
- Intense pixel gun combat system
- Ever-changing outbreak challenges
Hazard Days is a hardcore game set in a pixel art apocalypse world overrun by zombies. As one of the last survivors, you must scavenge loot in last shelter survival bunkers and ruined cities to craft weapons and supplies. Fight zombie hordes and hostile humans in intense extraction shooter combat where every bullet counts. This deep craft system lets you build bases, but dark war raiders will try to destroy them. The pixel gun combat blends retro style with modern shooter mechanics.
Will you survive the last day on earth or become another victim of the apocalypse?

bluejetty:00036058:ios.description:
Discover the boundless potential of artificial intelligence with Lisa! Our cutting-
edge AI technology operates seamlessly in the background, delivering stunning
results tailored to your preferences. Unleash your creativity effortlessly through
Lisa's intuitive interface.
Explore Lisa's capabilities:
AI Avatar:
Explore an extensive selection of avatar styles, constantly refreshed with new
additions almost every week. Embark on adventures through time with your
partner, envision yourself as royalty, or select holiday-themed outfits. Simplify the
process by creating profiles for yourself, family, and friends, making avatar
generation a seamless experience with just a few clicks.
Text-to-Art:
Transform your words into captivating visual art! Describe your desired scene,
whether it's a canine astronaut or an underwater world, and watch as Lisa brings
your imagination to life with stunning imagery.
Image-to-Art:
Turn ordinary photos into extraordinary creations! Watch as your friends become
superheroes or your pets transform into cartoon characters. Simply upload your
images, provide a text prompt, and let Lisa work its magic.
Video Effects:
Elevate your favorite videos with AI-enhanced styles! Dance like an ancient
statue or perform in front of a medieval castle – the possibilities are endless with
Lisa's dynamic video effects.
Deforum:
Create engaging animations from your photos and videos! Produce content that's
sure to captivate social media audiences and stand out from the crowd.
Our dedicated team of developers is committed to staying at the forefront of AI
technology, continuously updating the app with exciting new features. Join us on
this journey of innovation with Lisa!
About Subscriptions
We offer in-app purchases and 3-day / 7-day free trial for Lisa AI premium version! The premium version provides benefits such as unlimited drawing creation, faster processing speed, more styles and discounts on avatar packs. You can purchase a weekly subscription for a short-term trial. To enjoy more of Lisa AI privileges, we recommend purchasing an annual subscription or lifetime package. The cost will vary from country to country, but will be charged to your iTunes account. You will be able to see the fee amount before completing the purchase. Subscriptions with in-app purchases will renew according to the renewal schedule of the selected payment plan. To terminate automatic subscription renewal, you must uncheck automatic subscription renewal at most 24 hours before your subscription expires. You can cancel your automatic subscription renewal at any time in your iTunes account settings. Privileges not used during the free trial period, if any, expire when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Privacy Policy: https://lisaai.app/privacy.pdf
Terms of Service: https://lisaai.app/terms.pdf

bluejetty:00026923:ios.description:
Hunting Points is the ultimate hunting tool suitable for every hunter and outdoorsman. With features dedicated to enhancing your experience out in the field, Hunting Points makes it easy to identify, track and save your preferred hunting grounds. Whether it’s trail camera zones, tree stand spots, or hunting areas, Hunting Points has you covered. Recording tracks, trails and marking points on the way has never been so easy with this perfect hunter’s tool.
Get easy access to land boundaries and property lines across the United States. Check private and public property lines seamlessly in app with landowner name and address information as well as other available parcel data. Hunting Points even provides you with reliable GPS coordinates to keep you on track and help you get back to base camp no matter where you are.
Check various forecasts including 7-day detailed weather forecast (hourly temperature, precipitation, wind, pressure changes) and rain & clouds map radar for potential incoming storms.
Get the top hunting companion for any outdoor expedition with Hunting Points. Download and take advantage of comprehensive tools today.
PROPERTY LINES, LAND OWNERSHIP & PARCEL DATA
• View private and public land boundaries and property lines
• Search for parcel data like landowner name and address
• Property lines coverage for the United States, Canada and New Zealand
NAVIGATION
• Save hunting locations, hotspots, and waypoints for your next trip
• Record tracks for seamless navigation back to camp
• Draw tracks, trails and hunting areas directly in the app
• Navigate to saved locations thanks to real time GPS data
• Measure distances and areas no matter where you are
• 3D map mode
OFFLINE MAPS
• Useful offline maps are available for use when there’s no coverage
• Get terrain, satellite, topo, and night mode with your offline maps
• Track your location even without cellular coverage
WEATHER
• Check current, hourly, and 7-day weather forecast information
• Get hourly wind conditions to plan your hunting approach
• Severe weather alerts to help keep you safe
• Check Rain & Clouds map radar for incoming storms (past and forecast)
RIVER DATA
• Current water levels & flows for 35k+ river stations
HUNT ACTIVITY
• Hourly deer activity forecast
• Feeding times (major and minor times)
• Best hunting times
SOLUNAR DATA
• Sunrise & sunset times
• Sun positions
• Moonrise and moonset times
• Moon positions, phases, and guide
TROPHY ROOM
• Save catches and create a trophy room of your favorite species (White-tailed deer, Turkey, Pheasant, Mule deer, Elk, Moose, Mallard duck, Canada goose, Rabbit)
• Check conditions from a previous hunt – from weather, solunar conditions, to location
• Add gear used, view catch photos, and much more
SHARE
• Import kmz or gpx files from gps devices or other apps
• Share your locations with friends
• Share photos of your hunts with other users
The download and usage of Hunting Points app is free of charge. Upgrading to the Premium version is available on a yearly or monthly subscription basis (price may vary between locations). Should you choose to upgrade to the Premium version, payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for auto renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and reflect the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in your Account Settings in iTunes after purchase.
Privacy policy: https://huntingpoints.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://huntingpoints.app/terms

bluejetty:00178005:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Fire up the grill! Delight customers by serving up delicious dishes in Bikini Bottom's restaurants in this culinary adventure based on the series.
When Mr. Krabs realizes there’s more money to be earned in the fast-food business, the penny-pinching restaurateur sets out to expand his empire — starting with a breakfast stand outside of SpongeBob’s house. Who better to help Mr. Krabs run his business than SpongeBob SquarePants himself?
Play as SpongeBob to create your own Bikini Bottom kitchen, decorate and customize your restaurant, and get ready to serve your guests delicious food! In this fast-food cooking game, put your time-management skills to the test and experience an expanded SpongeBob universe.
Features: 
• Move up the ranks: Ready to whip up Krabby Patties, pancakes, BBQ and more? You’ll serve tons of familiar faces like Patrick Star, Sandy Cheeks and Squidward. Keep your customers happy and be rewarded with tips, likes and exciting bonuses. Start as a junior fry cook and train to become one of Bikini Bottom’s premier fast-food chefs!
• Explore the world of SpongeBob SquarePants: Tour familiar restaurants and new kitchens in Bikini Bottom, Goo Lagoon and beyond. New restaurants and cuisines are added regularly, offering new cooking challenges and recipes to learn!
• Decorate, upgrade and personalize your restaurants: Start out with a basic restaurant design and create a kitchen fit for an expert chef! Upgrade your kitchen equipment to cook food quickly and provide faster service. 
• Unlock your favorite characters: Dress them in amazing outfits inspired by the show! Upgrade and power up your characters to help you cook in new and delicious ways.
• Experience a new storyline: Dive into an all-new, exclusive story featuring SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs, Squidward, Sandy and Patrick. Play through the storyline to unlock new levels.
- Created by Tilting Point.

bluejetty:00061901:ios.name: Littmann Learning
bluejetty:00061901:ios.summary: Littmann® Learning, powered by eMurmur®, is a mobile app for cardiac and pulmonary auscultation education. Built for students, educators, and clinicians, it gives you access to real patient heart sounds, lung sounds, and guided learning mod
bluejetty:00061901:ios.description:
Littmann® Learning, powered by eMurmur®, is a mobile app for cardiac and pulmonary auscultation education. Built for students, educators, and clinicians, it gives you access to real patient heart sounds, lung sounds, and guided learning modules – available anytime, anywhere.
Train your ear and strengthen your stethoscope skills with a rich library of high-fidelity recordings and interactive lessons designed to improve stethoscope auscultation and clinical listening confidence. Whether you are learning the basics or refining advanced listening skills, Littmann Learning helps you recognize and distinguish normal, benign, and pathological heart and lung sounds. Compare healthy and abnormal findings, reinforce pattern recognition, and build confidence for the classroom, simulation lab, and clinical practice. Build confidence with heart and lung sound recognition. Learn cardiac and pulmonary auscultation with Littmann Learning.
Littmann Learning includes a library of curated heart and lung sounds, including: 
* A range of normal heart sounds
* Abnormal heart sounds, including systolic, diastolic, and continuous murmurs
* Key pathologies like aortic stenosis, aortic insufficiency, mitral insufficiency, mitral stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, ventricular septal defect, atrial septal defect, patent ductus arteriosus, or tetralogy of Fallot
* Additional sounds such as clicks, splits, S3/S4, PAC/PVC
* A range of normal lung sound recordings
* Abnormal lung sounds, including crackles, wheezes, and rhonchi
Learn by listening and by seeing. Visual tools such as phonocardiograms and sound displays help connect what you hear through the stethoscope with the underlying acoustic patterns, making it easier to identify important cardiac and pulmonary findings.
Littmann Learning is designed for anyone learning heart and lung auscultation, including: nursing students, medical students, interns, residents, fellows, physicians, nurses, PAs, or EMTs.
DISCLAIMER: THIS APP DOES NOT PROVIDE MEDICAL ADVICE OR IS AN ATTEMPT TO PRACTICE MEDICINE.
The information including but not limited to, text, graphics, images and other material contained on this app are for informational purposes only. No material on this app is intended to be a substitute for professional medical education, advice, diagnosis or treatment.
–-
Available in-app purchases
Subscription titles, content and length:
* Basic Monthly — Access to Listening modules for 1 month.
* Semester Pass — Full access for 6 months.
* Annual Pass — Full access for 12 months.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Type of subscriptions: Auto-renewable. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period; the cost for renewal is the same as the initial charge.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
----

bluejetty:00077606:ios.description:
Achieve your fitness goals with the ultimate Street Workout & Calisthenics App.
Street Workout & Calisthenics App is an offline app with 60+ free routines classified by difficulty. Each routine has its illustrative image and guide to follow. Street Workout & Calisthenics App has a wide variety of sections such as Street Workout & Calisthenics Plans, Tabata Timer and 7 Minutes Workout Section. Start training Calisthenics today! There is content for all levels, so you don't need to have practiced calisthenics or bodyweight training before.
Street Workout & Calisthenics App helps you to achieve impressive street workout skills and functional muscles. Learn impressive Street Workout & Calisthenics Skills with step by step progressions from beginner to hard levels. As if that were not enough, you can enjoy the bonus section 3+ independent routines available for now. Workout at home, park or at the gym, with your routines in your pocket always offline. Stay with our workouts and notice a change in just a few weeks.
Street Workout & Calisthenics Plans is a simple section where you can follow routines with 1-week plans for 3 or 6 months. Street Workout & Calisthenics Plans works automatically choosing your current day and show your routine for that specific day.
Tabata Timer HIIT is a free interval workout timer app for high-intensity interval training (HIIT). It is more than a stopwatch or countdown clock. This Tabata Timer will be useful for sprints, push-ups, jumping jacks, sit-ups, cycling, running, boxing, plank, weightlifting, martial arts, and other fitness activities.
5 to 26 Minute Street Workout & Calisthenics challenges are based on HICT (high-intensity circuit training), the most efficient way to improve your muscular and aerobic fitness.
7 Minute Workout is based on HICT (high-intensity circuit training), proven to be the “safest, most effective, and most efficient” way to improve your muscular and aerobic fitness, and make you healthier. Consists of only 12 exercises to be done for 30 seconds, with 10-second breaks between each exercise. All you need is a chair and a wall. Repeat 2-3 circuits depending on how much time you have. Make it your first choice at home or at the office. The bonus is Jump Rope Workouts.

bluejetty:00160565:ios.description:
Momento Dash Cam Viewer: Your Roadside Storyteller
Rediscover every moment of your journey with the Momento Dash Cam Viewer. Now supporting both the M8 and M7 Wi-Fi Dash Cams, this app effortlessly captures, stores, and lets you revisit all your road adventures in stunning detail.
Why Drive With Momento?
- Instant Replay: Access and rewatch videos from your M8 or M7 Wi-Fi Camera, whenever inspiration strikes.
- Capture Life’s Best Roads: From scenic routes to unexpected incidents, record every twist and turn with precision.
- Offline Flexibility: Save your videos for offline viewing and relive memories anytime, anywhere.
What's New With M8?
- 4K Resolution: M8 Max offers the 4K resolution for clear and high-quality videos 
-Eco Parking Mode: Now available for both front and rear cameras, offering eco-friendly parking surveillance with reduced power consumption.
- Voice Control: Conveniently control your dashcam with your voice for manual recording, Wi-Fi on/off, and more.
- Improved Gallery: Navigate your recordings more easily with an upgraded gallery system.
- Privacy Mode: Quickly disable the microphone and interior camera for added privacy when needed.
- Timelapse Parking Mode: Capture a condensed view of your parking surveillance with the new Timelapse option.
- Travelapse: Seamlessly create a time-lapse video of your trips for easy sharing.
Simple Connectivity:
1. Activate Wi-Fi on your Momento M8 or M7 to create a secure hotspot.
2. Stay within the Wi-Fi range.
3. Pair your phone to the camera’s network.
4. Launch the Momento Dash Cam Viewer app to access your recordings on the micro-SD card.
Your Privacy, Our Priority: We value your moments. With Momento, your videos NEVER go to the cloud or any online storage. Enjoy local storage on a micro-SD card, meaning zero storage or subscription charges!
Features that Drive You
- Stunning Clarity: Experience up to 4K video resolution for all in-app downloads.
- 3 Channel & Complete Coverage: Capture everything using the front and rear cameras. With the optional interior camera, ensure every angle of your vehicle’s surroundings is covered.
- Eco Parking Mode: Extended, eco-friendly parking surveillance that cuts power consumption by 90%.
- Safety First: Integrated shock sensors activate upon vehicle impact.
- Room for Every Road: Start with 64GB storage and upgrade as your journeys expand.
Having Connectivity Issues? Here’s a quick guide:
1. Activate Airplane Mode.
2. Erase any saved M8 or M7 Wi-Fi Network.
3. Join the Wi-Fi network using the provided password.
Embark on every journey with the Momento Dash Cam Viewer by your side, capturing the tales of every mile. Download now!

- Unlimited devices.

- High-speed servers with high encryption.
- 24/7 customer support via live chat or email.

1. Secure Your Personal Information: Protect credit card information, login credentials and passwords, and secure gaming or streaming accounts with a free VPN.

Premium version Features:
• Ads and Malware Blocking: Protect your device from viruses, cookie tracking, and ads. Premium users can use the app filter to choose which apps connect through the VPN, while others can be set as exceptions.

bluejetty:00135808:ios.description:
Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker is an easy-to-learn, simple and relaxing idle game in which you can decorate and build your own unique planets in different areas of the universe with beautiful objects. Perfect to escape the stressful everyday life for a few minutes or even for a longer time! However, if you want to do more than just relax, Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker lets you expand your strategic thinking and use tactics and flair to compete against other players who also want to get to the top of the real-time leaderboard.
By simply tapping on the planet, you'll collect valuable coins and, bit by bit, increase the attraction to exciting objects flying around in space. If you're really clever, you'll use multiple fingers to collect coins even more effectively, to get the resources you need to build the planet as quickly as possible. However, Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker is not limited to just tapping, but also offers many exciting upgrades, special boosters and a unique prestige system to speed up your progress immeasurably and help you explore all areas of the universe.
● Endless free-to-play idle gameplay
Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker offers endless fun, relaxation and competition. On your way to becoming an absolute gravity enthusiast, you will encounter some surprises that will sweeten your time and may even make you smile as you discover new areas of the universe. 
● Keep collecting endlessly!
You are very busy and have limited time to play? Don't worry, in Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker, you'll keep collecting diligently in your absence, so you can jump back in at any time. The wiser your previous choices for upgrades, boosters and other tools have been up to this point, the more resources your planet will have gathered for you in the meantime, so you can resume building right away at an increased pace.
● Play offline and for free!
Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker can be played completely without an internet connection. Play offline - when and from where you want! 
We regularly deliver cool updates & new content for endless fun in space at home and on the go - online and offline!
Download Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker now for free (free to play) and enrich the universe with your own unique planets!
We at Leek & Ribs Games wish you a lot of fun but also relaxation while playing Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker!
Privacy Policy: https://leekandribs.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Service: https://leekandribs.com/termsofservice

bluejetty:00062308:ios.description:
Imagine Language & Literacy® harnesses the power of technology to teach language and literacy to students around the world through engaging, interactive instruction. This mobile app is a companion to Imagine Learning's cloud-based services which allows students and teachers to have flexible access to the extensive curriculum activities.
Imagine Language & Literacy lessons and activities are designed for Pre-K through 6th grade students. A personalized learning path differentiates instruction and boosts student achievement for English language learners, struggling readers, early childhood students, and students with disabilities. Imagine Language & Literacy includes thousands of fun, interactive, research-based activities, so students have fun while learning! Build a crazy monster while learning the alphabet. Play basketball while learning to spell. Free aliens by identifying the correct letter. Learn to read more than 250 books and articles.
Children encounter activities in four main areas: letters, phonological awareness, reading, and vocabulary. Instruction is offered in a variety of literacy skills including letter recognition, reading comprehension, idiom comprehension, vocabulary development, phonic rules, spelling, rhyming, and phoneme segmentation.
Please note this app will not work without being assigned a site code specific to your school or district.
Please visit http://support.imaginelearning.com for information about System Requirements and Release Notes.

bluejetty:00150272:ios.description:
Help the animals find their pairs!
Tile Connect is a type of abstract strategy game in which players attempt to complete a specific type of connection with their pieces. This could involve forming a path between two or more goals, completing a closed loop, or connecting all of one's pieces so they are adjacent to each other. Connection games typically have simple rules, but complex strategies.
The game may have simple rules, but it's more challenging than you can imagine. It's a fast-paced action puzzle game that puts you to the test. Can you manage to save all the animals before time runs out? In-game instructions with detailed descriptions of rules are included.
Connect 2 Same tile in a path with no more than 3 lines to bring them happily together forever and clear them from the board. To play this game: First, click on an emoji to select it.
Then find another tile of the same type that has a path to the first emoji. If that path has no more than 3 lines, both emojis will disappear from the board. You are challenged to clear as many emojis as possible in the constrain of time.
Tile Connect - Funny, challenging, this is Onet game!
Quickly recognize and Match 2 tile of the same type in a path with no more than 3 turns. 
Have fun of playing Tile Connect!

bluejetty:00038659:ios.description:
Welcome to Guroja! The app that strives to be the best at connecting the world through the tip of your fingers. 
Key Features
- Connect with people all around the world.
- Select filters to connect with a person of your choice.
- Select camera filters to create the mood you want.
- Add users when connected to form friendships.
- Message and video call friends in your lists.
- Use emoticons during connections to create a friendly environment.
- Messages are translated in real time! Language is not a barrier!
Management Policy
- Guroja team has strict policies in regards to users safety and positive experience on the app. Please respect other users and follow guidelines to create a safe and positive community within Guroja. Violations of guidelines and policies will be taken seriously that will result to account suspension. 
Protection of Personal Information
- All users information is securely protected and not sold nor shared to third parties. Guroja does not save any video chats or screenshots. 
- Users should be cautious when sending sensitive information as they are solely responsible for information they provide to other users during connection. Users detailed location is never fully disclosed. 
- Personal information other that what users write directly can not be seen by other users.
Guroja requests the following permissions:
- Camera : Video calls, taking and saving profile picture
- Microphone : Audio for video calls
- Photo Library : Sending and saving photos to friends during chats.
- Location : Required for region based connections.
Additional Information
- If you seek help or have suggestion, please contact us at help@guroja.kr
Private Policy - http://www.guroja.kr/home/privacyPolicy
Terms of Service - http://www.guroja.kr/home/termsOfService

bluejetty:00184556:ios.description:
If you liked the early village building sim games, you will definitely love this village building tycoon simulation game!
In Village City - Island Sim you will expand and build houses for your citizens, decorations and community buildings to make them happy, explore the beach, and create jobs so you can earn money and gold from your happy citizens. If you like to play a free village building game, building a virtual life on Village City - Island Sim is your best choice! Expand your village to make it larger and more challenging.
Discover, be creative and expand your island, town and beach life in a virtual world full of quests where you have the power to build a lot of different structures with a choice of 100+ unique buildings, like hotels, cinema's, offices, bakeries, restaurants, and even oil platforms on your island paradise. Start with a tiny village and grow it into a large metropolis. Catch some fish with your boats, make people happy by building parks, beach huts, schools, churches, libraries, museums, plants, and even a nice ferris wheel. It is all about insight and balance in this village city town game: happy people attract more citizens, who will need residences and jobs. You have all the power in this epic story: discover what is the best way to be a successful entrepreneur in this fabulous virtual world!
** Features **
- Top FREE to play simulation game
- Tablet support
- HIGH QUALITY town graphics
- Translated to 18 languages
- Intuitive gameplay
- Challenge to create your own new virtual paradise
- Unlock and build from a list of 100+ Unique buildings (residential, commercial, farm, community, decoration, park, plants, beach and sea buildings like oil platforms and more)
- Currencies: gold and cash
- Attract citizens with parks, trees, and community buildings
- Build residences for your larger population of citizens
- Collect profit from your commercial buildings
- Upgrade your city buildings
- Collect XP and level up to unlock new buildings for construction
- Collect dozens of REWARDS while playing
- Expand the tiny city on your larger paradise island to create more room for constructing more buildings, and making your tiny city bigger and bigger
- Speed up construction/upgrade time using gold
- Lots of adventure and quests to unlock
- Help your citizens build a city on this exotic island and explore the beach
- Age independent story
- Find pirate chests around your island, containing cash or gold
- Tons of hours of fun
- Play with your friends: enter friend codes and gift codes to receive cash and gold
- The "City Advisor" will provide insight and tell you what is needed in your city

bluejetty:00138402:ios.description:
The Sprocket Sports mobile app is the ultimate youth sports team management solution, allowing parents, players and coaches to keep current with their team. Sprocket Sports makes it easy to see if your game has been moved to a new location, if you practice time has changed and to exchange messages with other parents and coaches no matter where you are!
Parents and Players: the Sprocket Sports app allows you to 1) monitor your team’s schedule and indicate if you can attend, 2) exchange messages with other parents and coaches and 3) view your team’s roster. Get updates instantly when there are changes to an event without having to check your email or your team’s website.
Coaches: use Sprocket Sports to add or update games and practices and view which players will be available. You can also use the app to take attendance and to communicate with your players and their parents.
WHAT IS SPROCKET SPORTS?
Sprocket Sports provides youth sports clubs with advanced software and services that enable registrations, payments, marketing, communications, and administration. In addition to serving as a club's central operating platform, Sprocket also offers professional services that help differentiate and strengthen the club's value proposition and brand, including advertising, video production and photography.

bluejetty:00138612:ios.description:
PCOS isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is your plan. Find your PCOS type in 2 minutes and get meal plans, workouts, and weekly coaching built around your body, from a Registered Dietitian who has PCOS too.
The Cysterhood is the largest community of women with PCOS learning to lose weight and improve their symptoms through the proven PCOS Weight Loss Method, designed by Tallene (Registered Dietitian) and Sirak (PCOS Personal Trainer).
YOUR PCOS PLAN
Weekly meal and workout plans built for your PCOS type, with recipes, grocery lists, and daily habit and progress trackers. We take the thinking out of it.
RECIPES
250+ gluten and dairy free recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and dessert, all designed by Tallene for PCOS weight loss. New recipes drop every month, with vegetarian and carb-tolerance options.
WORKOUTS
A full library of PCOS-friendly workouts designed by Sirak for weight loss, plus monthly workout classes and replays. Do them at home or at the gym.
COACHING
Join Tallene live every week for group coaching. Bring your questions, get real answers from a Registered Dietitian who has PCOS, and stay accountable with women on the same journey. Can't make it live? Watch the replays anytime.
LEARN
Our Masterclass walks you through the 5 Steps to PCOS Weight Loss: find your PCOS type, manage gluten and dairy, discover your carb tolerance, and train for results. Download the workbook and save notes in the app.
COMMUNITY
Join thousands of cysters managing their PCOS together. Ask questions answered directly by Tallene, Sirak, and the community, and share your wins, progress, and meals.
A MESSAGE FROM TALLENE
Hi! I'm Tallene, and I have PCOS too. As a Registered Dietitian, I improved my symptoms, lost the weight, and kept it off. I built The Cysterhood so you can get there faster than I did.

bluejetty:00135305:ios.summary: Invincible: Guarding the Globe is an idle squad RPG set in the Invincible universe featuring a new story never seen in the comics or Amazon Prime TV series, with graphic multi battle action, character collection, team management, idle featu
bluejetty:00135305:ios.description:
Invincible: Guarding the Globe is an idle squad RPG set in the Invincible universe featuring a new story never seen in the comics or Amazon Prime TV series, with graphic multi battle action, character collection, team management, idle features and, of course, super-powered visuals.
THE WORLD OF INVINCIBLE
Accompany the highly rated Amazon Prime Video show with the first Invincible mobile RPG.
Embark on a complete campaign with an original story – a new narrative where you join the Global Defense Agency to unravel the mystery of a deadly clone army (and… stolen burger meat?) working alongside the head of the GDA, Cecil Stedman.
CHARACTER COLLECTION
Recruit a team of iconic characters from the Invincible comics and show. From obvious all-time favorites like Invincible and Atom Eve, to the notorious Flaxans, Mauler Twins and more.
Gain battle experience to level up your team, combining clones to increase their rank and achieve new heights of strength, power, and overall badassery.
SUPER-POWERED ACTION
Assemble your line-up and deploy them into blood-soaked RPG battle action.
Each squad member has a role: Attacker, Defender, or Support. 
It’s up to you to choose the best combo for each encounter. During combat, each member of your team can unleash their own powerful ultimate ability to smash and/or rip the enemy to a pulp and/or shreds and claim victory.
IDLE BATTLE & GDA OPS
Run idle battles in the background while you’re AFK living your everyday life. Even better, accumulate tons of rewards to collect when you’re back!
Get more out of your team, send them on GDA Ops: secondary battle that runs separate from the main storyline, played simultaneously.
ALLIANCES WITH FRIENDS
Team up with friends to deploy a group of heroes co-op. Prepare for social battle together, facing waves of Magmanites, Reanimen and Flaxans popping up, dropping down, or portal-ing themselves in from other dimensions.
GEAR & ARTIFACTS
Always good to have a little extra padding! Send your team into battle fully equipped with four categories of gear: chestwear, legwear, footwear and gloves. 
Add special, unique gear known as artifacts for extra stat bonuses or passive effects. 
Each piece of gear has a rarity level and can be upgraded to enhance its benefit even further.
SHOPS, NOT LOOTBOXES
There’s a mall’s-worth of different stores to check out. Recruit heroes, acquire gear, currencies and more! Pop into Cecil’s Recruitment Department to get new heroes. Or visit Art’s Tailor Shoppe to purchase equipment and other items of interest. 
This is no casino: get what you want in transparent shops without frustrating gacha mechanics or lootbox systems.
MISSIONS & EVENTS 
More action to keep you on your toes - complete daily and weekly goals for huge in-game rewards, with frequent special offers, unique in-game events, and more to come. Each month a new character from the Invincible universe will be revealed and available to recruit for your team.
Visit us on: www.ubisoft.com/invincible
Like on Facebook: www.facebook.com/InvincibleGtG
Follow on X: @InvincibleGtG
Join us on Instagram: @InvincibleGtG
Need support? Contact us here: https://support.ubi.com
Privacy Policy: https://legal.ubi.com/privacypolicy/
Terms of Use: https://legal.ubi.com/termsofuse/

bluejetty:00125909:ios.description:
AirFinder – Find Lost Bluetooth Devices
Lost your AirPods, headphones, or smartwatch? AirFinder helps you quickly find nearby Bluetooth devices using a simple signal radar and real-time detection.
Just scan for devices, follow the signal strength, and move closer to your lost item. AirFinder works with many Bluetooth devices including AirPods, Beats, Bose, JBL, Sony headphones, Apple Watch, Fitbit trackers, phones, tablets, and speakers.
How It Works
1. Open AirFinder and scan nearby Bluetooth devices
2. Select the device you want to find
3. Follow the signal radar while moving slowly
4. As the signal gets stronger, you're getting closer. When the signal reaches 90+ strength and under 0.5m, your device should be nearby.
Tip: Make sure the device is powered on and Bluetooth is enabled while searching.
Key Features
- Bluetooth Device Finder: Scan and detect nearby Bluetooth devices such as earbuds, headphones, smartwatches, phones, tablets, and speakers.
- Find Apple Devices: Locate AirPods, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch when Bluetooth is active.
- Signal Radar: Follow the signal strength to move closer to your device.
- Map Tracker: View the last known location and detection time.
- Play Sound: Trigger sound on supported devices to help locate them faster.
- Favorites: Save devices for quicker access when scanning.
Premium Access
Upgrade to AirFinder Premium for:
- Unlimited Bluetooth scans
- Map tracking history
- Ad-free experience
- Priority support
Subscription Options:
1 Week: $3.99 | 1 Month: $9.99 | Lifetime: $29.99
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Privacy
AirFinder only scans Bluetooth signals locally on your device. We do not collect or share personal data.
Disclaimer
AirFinder is not affiliated with Apple Inc. or any mentioned companies. All trademarks (including AirPods) belong to their respective owners.
Terms of Use: https://smartwidgetlabs.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://smartwidgetlabs.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00166817:ios.description:
Welcome to DramaBite – Hot Short Drama Hub in the U.S.!
DramaBite is your ultimate destination for immersive short drama experiences, designed to ensure everyone finds their perfect series. Whether you’re a fan of gripping tales or lighthearted stories, DramaBite has something for everyone!
Explore a vast world of diverse short dramas, including genres like millionaire fantasies, revenge sagas, heartfelt romances, and touching family stories. Love binge-watching? You’ll never run out of favorites here.
Worried about choosing from our extensive collection? Don’t worry, our "For You" Recommendation System is here to help, offering tailored drama picks based on your unique taste, anytime and anywhere.
Why Choose DramaBite?
1. Diverse Drama Genres: Whether you’re in the mood for thrilling revenge plots, sweet romances, or heartwarming family dramas, DramaBite has an expansive selection to suit every taste. With genres ranging from fantasy to suspense, you’ll always find something to match your mood.
2. "For You" Recommendation System: Our smart recommendation system is designed to make finding your next favorite drama effortless. By learning from your viewing history and preferences, it suggests shows that align with your unique taste, ensuring you spend less time browsing and more time watching what you love.
3. Seamless Viewing Experience: Enjoy an uninterrupted, smooth streaming experience with zero buffering. Watch your favorite dramas with fast loading times and high-quality streaming, ensuring every scene looks its best, no matter where you are.
4. Language-Specific Subtitles: Stay fully immersed in the story with accurate subtitles in multiple languages, allowing you to follow along effortlessly. Whether you're watching a drama in English or another language, we make sure nothing gets lost in translation.
5. High-Definition Video Quality: DramaBite provides high-definition video streaming, offering a sharp and visually stunning viewing experience. Every detail of your favorite short dramas is brought to life with crystal-clear quality, elevating your drama-watching experience.
6. Global Drama Collection: Dive into a collection of top-rated dramas from around the world. Whether you’re in the mood for a British crime thriller, a romantic K-drama, or a suspenseful European mini-series, DramaBite brings the best global content to your screen, all in one app.
7. Constant Exploration and Growth: DramaBite is always expanding and improving. We’re committed to bringing you fresh, exciting, and innovative content, keeping you up-to-date with the latest trends and keeping your drama journey exciting and new.
Download DramaBite now and dive into the hottest platform for short dramas, where an endless world of captivating stories is waiting just for you!
Dramabite Auto-Renewable Subscription:
1.Subscription service: Dramabite Weekly Subscription (7 days); Monthly Subscription (1 month); Annual Subscription (12 months). All are auto-renewable.
2.Subscription price: Based on IAP application information, e.g., Annual subscription $199.99.
3.Payment: Subscriptions are managed by the user. After confirmation of purchase and payment, the amount will be charged to the iTunes account.
4.Renewal: The Apple iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours before expiration. Once charged, the subscription will be extended for another period.
5.Canceling renewal: To cancel the subscription, open "Settings" on your Apple device → go to "iTunes Store & App Store" → tap "Apple ID" → select "View Apple ID" → go to "Account Settings" → tap "Subscriptions" → select "Dramabite" to cancel the subscription. If the subscription is not canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period, it will renew automatically.

 EXPLORE AND CONQUER ANCIENT CIVILIZATIONS

 - Experience real-time strategy with millions of players worldwide

 - MMO RTS gameplay with deep strategic mechanics
 - Build your village into a thriving empire

 - Train powerful armies and lead them to victory
 - Conquer enemy territories
 - Expansive world map with endless tactical possibilities
 - Limited game rounds - outsmart your opponents to claim the win
 Are you ready to forge your empire, lead legendary warriors, and claim ultimate victory?
 Download Travian: Legends now and become a legendary conqueror!

bluejetty:00135024:ios.name: First Iraqi Bank
bluejetty:00135024:ios.summary:
First Iraqi Bank is Iraq’s first-ever completely mobile bank. 
First Iraqi Bank’s completely digital onboarding process is fully compliant with KYC (Know Your Customer) guidelines and legal requirements. You can open a bank account in unde
bluejetty:00135024:ios.description:
First Iraqi Bank is Iraq’s first-ever completely mobile bank. 
First Iraqi Bank’s completely digital onboarding process is fully compliant with KYC (Know Your Customer) guidelines and legal requirements. You can open a bank account in under 5 minutes and enjoy a wide range of services provided by the app. All you need is your ID card or a Passport. You can get onboarded even faster if you are a KRG (Kurdish Regional Government) employee. First Iraqi Bank app features include: 
-Deposit. Quickly and conveniently deposit your cash using a wide network of merchants all around Iraq. You can do this by simply showing your unique QR code to the merchant. The balance will be updated instantaneously.
-Withdrawal. Quickly and conveniently withdraw cash using a wide network of merchants all around Iraq. You can do this by simply scanning a QR code provided by the merchant. Your balance will be updated instantaneously.
-QuickPay. Pay for goods and services by simply scanning the QR code generated by the merchants. It will only take seconds!
-Money conversion. Do you want to store and spend your money in different currencies? With First Iraqi Bank you can easily convert your money between IQD, USD, and EUR.
-Money transfers. Perform Peer-to-Peer money transfers to other First Iraq Bank account holders. They will get the money within seconds! First Iraqi Bank also allows you to make local and international transfers to other banks.
-Balance and transactions. Never lose track of your finances! You can always view the details of your transactions and see the history of changes in your balance.
-Service Store. With First Iraqi Bank you can quickly purchase vouchers and gift cards from more than 100 different providers (e.g., Careem, Netflix, etc.) using your current balance. They will appear in the app’s wallet after the purchase, from where you can also share them with your friends and family.
-Money boxes. Saving up for a new car or even a house? Take advantage of our money boxes feature! It allows you to save your money in separate spaces away from your main balance.
-Find branches and stores. Quickly find our nearest branch office of First Iraqi Bank, where we will be happy to serve you. Looking for the nearest merchant to make a deposit or withdrawal? You can conveniently find them on the map.
-Spending limit. Take control of your monthly spending by setting a spending limit. If your next transaction goes over the limit you will be notified.
-Cash delivery. Don’t have a possibility to reach our network of merchants to deposit or withdraw money? Don’t worry, we have your back! First Iraqi Bank app allows you to track, and schedule cash withdrawal deliveries and cash deposit collections.

bluejetty:00013888:ios.description:
The BT Panorama mobile app provides advisers, practice professionals, and investors with easy access to their accounts via mobile.
Signing in to the app is fast and secure with Face ID, 4-digit passcode or fingerprint technology², or you can use your Panorama username and password.
For BT Panorama advisers and practice professionals:
The mobile app lets you take your business with you, with features including:
· View a summary of your total funds under administration, active accounts, net flows and fees from the business overview dashboard
· Search client accounts, and view what your clients view including total portfolio balance and performance details 
· Drill down into market information for shares and managed funds in your clients’ portfolios, for a quick snapshot of the latest prices, asset performance, ESG and key information
· Buy, sell and track orders for term deposits, managed funds, managed portfolios and listed securities (where applicable)
· View your clients' cash account summaries and make payments to existing accounts on their behalf, where authorised
· View messages, consent and service request status, updates, product news and alert notifications
· Ask Blue, BT’s virtual assistant or chat to a consultant
For BT Panorama investors:
Use the mobile app to access your account on the go, with features including:
· View your total portfolio balance and performance by investment, which can include any term deposit, listed security, managed fund and managed portfolio investments
· Drill down into market information for shares and managed funds in your portfolio for a quick snapshot of the latest prices, asset performance, ESG and key information
· Make payments, deposits and schedule transactions, and add linked, payee and BPAY®³ accounts
· Trade all investment types and track the progress of investment orders, where authorised
· Apply filters to view transaction history and details
· View and update personal details, where authorised 
· View important notices, messages, forms and requests, consent requests and alerts, and access the Benefits Now portal
· Review and download your statements, reports and disclosure documents
· Ask Blue, BT’s virtual assistant or chat to a consultant
For BT super members:
BT Super merged into the Mercer Super Trust on 1 April 2023. 
If you have any queries, contact Mercer Super on 1800 682 525 Mon to Fri 8am – 7pm (AEST) or https://www.mercersuper.com.au/contact-mercer-super/
This app is only available for BT Panorama advisers and BT Panorama investors. For more information:
Advisers – call 1300 784 207
Investors – call 1300 881 716
Important:
¹ You must be an investor in Australia resident to use this app.
² Your phone must be able to support this technology.
Requires iOS 14 or greater.
Westpac Banking Corporation ABN 33 007 457 141 provides the facility for making payments by BPAY®³ and Pay Anyone (excluding payments to linked accounts). Refer to the BT Cash Management Account and BT Cash Management Account Saver and related Payment Services Terms and Conditions, for the terms and conditions applying to this facility.
By installing the application, and each time you use the application, you acknowledge and accept the BT Panorama Mobile Application Terms and Conditions, and any amendments to them made available electronically through the BT Panorama Mobile Application.

bluejetty:00128383:ios.description:
An Official US Navy mobile service, produced by the Navy’s PMW 240 Program
The U.S. Navy App Locker mobile app and accompanying website are your trusted source for information and download links to mobile apps developed by the U.S. Navy.
Prior to the Navy App Locker, there was no single way to view all mobile applications developed by the U.S. Navy. The Navy App Locker solves this problem, allowing Sailors to view all details and information about Navy apps, while also providing direct download links to commercial app stores. The Navy App Locker interacts seamlessly with Sailors’ personal devices and does not require CAC authentication. 
The Navy App Locker is also a great place to find apps that offer training on a variety of topics. Many of these apps allow Sailors to submit Navy Training Management and Planning System (NTMPS) course completion credits to their Electronic Training Jacket (ETJ). 
Features of the Navy App Locker:
» Provides users with textual descriptions, screenshots and related links for each app
» Provides direct links to Navy-developed apps in commercial app stores
» Viewable on smartphones, tablets, laptops and desktops
» Offers a search function to locate applications
» Capable of filtering through Navy apps by category
» Allows users to suggest new Navy apps and provide feedback
The Navy App Locker serves as your one-stop shop for all U.S. Navy mobile applications. Download the app today or visit the website at https://www.applocker.navy.mil!

bluejetty:00093022:ios.description:
Transform your fitness into an epic adventure. Sport Is My Game turns bodyweight training and calisthenics into an RPG where your real-world effort levels up your character.
Fitness progress is often slow and invisible—that's why most people quit. Sport Is My Game makes every rep count. Your body has real stats: strength, endurance, balance, and mobility. Every push-up, pull-up, and squat increases your abilities on screen and in real life. Unlock real skills and turn "I can't do that" into "I just did."
Train Like It's a Game:
• Level Up Your Stats: Every workout develops your attributes—strength, endurance, coordination, and mobility. Watch your character grow alongside your real fitness.
• Skill Trees: Master calisthenics through clear, visual progression trees. Always know your next step, from beginner variations to elite mastery.
• Dungeons & Quests: Conquer guided progressive routines to unlock iconic skills like the Pull-Up, Pistol Squat, or Muscle-Up. Daily and weekly quests keep your streak alive.
• Exercise Mastery: Take individual movements from beginner forms to complete mastery with dedicated form milestones.
• Leaderboards & Trophies: Earn rare achievements for milestones and compete with friends worldwide.
Structured Calisthenics Skill Trees:
• Push: Progression from knee push-ups to dips and handstand push-ups.
• Pull: Build a strong back with Australian rows, pull-ups, and front levers.
• Core: Develop bulletproof abs with planks, L-sits, and dragon flags.
• Legs: Build powerful legs at home with squats, lunges, and pistol squats.
• Skills: Dedicated balance and control progressions for handstands and levers.
Smart, Adaptive Training:
Built-in progressive overload adjusts to your current performance. Workouts adapt automatically to push your limits without burnout, delivering consistent strength gains and muscle growth.
Key Features:
• 200+ Achievements to unlock across your fitness journey
• Visual Skill Trees mapping your entire calisthenics path
• Smart adaptive workouts for all fitness levels (beginner to advanced)
• 100% Offline training—work out anywhere, anytime
• Ad-free and distraction-free experience
What Athletes Are Saying:
"This is what made working out finally stick." – Vincenzo P.
"The best calisthenics app. The progress map and RPG mechanics are genius." – Beps1990
"It gives me the exact motivation I need to train consistently." – Valestia
Sport Is My Game is free to download. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited dungeon battles, complete workout history, and advanced RPG features with a free trial.
Ready to build real bodyweight strength? Start your journey today.
