bluejetty:00062596:ios.description:
Preschool Learning Games Kids: fun learning game for kindergarten and preschool kids.Kick start your child's education with 25+ interactive learning games designed to develop fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Let them learn while they play!
Give your toddlers the gift of education with our fun-filled interactive app, "Preschool Learning Games". Specially designed for kids aged between 2 to 6 years, our app makes learning fun and easy, focusing on the development of fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and comprehensive understanding of Alphabets, Numbers, Colors, and Shapes. 
With more than 25 interactive games, we offer an early and exciting kick-start to your child's education. Our games are beautifully designed with colorful and engaging cartoon characters, compelling sound effects, and captivating animations. These features are thoughtfully put together to grasp and keep your child's attention.
The Preschool Learning Games app enhances learning through play. We integrate alphabets, numbers, colors, and other essential preschool elements into our games, making learning an enjoyable process for your toddlers. Our visual learning games and activities significantly contribute to developing your child's motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Our user-friendly interface and intuitive touch controls are perfect for little fingers, making navigation simple for Pre-K and kindergarten kids. The best part is that every game concludes with a reward system; kids get a chance to win stickers, fostering a sense of achievement and motivation in them. 
We also offer a unique feature, "Quiz Time," which tests your little one's progress through an enjoyable and engaging way, providing an overall review of the games played.
Our Games & Activities Include:
1. "Fill The Colors" game with 80+ coloring pages, nurturing creativity.
2. "Space Gnomes" aids alphabet and number recognition.
3. "Match The Shadows" strengthens visual learning through shadow and shape matching.
4. "Tricky Maze" keeps children engaged while reinforcing alphabets.
5. "Learn To Trace" allows practice of alphabets and numbers by tracing.
6. "Make Your Own Car" introduces different shapes as kids construct a car.
7. "Hide and Seek" boosts memory as your child locates our friendly monkeys and elves.
8. "Music Time" introduces a variety of rhymes and musical instruments like drums, piano, xylophone, and various animal sounds.
9. "Scratch to Reveal" lets kids reveal hidden characters using finger movements.
Each of our games promotes the kinesthetic development of toddlers and pre-k children. We believe that educational games should engage children and provide rewards to boost their spirits. 
Our app guarantees a delightful learning experience filled with colorful pictures, enchanting sound effects, and captivating animation. Young children will love every activity this app offers, learning and playing simultaneously through various fun activities.
Parents and teachers seeking interactive learning games for children will find our app highly beneficial. Download Preschool Learning Games for kids, and turn screen time into valuable learning time for your child!

Preschool Learning Games Kids: fun learning game for kindergarten and preschool kids.Kick start your child's education with 25+ interactive learning games designed to develop fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Let them learn while they play!

Give your toddlers the gift of education with our fun-filled interactive app, "Preschool Learning Games". Specially designed for kids aged between 2 to 6 years, our app makes learning fun and easy, focusing on the development of fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and comprehensive understanding of Alphabets, Numbers, Colors, and Shapes. 

With more than 25 interactive games, we offer an early and exciting kick-start to your child's education. Our games are beautifully designed with colorful and engaging cartoon characters, compelling sound effects, and captivating animations. These features are thoughtfully put together to grasp and keep your child's attention.

The Preschool Learning Games app enhances learning through play. We integrate alphabets, numbers, colors, and other essential preschool elements into our games, making learning an enjoyable process for your toddlers. Our visual learning games and activities significantly contribute to developing your child's motor skills and hand-eye coordination.

Our user-friendly interface and intuitive touch controls are perfect for little fingers, making navigation simple for Pre-K and kindergarten kids. The best part is that every game concludes with a reward system; kids get a chance to win stickers, fostering a sense of achievement and motivation in them. 

We also offer a unique feature, "Quiz Time," which tests your little one's progress through an enjoyable and engaging way, providing an overall review of the games played.

Our Games & Activities Include:
1. "Fill The Colors" game with 80+ coloring pages, nurturing creativity.
2. "Space Gnomes" aids alphabet and number recognition.
3. "Match The Shadows" strengthens visual learning through shadow and shape matching.
4. "Tricky Maze" keeps children engaged while reinforcing alphabets.
5. "Learn To Trace" allows practice of alphabets and numbers by tracing.
6. "Make Your Own Car" introduces different shapes as kids construct a car.
7. "Hide and Seek" boosts memory as your child locates our friendly monkeys and elves.
8. "Music Time" introduces a variety of rhymes and musical instruments like drums, piano, xylophone, and various animal sounds.
9. "Scratch to Reveal" lets kids reveal hidden characters using finger movements.

Each of our games promotes the kinesthetic development of toddlers and pre-k children. We believe that educational games should engage children and provide rewards to boost their spirits. 

Our app guarantees a delightful learning experience filled with colorful pictures, enchanting sound effects, and captivating animation. Young children will love every activity this app offers, learning and playing simultaneously through various fun activities.

Parents and teachers seeking interactive learning games for children will find our app highly beneficial. Download Preschool Learning Games for kids, and turn screen time into valuable learning time for your child!

bluejetty:00153668:ios.summary:
Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG.
Enjoy creating decks and battling online, just like the original Shadowverse CCG.
With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse P
bluejetty:00153668:ios.description:
Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG.
Enjoy creating decks and battling online, just like the original Shadowverse CCG.
With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.
Card Battles
The rules of Shadowverse are simple, yet offer limitless ways to strategize and win.
Use different card combinations to create unique synergies and strategies in battles against players all around the world.
Dive into the game and enjoy strategic card battles with breathtaking graphics and effects.
New Game Mechanic: Super-Evolution
Each of your followers (unit cards you play on the field) can now super-evolve!
Followers that have super-evolved are stronger and can knock opposing followers out with powerful attacks and deal damage straight to their leader! 
Super-evolve your followers and enjoy exhilarating card battles like never before!
Free Card Pack Every Day
Log in to open a free card pack every day!
Collect cards for the new compendium feature!
Enjoy battling and collecting!
Class
Choose from 7 unique classes that match your playstyle and create custom decks.
Tailor your deck to match your strategy and style, then dive into epic card battles!
Story
Experience a brand new Shadowverse story where characters are brought to life with full voice acting!
Follow spectacular stories centered around seven unique characters, each bringing their own personality to the adventure.
New Feature: Shadowverse Park
Step into the Shadowverse CCG community where players can connect and interact!
Show off your avatar with customizable outfits and emotes, bond with others, and grow stronger together!
Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is recommended to the following:
- Fans of card games and collecting cards
- Players who like collectible card games (CCG) or trading card games (TCG)
- Long-time fans and players of the Shadowverse CCG
- Players who enjoy PvP card games
- People who have played other TCG and CCG before
- Players who are looking for new TCG and CCG
- Fans of strategic trading card games (TCG) and collectible card games (CCG)
- Players who are looking for card games with compelling full-scale stories
- Card collectors who appreciate beautifully designed collectible or trading cards
- People who want to connect and interact with others through gaming

Glintr helps LGBTQ+ individuals discover nearby venues, connect with the community, and build meaningful local relationships in a safe and welcoming environment.
KEY FEATURES

• Interactive radar scanner to explore LGBTQ+ bars and venues nearby
• Integrated map view showing the closest 5 locations
• Real-time GPS-based location services
• Detailed venue information including hours, photos, and contact details
• One-tap navigation and calling
COMMUNITY CHATS
• Join venue-specific group chats and meet people at your favorite spots
• Create event-based chats to organize meetups
• Private one-on-one messaging with text, emoji, and photo support
• Safe communication with built-in reporting and blocking features
EVENTS & MEETUPS
• Create and join local LGBTQ+ events
• See who's attending before you go
• Automatic event group chats for coordination
• Build your local network organically
PERSONALIZED PROFILE
• Customize your profile with photos, bio, and interests
• Follow users and build your community network
• Manage your privacy with blocking and reporting tools
• Express yourself authentically
BUILT FOR THE COMMUNITY
Glintr is designed specifically for the LGBTQ+ community, providing a safe and inclusive space to:
• Explore local LGBTQ+-friendly venues
• Connect with like-minded individuals
• Build lasting friendships and relationships
• Feel a sense of belonging in your local area
SAFE & SECURE
• Report and block features for community safety
• Privacy-focused design with local data storage
• Secure authentication and data protection
• Community-driven safety standards
Whether you're new to the area, looking to expand your social circle, or simply want to explore local LGBTQ+ spaces, Glintr helps you build the local ties that matter.
Download Glintr today and start building your community connections!

bluejetty:00177253:ios.name: Soro - For Sonos
bluejetty:00177253:ios.summary: Soro provides modern, intuitive user interface to control your speakers, extends your iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Siri AI, Control Center and Home Screen widgets, Live Activities and 30+ powerful Shortcuts actions. Soro lets you create both
bluejetty:00177253:ios.description:
Soro provides modern, intuitive user interface to control your speakers, extends your iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Siri AI, Control Center and Home Screen widgets, Live Activities and 30+ powerful Shortcuts actions. Soro lets you create both quick actions or extensive workflows to control your speakers with the Shortcuts app using widgets, Siri voice commands or automations. 
▶ Browse Your Music
* Support for Music Services that you already added in the Sonos app
* Browse your Sonos Music Library
* Extended Apple Music Integration:
 * Add tracks, albums to your Apple Music playlists or favourites (in-app and via Shortcuts action)
 * Play artist stations
 * See additional details of albums and artists, such as related items and notes
▶ Shortcuts & Automations
* 30+ actions to control your speakers and automate the settings in the Shortcuts app
* Build quick actions or extensive automations or integrate with other third-party apps
* Start creating shortcuts in the Shortcuts app or use one the of examples included in Soro as a starting point
* Use the actions to 
- Play music from any of your music services, favorites, playlist, 
- Broadcast a message
- See what's playing
- Change volume, adjust the EQ, home theatre settings such as speech enhancement and night mode, subwoofer and surround options
- Manage the music queue
- Select input
- Control playback
- Manage speaker grouping
- Load sound preset
- Control you alarms
▶ Search
* Efficiently search and filter across your Sonos Favorites, Sonos Playlists, Sonos Music Library, and connected music services
* Search directly from Siri AI: “Find the album Get Mean by Boy Harsher in Soro”
▶ Home Screen Widgets
* Now Playing: View current Sonos playback details, pick/configure rooms, adjust volume, play/pause, skip
* Quick Access: Jump into search, open queue/EQ/grouping or music services
* Collections: Quick access to items in your favourite collections
▶ Lock Screen Control and Dynamic Island
* Soro is now integrated with the system media controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center to allow better integration with system features such using the hardware buttons for volume control.
▶ Control Center Widgets
* Quickly change your speaker settings or instantly open the app to a specific view from the Control Center.
* All available speaker settings, such as volume, EQ parameters, etc. can be adjusted by adding and configuring an instance of the Sonos Settings widget
▶ Siri Al
* On iOS 27, ask Siri to play music with Soro, check what's playing on your speakers or learn more about what's on screen in Soro.
* Ask Siri what's playing in Soro or on Sonos: “What's playing in Soro?”
* Use Siri AI's conversational answers and broad world knowledge for open-ended music discovery, then ask to play it in Soro.
* Use Siri's onscreen awareness to play or find music you are looking at in other apps or Siri mode in the camera app.
* When in Soro, you can ask Siri for more details of the music you are looking at, either on the Now Playing screen or when browsing and looking at an album or artist.
* Siri can also run the custom Shortcuts you built with the various Soro actions in the Shortcuts app. You can fine tune the logic you want to execute and tell the name of Shortcut to Siri to run it.
▶ Spotlight
* Search for a room by its name in Spotlight to find and control it from outside of Soro.
* Change volume, group or remove rooms from anywhere.
▶ Share Sheet
* Start playing music directly from supported apps (Apple Music, Spotify and Bandcamp) by using the share sheet.
▶ Modern Interface
* Modern design with that feels at home on iOS and iPadOS 
▶ Accessibility
* Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support
* Speak Text supported on Sonos One, Amp, Port, Play:5 (Gen 2), Beam, One SL, Move, SYMFONISK (table lamp & bookshelf), and all newer Sonos S2 speakers. 
Soro is not affiliated with Sonos Inc. nor is it an official Sonos app. Sonos is trademarked by Sonos Inc.

bluejetty:00034867:ios.name: Climb Knight
bluejetty:00034867:ios.summary:
Step into a retro arcade adventure with Climb Knight! Every floor you conquer brings you closer to the top of the global leaderboards. Can you out-climb the competition and reach the "top"?
With LCD-style graphics and super simple 1-button
bluejetty:00034867:ios.description:
Step into a retro arcade adventure with Climb Knight! Every floor you conquer brings you closer to the top of the global leaderboards. Can you out-climb the competition and reach the "top"?
With LCD-style graphics and super simple 1-button controls, Climb Knight is easy to pick up but fun to master. Just avoid traps, scale ropes, and see how many floors you can clear. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or those moments when you just need one more try after a close call!
Featuring a 1-bit minimalist aesthetic inspired by classic handheld LCD games, vintage brick game consoles, calculator games, old keypad phones, and the timeless charm of palm computers and early portable gaming devices, Climb Knight blends that nostalgic pixel art charm with the fun challenge of a true high-score chaser.
Why you’ll love it:
Global leaderboards: The higher you climb, and the more levels you conquer, the better your high score. How high can you go?
Haptic feedback: Feel every moment! Satisfying haptic feedback makes every collectible pulse in your hands, while traps and monsters deliver an extra punch when they catch you.
Unlockable characters: Collect and play with multiple pixel art characters as you progress.
Retro feel: Inspired by the 80s arcade era, with LCD game pixel graphics and chiptune music to match.
Challenge friends: Share your high score and challenge your friends to beat it.
Changing environments: The layout, traps, and reality itself shift slightly after each game, making every run feel familiar, yet strangely different.
Test your reflexes: Improve your skills and reaction time with every playthrough.
Fun is infinite: The fun never stops as you climb higher and higher in an 80s-style arcade game with a modern twist.
Mr. Advisor: A mysterious entity now answers your questions. But beware—knowledge always comes at a price.
Tarsier Tales: Meet the tarsiers, learn their story, and learn about protecting their home through ten exciting platforming levels!
Three Unlockable Mini-Games: Earn your right to play them; they do not reveal themselves easily:
1. Run Knight – Run and jump over obstacles in this endless test of reflexes.
2. Floppy Bat – Guide a fragile bat through a gauntlet of deadly spikes. Precision is survival.
3. Squirmy Worm – A slithering creature moves forward, unable to turn back. Just like you. Can you survive the traps ahead?
If you're a retro gaming fan or looking for a quick one-more-try challenge, Climb Knight is packed with endless fun, designed to keep you coming back for more. Ready to test your reflexes and reach new heights? Play Climb Knight today!

With LCD-style graphics and super simple 1-button controls, Climb Knight is easy to pick up but fun to master. Just avoid traps, scale ropes, and see how many floors you can clear. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or those moments when you just need one more try after a close call!

Featuring a 1-bit minimalist aesthetic inspired by classic handheld LCD games, vintage brick game consoles, calculator games, old keypad phones, and the timeless charm of palm computers and early portable gaming devices, Climb Knight blends that nostalgic pixel art charm with the fun challenge of a true high-score chaser.

Why you’ll love it:

Global leaderboards: The higher you climb, and the more levels you conquer, the better your high score. How high can you go?
Haptic feedback: Feel every moment! Satisfying haptic feedback makes every collectible pulse in your hands, while traps and monsters deliver an extra punch when they catch you.
Unlockable characters: Collect and play with multiple pixel art characters as you progress.
Retro feel: Inspired by the 80s arcade era, with LCD game pixel graphics and chiptune music to match.
Challenge friends: Share your high score and challenge your friends to beat it.
Changing environments: The layout, traps, and reality itself shift slightly after each game, making every run feel familiar, yet strangely different.
Test your reflexes: Improve your skills and reaction time with every playthrough.
Fun is infinite: The fun never stops as you climb higher and higher in an 80s-style arcade game with a modern twist.
Mr. Advisor: A mysterious entity now answers your questions. But beware—knowledge always comes at a price.
Tarsier Tales: Meet the tarsiers, learn their story, and learn about protecting their home through ten exciting platforming levels!
Three Unlockable Mini-Games: Earn your right to play them; they do not reveal themselves easily:
1. Run Knight – Run and jump over obstacles in this endless test of reflexes.
2. Floppy Bat – Guide a fragile bat through a gauntlet of deadly spikes. Precision is survival.
3. Squirmy Worm – A slithering creature moves forward, unable to turn back. Just like you. Can you survive the traps ahead?

If you're a retro gaming fan or looking for a quick one-more-try challenge, Climb Knight is packed with endless fun, designed to keep you coming back for more. Ready to test your reflexes and reach new heights? Play Climb Knight today!

bluejetty:00141621:ios.name: Music Visualizer - Vibely
bluejetty:00141621:ios.summary:
@dmsongs5 built 711K followers and 31.9M TikTok likes posting music videos made entirely with Vibely.
Vibely turns your music into scroll-stopping videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Spotify Canvas - in minutes, not hou
bluejetty:00141621:ios.description:
@dmsongs5 built 711K followers and 31.9M TikTok likes posting music videos made entirely with Vibely.
Vibely turns your music into scroll-stopping videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Spotify Canvas - in minutes, not hours. On iPhone, iPad and now natively on Mac.
WHAT YOU CAN CREATE:
- Animated music videos for TikTok, Shorts and Reels
- Spotify Canvas loops from your album artwork
- Waveform and audio spectrum clips for podcasts
- Lyric videos with custom text and backgrounds
- YouTube intros and music promo content
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Import any track - from Files, shared straight from another app, or extracted from a video.
2. Start from one of 48 ready-made templates, or build from scratch.
3. Stack layers: 11 reactive visualizers - audio spectrum, waveform, particles, particle ring, plasma, thunder, vortex, nebula, night sky, silk and synthwave sun - plus text, images, video, glass cards, vinyl disks, badges, progress bars and solid colors. Particles alone covers dust, starfields, snow, hearts, blossoms and numbers.
4. Add any of 36 effects, in five categories, and make each one react to the beat: glow, outline, drop shadow, vignette, god rays, star rays, ripples, twirl, liquify, melt, tiny planet, kaleidoscope, mirror, duotone, hue cycle, color cycle, strobe, invert, grayscale, adjust, VHS, TV static, glitch, pixel, blur, shake, dim, barrel, fisheye, flip, opacity and more.
5. Give every layer a blend mode and a place in depth, and the background video the same placement and effects as any layer.
6. Export in SD, HD, QHD or 4K, at up to 60fps.
7. Share directly to any platform.
BUILT TO BE FAST:
Vibely renders entirely on the GPU with Metal, so previews stay smooth while you work and exports finish in a fraction of the time. Undo and redo cover every edit, and your project saves itself as you go. Name any layer and its timeline bar says what it is. Every export keeps the song's title, artist and artwork, and is named after the project.
THE SONG IS PART OF THE TIMELINE:
The song sits as the timeline's first row, drawn as its own waveform. Trim it on that waveform, fade it in and out, and see every layer line up against it. A full-screen preview plays the result with nothing else on screen.
EVERYWHERE YOU WORK:
The editor is the same on iPhone, iPad and Mac. On a Mac and a wide iPad the panels sit in a column beside the canvas; on iPhone they are a sheet. VoiceOver reads and edits the timeline, layer by layer.
WHAT CREATORS SAY:
- "5 minutes with Vibely vs 3 hours anywhere else."
- "All the music trends on TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram you can do here, very very easy."
- "The editing ability in this app is really high end."
- "100% the best on the App Store."
- "Best app I've used to make my videos on YouTube."
- "You could possibly go very viral with it."
- "Never have I ever become so quickly satisfied with a product. Exactly does the job, with lots of fine tuning options."
BUILT FOR:
- Music producers & independent artists promoting new releases
- Content creators making TikTok, Reels & Shorts
- Podcasters creating waveform preview clips
- Artists animating album art for Spotify Canvas
Available in 10 languages. Your next viral video starts here.
~~~
Terms of Service: https://tryvibely.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tryvibely.app/privacy

bluejetty:00168858:ios.description:
Welcome to eddii, your all-in-one diabetes & endocrine care companion.
eddii provides access to real clinical care, supported by connected health data and personalized insights — all in one place.
Whether you’re living with Type 1 diabetes, Type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, thyroid conditions, or PCOS, eddii connects you to the clinical care you need while supporting your day-to-day management.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH EDDII
* Book virtual visits with licensed endocrinologists
* Message your care team, manage prescriptions, and order labs
* Connect your Dexcom or Freestyle Libre CGM to view glucose trends and insights
* Track insulin, meals, activity, symptoms, and glucose in one place
* View glucose patterns and health insights to better understand your body
* Stay consistent with daily check-ins, challenges, and guided support
* Receive weekly summaries and progress insights
* Invite caregivers or family members to stay involved in your care
DESIGNED FOR REAL CLINICAL CARE
eddii is built around access to real clinical care — with connected health data and personalized insights to support every decision.
By combining clinical care and your health data, eddii supports you between appointments — not just during them.
VIRTUAL ENDOCRINE CARE, WHEN YOU NEED IT
Access licensed endocrinologists through eddii Care:
* Get guidance on treatment and medication
* Manage prescriptions and lab work
* Receive care tailored to your condition
* Appointments may be covered by insurance in many states or available via self-pay.
BUILT FOR ONGOING SUPPORT
Managing a chronic condition isn’t just about numbers alone. eddii helps you stay engaged with tools designed to support long-term habits, motivation, and consistency.
Perfect for:
* Type 1 diabetes
* Type 2 diabetes
* Prediabetes
*Thyroid conditions
* PCOS
* Other endocrine conditions
Download eddii today and take a more supported, connected approach to your health.
Terms of Use: https://www.eddiihealth.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.eddiihealth.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00090465:ios.description:
eFly is the GCC’s first smart electric vehicle-sharing application.
We are introducing affordable, carbon-free 5G micro-mobility across the GCC region.
HOW IT WORKS
Download the app
Register and recharge your wallet
Find the nearest eFly vehicle
Unlock and eFly!
AFFORDABLE
Enjoy highly affordable rates that fit your budget. You can even get free rides when you refer your friends — let’s eFly!
GET FREE RIDES
Tell your friends about eFly and both of you can earn a free ride. Download the app, register or log in, then share your unique referral URL with your friends to start earning free rides.
SAFETY
Get from point A to B safely and in style. Your safety and the safety of pedestrians are our priority.
Stay alert and avoid distractions while riding. Always wear a helmet, and make sure to park your vehicle away from walkways, driveways, and access ramps.
Stay within the allowed green zones. If you leave the permitted area, your vehicle may automatically lock and stop working. Simply return to the green zone to unlock it again.
ECO-FRIENDLY
We help improve air quality by getting you where you need to go without relying on gas-powered vehicles.
SMART
The eFly app is built with advanced IoT technology, reliable performance, and a smooth user experience that makes riding our electric vehicles even more fun. The app is available in both Arabic and English for your convenience.
You can view all available vehicles on the map, including their battery levels and locations. You can also reserve a vehicle before reaching it.
The app automatically updates your location, helping you always find the nearest available eFly vehicle.
Fast-n-Fun!

bluejetty:00120632:ios.description:
For over a decade, TacticalPad has been the trusted choice for coaches, match analysts and sports enthusiasts, globally. Adopted by clubs, national teams, grassroots initiatives, prominent national federations and coach formation courses, our platform has revolutionized the way tactics, drills and strategies are visualized and shared.
Why TacticalPad?
- Simplicity Meets Technology: As intuitive as a classic tactical magnetic board but with the advantages of cutting-edge features.
- Versatile Use Cases: From professional arenas to grassroots fields, TacticalPad is indispensable for designing drills and exercises.
- Rich Visualization: Craft animated plays, visualize in 3D with realistic graphics and enhance with high-quality visuals.
- Diverse Sports Palette: Comprehensive support for various sports, from football/soccer to Rugby, Lacrosse, Beach Soccer and more!
- Share & Collaborate: Seamlessly export and share via images, videos, social networks or cloud services.
- Enhanced Editing: Digital ink tools, customizable training items and a library of editable elements at your fingertips.
- Complete Team Management: Detailed rosters, customizable lineups and diverse team appearance settings.
- A Legacy of Excellence: Bridging traditional tactics with modern technology, we've stood the test of time.
Invaluable Everywhere: TacticalPad thrives in diverse settings - from the game bench, training grounds, halftime discussions to educational sessions.
Additional Features:
• Notepad for tactical notes and analysis.
• Integrate with Youtube and Vimeo.
• Create detailed playbooks.
• Add custom pitches and items.
• Project visuals for team sessions.
Driven by the Community: Your feedback fuels our continuous evolution, ensuring TacticalPad meets the ever-changing demands of modern sports.
---------------------------------

- TacticalPad Year Subscription (auto-renewable): have access to upcoming features, TacticalPedia projects/content and constant support. Subscription is annual and auto-renewable.
- 12 months duration and auto-renewable
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00090254:ios.description:
Si buscas esos momentos de "¡Wow, me siento genial y me veo increíble!", entonces estás en el sitio ideal. Lo mejor de todo es que somos totalmente online, pero completamente humanos. Aquí, en Longevo, decimos adiós a los robots y a los planes "talla única para todos". Nuestro compromiso es ofrecerte una experiencia personalizada adaptada solo a ti, con el propósito de revolucionar tu calidad de vida. Ya sea que quieras mejorar tu salud física, nutricional o mental, o quizás simplemente buscas un estilo de vida más saludable, pues bien, nuestro equipo de expertos reales te espera con los brazos abiertos. Vamos, ¡te guiaremos en esta travesía hacia sentirte increíble, tanto por dentro como por fuera!
Lo que disfrutarás:
Plan Nutricional Personalizado: ¿Eres de los que come de todo, vegano, vegetariano o tienes alguna restricción alimenticia? No te preocupes. Independientemente de tu estilo de vida, tu nutriexperto creará un plan exclusivamente para ti. Disfruta de menús quincenales, aprende a hacer reemplazos inteligentes en tus comidas, descubre recetas saludables y obtén retroalimentación directa de tu experto a través de fotos que compartas en la app.
Plan de Entrenamiento a tu Medida: ¿Prefieres entrenar en casa o en el gimnasio? Tenemos un plan diseñado específicamente para tus objetivos y condiciones físicas. Explora rutinas semanales en la app, disfruta clases guiadas de HIIT, fuerza, estiramiento y enfrenta desafíos de fitness para complementar tus rutinas y lograr mejores resultados.
Mente en Armonía: Sumérgete en clases guiadas de yoga y meditación. Además, accede a herramientas diseñadas para mejorar tu sueño, gestionar el estrés, combatir el envejecimiento y potenciar tu desarrollo personal.
Conexión Inteligente: Conecta tus dispositivos inteligentes y permite que nuestro equipo de expertos supervise tu progreso, monitoree tu rendimiento en actividades diarias y evalúe la calidad de tu sueño.

bluejetty:00086326:ios.description:
Discover FitFast, the ultimate intermittent fasting app designed to help you lose weight and boost your health. Say goodbye to the yo-yo effect with your personalised fasting plan.
"Can I really fast daily with FitFast as my weight loss companion?" Absolutely! Our intermittent fasting tracker is your partner in achieving your health goals, offering expert insights, engaging fasting challenges, and ongoing motivation. FitFast is easy to use, even for beginners.
Why choose intermittent fasting?
Intermittent fasting is a powerful tool for weight loss because it reduces calorie intake by limiting meal frequency. This method not only helps in shedding pounds but also offers various health benefits. FitFast’s intuitive fasting timer makes the process seamless.
Intermittent fasting alternates between periods of eating and fasting, which helps deplete glycogen stores and triggers ketosis — your body's natural fat-burning mode. With FitFast, you can harness the benefits of this process efficiently.
Here’s what FitFast offers:
• Comprehensive fasting tracker
• Multiple daily fasting plans
• Hydration tracker
• User-friendly fasting timer - start/stop with a tap
• Step counter to monitor physical activity
• In-depth fasting and nutrition guide
• Over 1000 delicious recipes tailored to your preferences
• Meal plans crafted by nutrition experts
• 24/7 access to our Personal AI Coach
• Detailed fasting and weight progress statistics
• Notifications to remind you when to fast or eat
Is FitFast effective for weight loss?
Absolutely! FitFast caters to both women and men with daily fasting plans. Start with popular routines like 14:10, 16:8, or 18:6. For instance, the 16:8 plan allows you to eat within an 8-hour window, followed by a 16-hour fast.
For those more experienced, there are advanced plans such as 21:3 or OMAD (one meal a day).
Just use the fasting timer, stay hydrated, and pick the fasting schedule that fits your lifestyle. Whether you follow a keto, low-carb, or intuitive eating diet, FitFast helps you reach your healthy weight goals.
FitFast isn’t just a tracker; it’s your comprehensive guide to successful intermittent fasting and healthy eating habits. Plus, it's incredibly beginner-friendly!
Disclaimer: This app provides information intended for general educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Users are strongly encouraged to seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
FitFast offers six auto-renewing subscription options:
- 1 month plan $19.99
- 3 month plan $39.99
- 12 month plan $59.99
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing may vary based on region and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your Apple ID Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your Apple ID settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your Apple ID will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

bluejetty:00149448:ios.description:
Why Choose BoxOrganizer?
BoxOrganizer is the go-to solution for anyone - individuals, families, or even small businesses - looking to organize their belongings or inventory with ease and efficiency. Moving to a new place and struggling to find your essentials? Managing a small business and need a quick way to track your inventory? Whether it’s personal items like sports equipment and medicine or business assets like merchandise and supplies, BoxOrganizer has you covered. Its intuitive design lets you catalog, locate, and manage your items quickly, saving you time and stress. Not just for moving, it’s perfect for organizing hobbies, collections, or even the office stockroom. Plus, you can share your system with others for collaborative inventory management.
How Does BoxOrganizer Work?
- Set Up Your Projects: Create a project and add key attributes.
- Add Your Boxes: Organize each box by adding essential details like its name, description, and other important characteristics. You can even nest boxes within other boxes for more detailed organization.
- Track Your Items: Add items manually or use the app’s scanning feature to input them quickly.
- Print Labels: Just print BoxOrgnaizer-Codes to stick on boxes for quick scanning and access.
- Use Tags: Create tags to group related elements for faster searches later.
- Store & Organize: Let the app keep track of everything for you.
- Collaborate: Share your inventory with family, friends, or colleagues to streamline organization across your household or team.
- Find Items Instantly: Search by name, tag, and even attribute or just scan the Box-Code for fast retrieval.
What Can I Organize with BoxOrganizer?
BoxOrganizer is incredibly versatile. Whether it’s household items like kitchenware, clothing, and electronics, or business inventory like office supplies and merchandise, if you can store it, you can track it.
Can Small Businesses Use BoxOrganizer?
Absolutely! BoxOrganizer is ideal for small businesses. Keep tabs on stock, office essentials, or tools, and access your inventory anywhere, anytime.
What Are BoxOrganizer-Codes?
BoxOrganizer Codes let you scan boxes to view their contents and access item details instantly. You can choose between single, grid, or row layouts for printing.
Is My Data Secure?
Yes, your data is safe with us. Information is stored locally on your device and, for shared projects, securely backed up in the cloud. We collect anonymous usage data for app improvement, but you can opt out anytime. See our privacy policy for details.
Is there a subscription?
Yes, BoxOrganizer offers different subscription plans depending on the features you need and how many items you want to manage (sign-in necessary in the app to view subscription options). You can choose between a monthly or yearly plan - both can be canceled at any time. The yearly plan also comes with a discount compared to the monthly option.
What Are the Technical Requirements?
BoxOrganizer works on devices with a camera and iOS 15.1+. It’s built to be lightweight and accessible.
Need Help? Reach out to us at support@boxorganizer.app or connect with us on Instagram, Facebook, or Twitter.
Feedback? Email us at feedback@boxorganizer.app to share how you’re using BoxOrganizer or to suggest improvements.

bluejetty:00069824:ios.description:
Say hello to your TSB Mobile Banking App.
Manage all your TSB accounts securely in one place. Check your balance, make payments, move money into Savings Pots and stay in control of your cards—anytime, anywhere.
With the TSB app, you can: 
 - Log in fast with Face ID or fingerprint. 
 - Make payments, transfer money and manage standing orders or Direct Debits. 
 - Freeze or unfreeze your card, view your PIN & card details, and order a replacement. 
 - Add your card to Apple Wallet/Google Pay. 
 - Use Savings Pots and Save the Pennies to grow your savings. 
 - Track spending with Spend & Save tools. 
 - Identify transactions easily with retailer logos. 
Simple. Secure. Designed to help you stay on top of your money.

 - To use this app, you must be a personal TSB customer with a device running iOS15 or above.

Get ready for an exciting mix of tower defense strategy and NFT gaming! HeroesTD combines the best of both worlds to offer an adventure like no other. In this game, you can collect powerful
bluejetty:00069538:ios.description:
HeroesTD: Where Tower Defense Meets NFT Gaming! 
Get ready for an exciting mix of tower defense strategy and NFT gaming! HeroesTD combines the best of both worlds to offer an adventure like no other. In this game, you can collect powerful heroes and embark on a journey to become a legend in the virtual world.
Features:
Mid-Autumn Theme and Skin Feature: Explore the enchanting atmosphere of the Mid-Autumn Festival with the special Mid-Autumn theme brings more valuable rewards in HeroesTD. Experience stunning visuals, vibrant colors, and festive decorations that bring the spirit of this traditional celebration to life. Additionally, unlock exclusive Mid-Autumn-themed skins for your heroes, allowing you to customize their appearance and showcase your festive spirit.
Unleash NFT-Powered Heroes: Take command of a diverse army of over 60 unique heroes, each with their own special abilities. These heroes are not just characters; they are valuable assets in the world of NFTs and decentralized marketplaces.
Crafted Strategies for Victory: Build a team of five heroes and strategically choose their skills, items, classes, and origins. Customize your tactics to take advantage of enemy weaknesses and aim for the top spots on the HTD and Leaderboard NFT leaderboards. You can also participate in in-game auctions.
Play to Earn Rewards: Your victories in the game can earn you real-world rewards. Compete against other players on the HTD and Leaderboard NFT to win exclusive prizes and establish yourself as a tower defense legend. Engage in cooperative gameplay, join in-game events, and complete quests for additional rewards.
Explore a Rich Universe: Engage in a captivating universe filled with mysteries and untold stories. Each hero has a unique narrative that adds depth and intrigue to the game. Immerse yourself in the rich lore and be part of a community-driven development and governance process.
Dynamic NFT Ecosystem: The heroes you collect are more than just digital; they are NFTs that you truly own. Collect, trade, and own heroes that hold real value in the player-driven economy and the tokenized characters market. Take advantage of the decentralized marketplace and trading platform.
How to Play:
Plan Your Strategy: Carefully select your heroes, considering their skills, items, classes, and origins. Mix and match them to create a powerful team. Use skill trees, customize items, and manage resources efficiently.
Defend Your Towers: Strategically position your heroes to defend against waves of enemies. Upgrade your towers and manage resources effectively to succeed in this tower defense game. Learn how to master tower upgrades and the in-game economy.
Evolve Your Heroes: Merge and evolve your heroes by combining Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary Heroes. Witness their growth in power and unlock unique abilities as you progress through the game's character progression system. Utilize the resource management system to evolve your heroes.
Master Diverse Game Modes: Engage in various game modes, including player-vs-player battles, cooperative gameplay, World Boss, Tower Climbing and challenging campaign missions. Participate in in-game events and quests to earn additional rewards in this immersive NFT gaming experience. Experience real-time battles and competitive gameplay in HeroesTD.
HeroesTD is more than just a game; it's a revolution powered by blockchain technology and a vibrant community. Every hero you collect and every move you make shapes your legacy in the virtual world. Join us, trade on the decentralized marketplace, participate in community governance, and become a legend in the gaming universe with your owned virtual assets in this play-to-earn NFT game.

bluejetty:00126454:ios.description:
Welcome to Reinbow, the social media app that’s changing the game! This vibrant platform promotes authenticity and creativity, allowing you to connect with real people through original content. With Reinbow, you’ll discover a world where every interaction is meaningful, and every moment is unfiltered.
Create Authentic Content with Ease
Say goodbye to filters and pre-recorded perfection! Reinbow encourages genuine expression by requiring users to use only the in-app camera for recording videos in real time. This ensures that every post reflects your true self—no edits, no gimmicks, just you. Whether you’re sharing your thoughts, showcasing talents, or engaging with others, Reinbow makes it easy to create content that resonates.
Engage and Grow Your Colorful Network
Unlike traditional platforms, Reinbow rewards your activity. The more you post, interact, and engage with others, the more your “color” evolves. As your color grows, you unlock access to new galaxies, where you can meet inspiring creators and make new friends. It’s not just a social media app; it’s an engaging community where your efforts are celebrated.
Reach Millions and Make Connections
With just your face and voice, Reinbow lets you connect with a global audience. Share videos, participate in challenges, and build a network of followers who appreciate your authenticity. You’ll find like-minded people who value genuine connection over curated perfection. Whether you want to meet new people, share your passions, or simply explore, Reinbow is the place to be.
Explore New Galaxies and Orbit Your Friends
Reinbow is more than just a platform; it’s an adventure. As you grow, you can enter new galaxies, explore vibrant planets, and orbit around your friends’ content. This unique feature makes social media fun and interactive, giving you a sense of discovery every time you log in. Dive into the Reinbow universe and see what surprises await!
Chat, Go Live, and Send Gifts
Stay connected with your favorite creators and friends through live chats and video streams. Reinbow’s live feature makes it easy to engage in real-time conversations and share your thoughts instantly. You can also send gifts to creators you admire, supporting their journey and building meaningful relationships.
Celebrate Real Content, Real People
Tired of fake interactions and superficial scrolling? Reinbow is a refreshing alternative to the social media norm. It’s a space for real people to share real moments, fostering connections that go beyond the screen. Whether you’re passionate about art, music, food, or simply sharing your daily life, Reinbow provides the perfect stage for your original content.
A Colorful Experience Like No Other
With Reinbow, every interaction adds more color to your life. Build an audience, grow your network, and earn rewards for your creativity. This platform is designed to celebrate individuality and community, creating a vibrant social media experience that’s uniquely yours.
Why Reinbow - Colorful Social Media
- Use only in app camera
- Create amazing content with our editor
- Reach millions of people
- Orbit your friends and meet new people by entering new galaxies
- Chat and go live with your favorite influencers
Join the Reinbow Revolution
Why settle for ordinary when you can join a platform that values authenticity and fun? Download Reinbow - Colorful Social Media today and discover the power of real connections. It’s time to fill your life with color, creativity, and genuine interactions.
Create, connect, and shine with Reinbow—where your true self is your greatest asset!

bluejetty:00016529:ios.description:

Become a real detective, seek and find objects, solve mysteries, find clues, and investigate crimes!
Embark on Hidden Journey quest! Each level is a new location – a mysterious house, ranch, abandoned pickup truck, and many others. Enjoy the atmosphere thanks to the highly detailed awesome graphics!

- Awesome music to deep into the seek and find game atmosphere 
- Highly detailed & awesome graphics
- 9 different object finding mechanics
- Level map with unique locations
- 7 instruments to ease your search
- Instrument Upgrade Shop
If you're looking for an amazing hidden object seek and find game then Hidden Journey is just what you need! Wonderful music and amazing graphics will make your hidden object gaming experience unforgettable. Try on the detective role, prepare a magnifying glass, plunge into the amazing world of seek and find game, and start your hidden object adventure!
So, what are you waiting for? Download Hidden Journey and enjoy this amazing seek and find game!

bluejetty:00086154:ios.description:
The BabyInside app serves as a pregnancy tracker, assisting expectant parents in maintaining calmness throughout their pregnancy journey. This comprehensive pregnancy guide keeps users informed about bodily changes, baby development, a pregnancy calendar, and a countdown to the baby's birth. The app offers various tips, including advice on pregnancy diet, labor, and guidance for both moms-to-be and dads-to-be.
For parents of newborns, the app provides insights into increasing fertility. Users can access a pregnancy calendar week by week and utilize a pregnancy tracker with valuable information. The app also features a contraction timer for users to monitor contractions effectively.
If users are focused on the countdown to childbirth, the app offers assistance. The baby due date calendar provides a new experience, allowing users to calculate the due date and determine their current week based on the last menstrual period. The app displays the current week, due date, and the remaining days until childbirth.
Key features of the BabyInside application include:
Learning about the baby's growth during pregnancy
Guidance on preparing a hospital bag for labor
Pregnancy diet tips, including nutrition advice, recommended and restricted foods, and suitable pills
Weekly tips from conception to delivery, covering exercises, workouts, recommended reading, and other aspects of a healthy pregnancy
Push notifications for important dates in the pregnancy calendar
Information on the baby's size
The app includes tools such as a baby due date calculator based on the date of conception and a pregnancy baby countdown calculator.
The developers are proud to present the best app with information for moms-to-be and welcome user reviews and suggestions for new features. They express willingness to implement user feedback.
Terms of Use: https://babyinsideapp.ru/terms.html

bluejetty:00024308:ios.name: MTG Life Counter App: Lotus
bluejetty:00024308:ios.summary:
Lotus is your all-around Magic the Gathering Companion app.
Key features:
- Track life totals and Commander damage for up to 10 players
- Quick life total adjustments and custom starting health
- Card search with price checking and format
bluejetty:00024308:ios.description:
Lotus is your all-around Magic the Gathering Companion app.
Key features:
- Track life totals and Commander damage for up to 10 players
- Quick life total adjustments and custom starting health
- Card search with price checking and format legality
- Roll any custom dice (including D4-D20) or flip a coin
- High-roll feature and coin flips
- Track various counters: poison, experience, charge, storm, and more
- Support for partner commanders and Commander Tax
- Initiative and Monarch status tracking
- Game timer with individual turn tracking
- Customize player backgrounds and defeat messages
- Battery-friendly design with sleek dark mode
- Additional game modes: Planechase and Archenemy
The best MTG Life Tracker
We love Magic the Gathering! That's why we built Lotus. Supporting up to 10 players with custom starting health totals, Lotus makes tracking life totals as smooth as a well-oiled combo. Set unique colors or background images for every player, and swipe to track commander damage with ease. Beyond life tracking, Lotus handles everything from Poison counters to Storm count, Energy to Mana, and even keeps tabs on your Commander Tax.
Advanced Game Management
Swipe up or down on player cards to access a full suite of customization options. Set custom backgrounds, enable partner commanders, and manage players directly from their cards. Share your favorite profiles across devices, and when a player falls in battle, bring them back with our streamlined revival system. Plus, add some salt to defeat with customizable defeat messages!
Card Search and Price Checking
Need to check if that sneaky tech is format legal? Or maybe you're wondering about the price of that chase rare? Search for any Magic card to instantly see current prices and format legality information.
Additional Game Modes: Planechase and Archenemy
Planechase: Journey through different planes with a full suite of Planechase cards, including the newest Doctor Who planes. The deck shuffles automatically, bringing fresh challenges to each game.
Archenemy: Unite against a common foe or take on the villain's role with integrated Archenemy Schemes, including the latest Archenemy schemes.
Game Timer and Turn Tracking
Keep your games moving with our integrated game timer and turn tracker. Whether you're in a casual Commander game or racing against the clock in a tournament, Lotus helps ensure smooth gameplay without slow play.
Battery-friendly MTG Companion
The app is designed to be energy-efficient with a dark mode that conserves your battery during those epic Commander sessions. Plus, there are no ads, so you can focus on your game without distractions.
Watch on a TV and share recaps
Turn on Allow spectators and tap Cast to TV to follow the game live on a TV, a laptop or the Lotus app on Apple TV. After a game, share a recap link with the winner, a life graph and the biggest hits.
We'd love your feedback!
If you have any feedback, please let us know! Your input helps us make Lotus even better and keeps it as your go-to Magic the Gathering life counter and companion app.
This app contains unofficial Fan Content permitted under the Fan Content Policy of Wizards of the Coast. This app is not approved or endorsed by Wizards. Portions of the materials used are property of Wizards of the Coast. © Wizards of the Coast LLC.
---
This app contains an optional subscription.
Lotus is free and has no ads. Nothing is locked behind payment, and nothing ever will be. If you want to support development, you can do so from inside the app, either as a monthly subscription or a one-time payment. It unlocks nothing: every feature is available to everyone. Monthly support renews automatically until cancelled.

bluejetty:00121772:ios.description:
Find the best slice of pizza using the One Bite app from Barstool Sports. Starting as a video series, Dave “El Presidente” Portnoy has created a cult following of people giving “one bite” pizza reviews by the common man, for the common man. Now you can find all 430+ of Dave’s reviews complete with videos, scores and location. One Bite users can upload their own reviews at any of the 100,000+ restaurants available in the app.
App Features:
Find Pizza
- Find all restaurants (on a map or list) by Score, if reviewed by Dave, delivery support or your bookmarks. 
Get detailed restaurant information like phone number, address, photos, hours and more.
Watch
- See all of Dave's One Bite reviews, tagged to each restaurant. 
- Watch Celebrity and your friends' reviews. 
- Share, like or dislike reviews and follow other reviewers (celebrities and friends alike).
Order
- Order takeout or delivery from the restaurant right from the app. Delivery is supported by Slice, Delivery.com or Yelp!. 
Post a Review
- Upload your own video review giving your One Bite score of any pizza restaurant, rating it from 0 - 10. (Decimal scores supported so there are no amateur reviews)
Profile
- See all of your own reviews including your average rating.

bluejetty:00031409:ios.description:
Introducing Mindr, the innovative reminder app that takes a fresh approach to keeping you on track without the hassle of constant notifications. Mindr utilizes a subtle widget on your home screen to discreetly show the time remaining until your tasks are due and how long they've been overdue. Say goodbye to intrusive reminders and stay organized effortlessly, especially for chores and other repeating tasks. Mindr's user interface draws inspiration from the familiar Apple battery widget, ensuring a seamless and intuitive experience.
KEY FEATURES:
Non-Intrusive Reminders: Mindr provides a unique way to remind you of your tasks without inundating you with notifications. The widget discreetly displays the time remaining until your tasks are due, allowing you to stay on top of your responsibilities without interruptions.
Effortless Completion: With iOS 17 integration, Mindr lets you complete tasks right from your home screen. No need to open the app; simply mark tasks as done with a tap, making your daily routines smoother than ever.
Familiar and User-Friendly: Mindr's user interface takes design cues from Apple's battery widget, featuring circular elements that display the remaining time for your tasks. This familiarity ensures that you can start using Mindr intuitively from day one.
Privacy-First: Rest easy knowing that your data is secure. Mindr does not store any user data. All information is stored on your private iCloud and your device, with no third-party access.
Subscription Options: You can enjoy limited functionality without a subscription, for the full Mindr experience, explore our subscription options. Mindr offers flexible plans to unlock its full potential. Choose between a monthly, yearly, or lifetime purchase to enjoy all the benefits of Mindr. Subscription plans automatically renew for your convenience.
For information about the terms of use, refer to the Apple EULA (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula)
Never miss a task again with Mindr's discreet and efficient reminder system. Download Mindr now and experience a new way to stay organized while maintaining your peace of mind.

bluejetty:00032181:ios.description:
New free to play puzzle games, brain teasers and mini games of Hidden Motives: The Diamond Rush where you need to find hidden pictures and win top new adventure games! This game has no plot differences with the original puzzle, and its main feature is that you can play the entire hidden objects quest for free! 
It's the Wild West, and you're the sheriff's daughter! Or at least you're playing one as the lead actress in a movie. But what should be the role of a lifetime becomes more than you bargained for when you're transported into the film itself! The city of Redsand is plagued by bandits, and a recent string of murders has residents blaming the fabled Diamond Ghost. You’ll need to play your part perfectly to uncover the truth and get back home before it's too late! Do you have the chops to get the job done? Find out in this sensational Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!
· Investigate the mysterious deaths of coal miners and a series of stagecoach robberies in the bonus chapter!
Didn't you think that detective investigation was over? No, there is another little task waiting for you. We are sure you will cope! In the mystery games you need to solve puzzles, brain teasers and mini-games.
· Collect morphing wild west items and wanted posters!
A collector's item is waiting for you at each location, so be extremely careful! Do you see something that is not in its place? Click boldly on the items of hide & seek story games!
· Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games and earn achievements!
Do you want to become an experienced seeker and find hidden pictures better than others? Then go through puzzles, brain teasers and mini-games, as our murder mystery games will make you think about how to search better!
· Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, music, concept art, videos and more!
Our detective games are filled with beautiful wallpapers, pleasant music, picturesque concept art and interesting videos, so hurry to play to immerse yourself in the magical atmosphere completely!
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Hidden Motives: The Diamond Rush! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!
-----

【File Sl
bluejetty:00151115:ios.description:
Ur Cleaner is a smart and efficient mobile utility that supports photo size reduction, video compression, email cleaning, intelligent web image extraction, and precise screenshot capture. It's a handy assistant in your daily life!
【File Slimmer】 Filter similar media to retain the best versions
• Accurately identify duplicates/similars, photos/videos/screenshots, mark recommended ones for retention, and clean up redundant files with one click, effectively eliminating duplicates without losing important content.
【Video Slimming】 Intelligently frees up space and eliminates memory concerns
• Supports 80% lightweight compression, 50% balanced compression, and 20% deep compression, allowing you to choose the right compression method for your needs. Compress videos and free up space in your photo album.
【Email Cleaner】Intelligent classification for ultra-efficient batch cleaning
• Automatically identify and categorize emails—promotional ads, forums, social media, and spam—eliminating manual sifting. One-click bulk deletion allows for a clean and organized inbox, making management more efficient.
【Web Screenshot】 Precise Extraction + Multiple Formats
• Generate precise screenshots of web page layouts with one click, scan and extract web page images; crop precisely, freely select desired content, and remove redundant information; export images in PNG, JPG, and PDF formats.
【Pain Points Solved】 Addresses common user concerns with practical and efficient functionality.
* Say goodbye to insufficient memory and instantly boost your device's performance.
Running low on phone memory? Intelligently clean similar media and compress videos to quickly free up storage space, addressing the root cause of insufficient memory and improving phone performance.
* Effortless email management saves significant time:
Overwhelmed by dozens or hundreds of emails every day? Automatic classification and batch operations quickly clear junk messages, doubling your email management efficiency.
* Protect every piece of data privacy.
All data is stored locally on your device, never uploaded or accessed by the cloud. Every piece of information is yours, ensuring your privacy and security.
* Web Screenshot
Easily capture webpage images without downloading restrictions. Capture precise content on demand, freely select specific areas, and convert webpage content to a specific file type.
◆◆◆Membership Subscription Auto-Renewal Service Statement◆◆◆
【Subscription Period】 Weekly Subscription: 1-week subscription; Annual Subscription: 12-month subscription
【Subscription Price】Subject to iAP application information. Weekly subscriptions are ¥4.99 per week; annual subscriptions are ¥49.99 per year.
【Payment】 Payment will be charged to your iTunes account after you confirm your purchase.
【Renewal】 "Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Annual" subscriptions are auto-renewable. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account after you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription. Apple will automatically debit your iTunes account within 24 hours before your subscription expires, and your membership will be automatically extended for one additional period.
【Cancel Renewal】 To cancel auto-renewal, please manually cancel your subscription in "Settings" on your iPhone, tap "Apple ID," then go to the "Subscriptions" page and select "Ur Cleaner."

bluejetty:00140785:ios.description:
Run Your Own Hospital Empire in Master Hospital!
If you’ve ever dreamed of running your own hospital, managing a team of doctors and nurses, or giving patients the care they need, this is the game for you. From handling clinic logistics to unlocking new treatments, you'll experience the excitement of the medical world while enjoying the satisfaction of running your own hospital empire.
►DREAM HOSPITAL MANAGEMENT
Start with a modest clinic and turn it into a bustling medical center. Oversee everything from hiring doctors, nurses, and support staff, to ensuring each department runs efficiently. Every decision you make influences your hospital’s growth and success, from managing budgets to choosing the right medical equipment. As the hospital manager, you’ll take control of every aspect of your clinic’s operations. Keep your staff motivated, manage schedules, ensure enough resources, and prioritize patient care. It's up to you to ensure smooth workflows and that your hospital remains profitable.
►CARE PATIENTS FROM VARIOUS DISEASES
From common colds to life-threatening heart conditions, your hospital will cater to patients with various medical needs. Diagnose and treat patients in a variety of departments, from general care to specialized surgery. Each patient has unique needs. Diagnose their conditions carefully, recommend appropriate treatments, and monitor their recovery. Your attention to detail will lead to faster recoveries and improved hospital ratings.
►UNLOCK AND EXPAND YOUR BUSINESS
As your hospital grows, you’ll unlock advanced medical departments and specialized treatments. Expand from basic healthcare services to offering complex surgeries like heart operations, dental clinics, and more. With every expansion, you'll attract more patients, generate higher profits, and increase your hospital’s reputation. Add more floors, build new wings, and upgrade facilities to cater to more patients and provide top-notch care. Whether it’s adding a pediatric wing or upgrading your surgical theaters, expanding your hospital is key to growing your business.
►ASMR MEDICAL EXPERIENCE
If you're a fan of ASMR games, you'll love the calming and immersive experience. From managing patients to performing surgeries, the game recreates the gentle, soothing sensations that ASMR enthusiasts enjoy. Each medical task, whether it’s diagnosing a patient or conducting a surgery, is designed with relaxing, slow-paced interactions that provide a satisfying, stress-free atmosphere. The quiet sounds of medical tools, the soft touch of patient care, and the rhythmic flow of hospital routines combine to create a peaceful environment, making every moment feel calming and therapeutic while you manage your hospital.
Ready to become the ultimate hospital manager?
Whether you're interested in the day-to-day tasks of running a clinic or performing high-stakes surgeries, Master Hospital has everything you need for a fun, idle gaming experience. With free gameplay, regular updates, and endless ways to manage and expand your hospital, you’ll always have new challenges and rewards awaiting you. Start your medical journey now—download Master Hospital and begin your adventure as a hospital manager, caring for patients and growing your clinic into a world-class medical facility.

# Quick Draft: Your Essential Notepad with Markdown Support
Capture your thoughts instantly with this streamlined notes app for iOS. Quick Draft is the lightweight notepad designed to help you document ideas, compose messages, and organize tasks with unprecedented speed and simplicity.
## Lightning-Fast Note-Taking
Turn fleeting thoughts into permanent records. Launch and start typing immediately with our distraction-free notepad interface. Create, edit, and manage notes on the go, then seamlessly share your content to any app with a single tap.
## Markdown-Powered Note Organization
Elevate your notepad experience with intuitive markdown formatting. Quick Draft transforms simple text into beautifully structured notes, making it the perfect markdown companion for students, writers, and professionals alike.
## Intuitive Checklist Creation
Manage tasks effortlessly within your notes:
- Convert any line into an interactive checklist item
- Tap to toggle completion status
- Organize everything from shopping lists to project milestones in your notepad
## Seamless Multi-Device Sync
Your notepad travels with you. Quick Draft's iCloud integration ensures your notes are instantly available across all your devices, providing a consistent markdown experience whether you're using iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
Quick Draft: The essential markdown notepad that stays out of your way, letting you focus on capturing your thoughts.
Also available for macOS - your complete notepad ecosystem for all devices!

It's relaxing daily word fun with the puzzles in 7 Little Words and More. Whether you enjoy word finds, anagram and jumble games, or crosswords, 7 Little Words and More is the perfect game when you’re taking a short break or passing time while waiting!
Daily Games include:
7 LITTLE WORDS
Use the clues and letter blocks to find the 7 scrambled words in each bite-size puzzle.  
HOOTLE
Guess the mystery word before you run out of turns.
RED HERRING
Find the connections between words, but don't get caught by the Red Herrings.
TINY LITTLE CROSSWORDS
Solve small crossword puzzles with just one clue.
MONKEY WRENCH
Solve the categories and find all the words in the grid. 
All games are FUN and EASY TO LEARN. Give 7 Little Words and More a try today!
From the creators of Moxie - Word Traveler, Red Herring, Monkey Wrench, Tiny Little Crosswords, and Woven Words.
-----
The app includes more than 10,000 puzzles (in US and UK English versions) spanning 5 difficulty levels that have been compiled since the original release of the app in 2011.

You may also buy individual packs within the app without a subscription.

bluejetty:00119805:ios.name: flowkey – Learn to Play Piano
bluejetty:00119805:ios.summary: flowkey makes it fun and easy to play your favorite songs on piano – whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced player. All songs and courses are created by professional pianists, with interactive lessons, practice tools, and inst
bluejetty:00119805:ios.description:
flowkey makes it fun and easy to play your favorite songs on piano – whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced player. All songs and courses are created by professional pianists, with interactive lessons, practice tools, and instant feedback to help you learn piano the way that works for you.
Choose from thousands of beautifully-arranged piano pieces covering all genres, including: Classical, Pop, Film & TV and more. With songs available in four difficulty levels, you’ll always find new pieces to play. 
If you’re a beginner, learn piano step by step – with courses on how to read sheet music, navigate the keyboard, and play songs with both hands. flowkey’s beginner piano lessons are easy to follow and are a great way to learn piano fundamentals.
Experienced piano players can sharpen their skills with in-depth tutorials covering scales, chords and improvisation. 
All you need to learn piano and play your favorite songs is the flowkey app, your device (phone, tablet or laptop), and an instrument. flowkey works with acoustic pianos, digital pianos, and keyboards. 
ALL YOU NEED TO LEARN PIANO & KEYBOARD
flowkey’s interactive learning features make piano practice easy – and give you instant feedback on your playing. 
Loop: Choose specific sections to practice, and replay until you’ve perfected them.
Select a Hand: Practice the right and left hand notes separately.
Wait Mode: Follows as you play and waits for you to hit the right notes and chords. Works with your device’s microphone – or through Bluetooth/MIDI on digital pianos and keyboards.
Video: Watch a professional piano player perform the song, see the next notes highlighted on the keyboard, and see how to place your fingers. 
Just Play: Perform the whole piece and Just Play keeps up with the score – even if you miss a few notes.
Full Sheet Music View: If you’re using a tablet, turn it to portrait mode and practice reading traditional sheet music.
TRY FLOWKEY FOR FREE
Subscribe to the Yearly plan and the first 7 days are free – so you can explore the full piano song library, discover all courses and lessons, and learn how to use flowkey’s practice tools to master your favorite songs faster. 
Not ready to subscribe? A limited selection of beginner piano lessons and classical songs is available to learn for free. 
CHOOSE THE SUBSCRIPTION THAT SUITS YOU
flowkey Premium
- Includes all learning tools and courses 
- Access to the whole song library – including Classical, Pop, Rock, Film & TV and more.
- Use flowkey on multiple devices
flowkey Classic
- Includes all learning tools and courses 
- Access to all classical and non-copyrighted songs 
- Use flowkey on multiple devices
flowkey Family
- Includes all learning tools and courses 
- Separate Premium accounts for up to 5 people on multiple devices
- Access to the whole song library of digital sheet music
BILLING OPTIONS
Monthly: Stay flexible with monthly billing. Cancel anytime.
Yearly: Save by subscribing to flowkey for 12 months. Includes a 7-day trial, which can be cancelled up to 24 hours before billing starts.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
PEOPLE LOVE FLOWKEY
With over 15 million people learning with flowkey worldwide, and 213,000+ 5-star reviews from happy pianists, keyboard players and piano teachers, we know flowkey’s fun approach to learning works. Ready to try it for yourself?
WE’RE HERE TO HELP
If you have any questions or feedback, you can reach us via email: support@flowkey.com 
Or directly in the app by tapping: Settings -> Support & Feedback.
FLOWKEY FOR TEACHERS
If you’re a piano teacher or music tutor who’d like to use flowkey in lessons, or to support your students’ at-home practice, get in touch with the ‘flowkey for Teachers’ team at: partner@flowkey.com
Terms of Service: https://www.flowkey.com/en/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.flowkey.com/en/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00134055:ios.description:
Songstats gives artists, labels, managers, and music industry teams one place to track streaming stats, playlist placements, chart positions, radio airplay, audience growth, and social momentum across major music platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Shazam, SoundCloud, and Beatport.
With real-time music data and cross-platform insights, Songstats helps you understand release momentum, monitor fan growth, spot promotional opportunities, and make smarter marketing decisions from one mobile dashboard.
Track performance across Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Amazon Music, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Shazam, 1001Tracklists, Beatport, Traxsource, iTunes, SoundCloud, Facebook, Twitter / X, Bandsintown, Songkick, and more.
Radiostats expands Songstats with AI-driven radio airplay monitoring across more than 50,000 radio stations and TV channels worldwide. Get real-time radio play updates, detailed airplay analytics, and access to a Royalty Collection service that helps you claim potential royalties from plays on SiriusXM.
KEY FEATURES
• Cross-Platform Music Analytics: Track streams, listeners, followers, views, playlist adds, chart positions, radio plays, and social growth across major music platforms.
• Real-Time Activity Feed: Get notified when your tracks enter charts, land on playlists, reach milestones, receive comments, or generate new radio airplay.
• Playlist & Chart Tracking: Monitor playlist placements, chart movement, supporter activity, and release momentum across global platforms and territories.
• Audience Insights: Understand where your listeners and fans are growing with audience demographics, city-level trends, geographic reach, and engagement data.
• Radio Airplay Monitoring: Use Radiostats to track radio and TV plays across more than 50,000 stations and channels worldwide, including SiriusXM royalty collection support.
• Shareable Milestones: Turn playlist adds, chart entries, radio plays, Shazams, and social achievements into custom artworks for Instagram Stories and other social channels.
• Reports & Exports: Create PDF and CSV reports for your team, label, management, artists, or clients.
• Music Marketing Tools: Discover playlist, creator, artist, label, and venue recommendations to support smarter promotion and release strategy.
• Widgets & Apple Watch: Keep key artist and label stats visible from your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Apple Watch.
WHY GO PREMIUM?
Unlock deeper analytics, full-catalog tracking, real-time activity alerts, advanced audience insights, detailed reports, marketing recommendations, and premium radio monitoring with Songstats Premium.
Subscribe to an individual artist or label to track their full catalog and receive push notifications for key activity across streaming, playlist, chart, social, and radio platforms.
For teams, labels, managers, A&Rs, and industry professionals who need broader access, the Songstats Professional Plan provides comprehensive music analytics across the wider industry in one subscription.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless canceled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://songstats.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00023695:ios.description:
Stop guessing how many grams are in a cup of flour. Cooking Conversions converts 1,500+ ingredients between cups, grams, ounces, ml, tablespoons, teaspoons, liters, kilograms, and pounds.
Most measurement converters treat every cup the same. This one doesn't - a cup of flour, a cup of sugar, and a cup of chopped walnuts all weigh different amounts. Pick sliced, diced, whole, chopped, packed, or sifted when it matters.
• Convert 1,500+ ingredients by weight and volume
• Cups to grams, flour grams to cups, ounces to ml - metric to imperial, both directions
• Ingredient forms that change the weight: sliced, diced, whole, chopped, packed, sifted
• Fahrenheit ↔ Celsius for oven temperatures
• Searchable conversion history
• Favorites for ingredients you use often
• Works fully offline - no account, no ads
• Light and dark mode with 8 accent colors
• English and Spanish
Example: 1 cup all-purpose flour → 120 g. 1 cup granulated sugar → 200 g.
Every conversion and feature is included with your App Store download. No subscriptions or in-app purchases.
