bluejetty:00146474:ios.description:
Wellness Coach is a global wellness platform that inspires and engages workforces through personalized wellness offerings. We offer Challenges, Coaching, Rewards, Next Generation EAP, and Weight Management to support mental and physical health. Our high-impact solutions integrate with MS Teams, Slack, and Zoom to enhance engagement, accessibility, and productivity, fostering a healthier workforce. Join us today as we embark on creating a healthier and happier workforce. 
Our Story
In the wake of burnout from relentless startup endeavors, founders D Sharma and Julie Sharma embarked on a transformative journey of self-care. Their path led them to a serene retreat in Thailand, where the wisdom of a monk/coach introduced them to the power of journaling, meditation, and living in the moment. This pivotal experience ignited a profound realization: the life-changing benefits of personal coaching, a privilege once reserved for elite athletes, should be accessible to everyone. 
Inspired to bridge this gap, they, together with their friend Bhartesh, founded Wellness Coach. With a mission to make wellness readily accessible for all, Wellness Coach offers a comprehensive suite of mental and physical health services, from multilingual digital health resources to personalized coaching and clinical solutions. It's more than a company; it's a movement to empower individuals to navigate life's challenges with grace and resilience, inspired by the founders' own journey toward healing and growth. 
-D, Julie and Bhartesh.
A Pawsitive Tale: A Journey of Hope and Healing
Meet Pawsitive, the heart and soul of our mission to help 5 billion people live their best lives. During the challenging times of the pandemic, when the world grappled with isolation and uncertainty, our team sought a symbol of hope and resilience. That's when Pawsitive came into our lives, an embodiment of emotional support and unwavering positivity.
Chosen for his joyful spirit and compassionate heart, Pawsitive quickly became more than just a companion; he became a beacon of wellness, guiding our community toward health, happiness, and mindfulness. As the mascot of Wellness Coach, he represents the journey every individual is on—seeking balance, peace, and well-being in their lives.
Pawsitive invites each user to join him on this global mission, offering a paw in friendship and support. Together, with Pawsitive leading the way, we're not just using an app; we're building a movement toward accessible, engaging wellness for everyone, everywhere.
Embrace the journey with Pawsitive, and let's walk the path to living our best lives, one step, and one paw, at a time.
Why Wellness Coach? One platform for all employee wellbeing needs.
Wellness Coach membership covers all essentials of wellness including:
- Mental Wellbeing: meditations, live classes, 1-1 coaching, audiobooks, thearpy
- Physical Wellbeing: Yoga, Fitness, Cardio, Stretching, Steps challenges, 1-1 coaches and more.
- Sleep: Bedtime stories, music, yoga for sleep and more
- Nutrition: Weight management, Live group classes, 1-1 Coaching and more
- Financial Wellness: Managing Debt, Rainy day funds, Live group coaching and 1-1 coaching
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://www.Wellnesscoach.live/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.wellnesscoach.live/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00084716:ios.description:
Take control of your heart health with Blood Pressure & Heart Rate Monitor, a smart and easy-to-use app designed to help you track, understand, and improve your cardiovascular wellbeing. 
Whether you want to monitor daily blood pressure, check your heart rate, or build a long-term health history, this app brings everything into one simple and intelligent health tracker.
Smart Health Tracking
Quickly log your blood pressure and heart rate with manual input or smart tools. Measure pulse using your phone’s camera and keep your health data organized in one secure place.
Clear Insights & History
View detailed charts and trends across days, weeks, months, and even a full year. Understand how your heart health changes over time with easy-to-read analytics and structured reports.
Heart Rate & Pulse Monitoring
Measure your pulse using your smartphone camera in seconds. Track heart rate patterns and get a complete overview of your cardiovascular condition after regular measurements.
Smart Data Input
Scan your blood pressure monitor results using a photo for faster logging. No need for manual typing every time - just capture and save.
AI Health Assistant
Get personalized insights and recommendations based on your measurements. The AI assistant helps you understand your data and suggests healthier habits tailored to your condition.
Export & Share Reports
Generate detailed PDF reports with charts and summaries. Easily share your health data with your doctor, family, or caregivers whenever needed.
Reminders & Health Profile
Set daily reminders to stay consistent with your measurements. Create a personal health profile including age, gender, and BMI for more accurate insights.
Apple Health Integration
Sync your data with Apple Health for a complete and unified health overview.
Complete Heart Health Analysis
After multiple heart rate measurements, receive a full analysis of your cardiovascular trends and health status.
Blood Pressure & Heart Rate Monitor is your personal health companion - helping you track, understand, and improve your heart health every day with confidence.

bluejetty:00046986:ios.description:
The hardest part of sales is the call you haven't made yet. CoachCraft lets you practice it first - low-stakes reps with an AI buyer that shake off the anxiety before you ever dial a real prospect.
Pick a scenario, hit call, and have a real voice conversation with an AI persona that pushes back like a live prospect - skeptical CFOs, busy gatekeepers, price-shoppers, and more. Every call connects. Every call ends with an honest scorecard. No waiting, no "try again later."
PRACTICE ANY SALES CONVERSATION
- Cold calls, discovery, demos, objection handling, and closing
- AI roleplay personas that respond, stall, and object like real buyers
- Build your own custom roleplay - set the persona, product, and difficulty
- Daily warmups and fresh trending scenarios so practice never gets stale
GET HONEST FEEDBACK, NOT A PAT ON THE BACK
- A real grade and scorecard after every call - strengths and what to fix
- Speech metrics that catch your habits: talking pace (WPM) and filler words
- Sentence-level rewrites that turn "uh, well, I just wanted to..." into a clean line
- AI Coach insights that explain the why behind every note
TRAIN ON YOUR REAL CALLS
- Record and transcribe your actual sales calls
- Get a full debrief: where you lost the room, what to say next time
- Turn live deals into your best practice material
LEARN THE METHOD, NOT JUST THE MOVES
- Guided learning pathways take you from beginner to confident closer
- NEPQ-style questioning and modern, no-pressure persuasion
- A Sales Toolkit of frameworks, openers, and objection responses on demand
SHOW UP READY FOR EVERY MEETING
- Connect your calendar and prep for upcoming meetings
- Walk in with the right questions and answers already rehearsed
TRACK PROGRESS AND COMPETE
- A skills radar across listening, empathy, clarity, objections, and negotiation
- Streaks, talk-time, and scores that show your arc over weeks
- Team leaderboards to push each other and stay sharp
BUILT FOR TEAMS, TOO
- Sales managers can onboard and level up new reps faster
- Consistent practice and feedback across the whole floor
WHO IT'S FOR
- New SDRs and reps ramping fast
- AEs sharpening discovery and demos
- D2D and phone reps who live and die by the next call
- Job seekers prepping for high-stakes interviews
- Anyone who gets nervous before an important conversation
There's nothing else like practicing the call before the call. Build the reps, build the confidence, and walk into every conversation like you've already had it.
Download CoachCraft and make your next call your best one.

bluejetty:00026737:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00026737:ios.description:
Brave is a fast, private web browser that blocks ads and trackers on every site, automatically. No settings to change, no extensions to install.
Over 125 million people browse with Brave. It's free, open source, and independent — we don't sell your browsing data.
Everything below is built into the browser. One app, not a stack of them.
BLOCK ADS ON EVERY SITE
Brave Shields stops banner ads, pop-ups, autoplay interruptions, and the ads that play before and during videos. Same on news sites, shopping sites, forums and video pages — no per-site setup, no ad blocker extension. It dismisses cookie consent banners too, and it's on from your first tab.
PRIVATE BROWSING THAT BLOCKS TRACKERS
Private mode in most browsers only hides your history from your own phone. Brave blocks the cross-site trackers and fingerprinting scripts that follow you from a shopping page to your social feed, strips tracking codes from links you copy, and turns on Global Privacy Control by default.
SHRED: DELETE ONE SITE'S DATA, NOT ALL OF IT
Clearing browser data usually logs you out of everything. Shred deletes the cookies and storage for one site and leaves your other sessions intact. Set Auto Shred to run whenever you close a tab.
BRAVE SEARCH: A PRIVATE SEARCH ENGINE, BUILT IN
Brave Search is the default search engine in the browser, running on its own independent index — not resold results from Google or Bing. It doesn't profile you or log your searches. Ask Brave puts search results and AI answers in one place. Switch search engines any time.
BRAVE LEO: A FREE AI ASSISTANT
Summarize a long article, translate a page, or draft a reply without leaving the tab. Choose from several AI models. Leo doesn't record your conversations, share them, or use them to train models.
BRAVE NEWS: A FEED WITH NO PROFILE BEHIND IT
Personalize a news feed from hundreds of sources or any RSS feed with Brave News.
FASTER PAGES, LESS MOBILE DATA
Ads and trackers are most of what a modern page downloads. Blocking them means fewer requests, less data and less battery drain. We rebuilt Brave's ad blocking engine to use 75% less memory, so it stays responsive with many tabs open.
MAKE BRAVE YOUR DEFAULT BROWSER
Open Settings, scroll to Brave, choose Default Browser App. Every link you tap — from Mail, Messages or any app — opens with ad and tracker blocking already on.
WHAT'S FREE AND WHAT ISN'T
Free: the browser, ad and tracker blocking, Shred, Brave Search, Brave Leo, Brave News, Sync and night mode.
Subscriptions: 
- Brave Firewall + VPN encrypts your whole device, not just browser traffic, with a kill switch and smart proxy. 
- Brave Leo Premium unlocks more capable AI models. 
- Brave Origin: The streamlined, minimalist browser that gives you Brave's industry-leading privacy and ad-blocking, with none of the extras.
One-time purchase: Brave Origin, an ultra-minimalist build of Brave — no AI, no crypto, nothing but the web. One purchase covers all your devices.
Also inside: encrypted Sync, a self-custody Brave Wallet (off by default), night mode, voice search, password autofill, custom app icons, and bookmark import from Safari or Chrome.
OPEN SOURCE
Brave is open source, so anyone can audit what the browser does. Read what we collect at https://brave.com/privacy/
Our mission is to protect your privacy online by building a fast, private browser — while growing a fairer revenue model for creators.
Enjoying the app? Please leave us a 5 star review!
Brave.com · Support: https://brave.com/support
Terms of Use: https://brave.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://brave.com/privacy/
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account. Firewall + VPN and Leo Premium are offered monthly and annually, and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Account Settings. Free trials may be used once; any unused portion is forfeited on purchase.

bluejetty:00186573:ios.description:
Prepare for the HSK Test with Confidence!
The Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì (HSK), also known as the Chinese Proficiency Test, is China's only standardized test of Standard Chinese language proficiency for non-native speakers, including foreign students and overseas Chinese.
HSK Online Test is a free and comprehensive application designed to prepare you for the HSK exam. It offers real, interactive test simulations that closely resemble the actual HSK exam, helping you achieve your best score.
To help you prepare effectively, we offer:
• 6 demonstration tests that meet the requirements of the real exam.
• Full simulation of the HSK test experience.
• Interactive listening sections just like in the official test.
• Automatic grading of test results for instant feedback.
• In-depth answer analysis to help you compare your responses with the correct ones.
• A built-in time counter to practice under real exam conditions.
Get ready for the HSK-4 exam in real conditions:
• Vocabulary: 1200 essential words.
• Characters: 1064.
• Listening: 45 questions.
• Reading: 40 questions.
• Writing: 15 items.
Key Features:
• Full HSK test simulation to boost your preparation and confidence.
• Track your progress and improve your performance as you study.
• Available offline, so you can practice anytime, anywhere.
Found a bug? If you encounter any issues with the app or tests, please report them using the contact form in the app, and we will address them as quickly as possible.
Prepare smarter and achieve your HSK goals. Download HSK Online Test now!
Source: http://www.chinesetest.cn

bluejetty:00061882:ios.summary: Stay connected on the go with Zoho Meeting! Host or join a secure online meeting with up to 250 participants, collaborate with audio, video and screen sharing, attend live conferences, participate in polls, interact with the host and other
bluejetty:00061882:ios.description:
Stay connected on the go with Zoho Meeting! Host or join a secure online meeting with up to 250 participants, collaborate with audio, video and screen sharing, attend live conferences, participate in polls, interact with the host and other participants using chat, and raise hand to voice out your suggestions.
HOST UNLIMITED MEETINGS 
- Schedule online meetings and send email invitation to the participants. When quick decisions and ad hoc collaboration is needed, conduct instant meetings from anywhere, in a matter of seconds.
- Easily join a meeting using the invitation link, or the meeting ID. Participants do not require an account to join meetings.
COLLABORATE SEAMLESSLY
- Collaborate with your team in real-time using video, audio, and screen sharing with our fully featured video conferencing software.
- Use your front or back camera for video meetings and build consensus through face-to-face collaboration, leaving no space for confusion or ambiguity.
- View the shared screen or application and collaborate contextually with other meeting participants. Share your mobile screen during meeting.
SECURE YOUR ONLINE MEETINGS
- Keep your meetings secure using lock meeting and password protection and prevent unwanted visitors or interruptions.
- Hold organized conversations. Mute individuals or all participants to reduce noise and foster more productive discussion.
- Maintain your privacy by removing anyone who may have joined inadvertently. You can also remove participants when they're no longer part of the discussion.
SHARE FILES AND RECORD MEETINGS
- Keep your chat conversations contextual during meeting. Send messages and emojis, share images and files with everyone and reply or react to a message.
- Screen, audio and video shared by you can be recorded by the meeting host joined from the computer. The recorded video can be played online and shared with anyone.
Your invaluable feedback is instrumental in enhancing the user experience. Please share your questions/feedback at support@zohomeeting.com

bluejetty:00032319:ios.description:
Relax, Logic, and Fun – The Ultimate Wood Block Puzzle & Sudoku Game!
Are you looking for a game that is easy to learn but challenging to your brain? 
This is the perfect blend of classic wood block puzzles and Sudoku grids. 
Whether you want to relax or keep your brain active, spend your spare time with this addictive wood puzzle game.
How to Play:
* Drag and drop wood blocks into the grid.
* Fill rows, columns, or 3x3 squares (in 9*9 mode) to clear all the wood blocks.
* Trigger Combos by clearing multiple lines of blocks at once and making them all blast.
* Keep your grid clean and think ahead to arrange the blocks methodically, as the game ends when there is no space for the next block.
Key Features:
* Sudoku Mechanics: Unlike traditional block games, you can clear blocks in 3x3 grids. More strategy, more fun!
* Wood Aesthetic: Enjoy the zen vibes with realistic wood graphics and satisfying sound effects.
* Brain Training: Sharpen your spatial logic and enjoy solving a wood puzzle.
* No Time Limits: Play at your own pace. Perfect for a quick break or hours of fun.
* Offline Play: No WiFi? No problem. Play anywhere, anytime.
Why You’ll Love It: 
* Experience the satisfying feelings of the wood blast. 
* Play different modes and accomplish all the trophies to be a master of Block Puzzle Sudoku.
* Challenge the limit of your brain to beat your record.
Ready to face the Sudoku Puzzle? 
Download now and start your wood block adventure!

Seamless Swing Tracking
Effortlessly track every range session and record every swing automatically in high-definition video, with measurable performance data and AI-driven recommendations to help you dial in your swing.

Compare progress, talk through what's working, and turn solo range time into a shared pursuit of a better game.
Don't waste another second out there on the range, course, or simulator. Make this year one to remember and take your golf game to the next level with Greenside AI!

bluejetty:00087900:ios.description:
Udhar Book is a simple and reliable ledger app that helps you record, track, and manage all your business and personal credit transactions in one place. Whether you run a small shop, manage customers on credit (udhaar), or want to keep track of money you give or receive, Udhar Book makes accounting easy and organized.
With an easy-to-use interface, you can create customer accounts, record daily transactions, send payment reminders, and view detailed reports anytime. The app is also useful for individuals who want to manage personal debts, payables, and receivables efficiently.
Key Features:
- Customer Ledger Accounts: Create and manage customer and supplier khata accounts
- Transaction Recording: Add credit, debit, notes, and attachments for every entry
- Payment Reminders: Send reminders for pending payments
- Share Records: Share transaction details with customers instantly
- Reports & Statements: Generate PDF and Excel reports
- Invoicing: Create and send invoices to customers
- Inventory Management: Track stock and receive low-stock alerts
- Sales & Purchase Reports: View daily business performance
- Expense Tracking: Maintain business and personal cashbook entries
- Multi-Business Support: Manage multiple businesses in one app
- Local Data Storage: Your data stays safely stored on your device
Udhar Book is ideal for shopkeepers, small business owners, retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and anyone who wants to manage udhaar and daily accounts digitally.
Benefits:
- Better Cash Flow Control by tracking receivables and payables
- Faster Collections with timely payment reminders
- Smarter Decisions with clear financial insights
Download Udhar Book – Credit Ledger Account Book today and simplify the way you manage your business finances and personal debts.

bluejetty:00116038:ios.description:
Spring Slide - Color Sort Game, the wonderful spring-loaded sorting challenge where colors bounce and brains twist!
Prepare for a wildly satisfying puzzle experience in Spring Slide - Color Sort Game! Master the art of spring physics as you guide colorful springs into their matching holes. With intuitive drag-and-drop mechanics and mesmerizing spring movements, each level delivers a fresh challenge that will test your spatial reasoning and color-matching skills.
Spring Into Action!
Your mission is simple but addictive:
- Match & Launch: Drag springs from their ends to navigate through intricate 3D mazes.
- Color Sort: Land each spring precisely in its color-coded target hole.
- Chain Reactions: Create cascading combos when multiple springs find their homes simultaneously.
- Beat the Clock: Race against time to train your brain or take it slow in Relax Mode.

- Addictive Spring Sorting Gameplay: A revolutionary twist on classic color-matching puzzles with bouncy physics!

- Endless Puzzle Variety: Hundreds of levels with unique spring arrangements and increasing complexity!
- Relaxing Yet Challenging: Unwind with smooth spring physics while testing your timing and strategy.
- Daily Trials & Events: Fresh challenges and limited-time tournaments every day!
- Easy to Learn, Tough to Master: Simple controls for beginners, deep mechanics for puzzle pros!
If you love physics puzzles, color-matching challenges, and the hypnotic joy of watching springs in motion, then Spring Slide - Color Sort Game is a great match for you!
Join the Spring Revolution Now!
Ready to twist, bounce, and sort your way to victory? Download Spring Slide - Color Sort Game today and experience an incredibly satisfying spring-loaded puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00040261:ios.description:
Looking for a relaxing mobile game that effortlessly switches your mind off from the stress of work or studies? Whether you're waiting for a bus or just passing time, "Merge 3 - Wood Puzzle" is your go-to game!
Dive into this ultimate casual puzzle game that combines the thrill of match-3 with the joy of block elimination. It’s your ideal companion for any situation, even when you're offline!
Game Rules:
● Simply tap to place tiles into the slots that can hold up to 7 tiles at a time.
● When you collect three tiles with the same image in the slots, they will merge and clear, freeing up space for more tiles..
● Aim to empty the board!
Game Features:
● Over a thousand challenging levels to ensure you're never bored!
● Play offline anytime, anywhere; no network? No problem!
● Simple and stress-free; say goodbye to games that bog you down with daily tasks.
● Customizable themes; take charge of your gameplay and tell us if there’s a theme you’d like to see!
If you're seeking a game that is:
● Free and offline, ready whenever you are.
● Loaded with levels that will keep you entertained endlessly.
● A solo play experience without the pressure.
Or if you enjoy games like animal matching, fruit popping, Mahjong solitaire, or Sudoku, "Merge 3 - Wood Puzzle" comes highly recommended!
We hope you enjoy playing this game as much as we enjoyed making it. Should you have any comments or ideas for improvement, feel free to share them with us. We're committed to making your gaming experience better!

bluejetty:00090468:ios.summary: Moj A1 is actually Your A1. Moj A1 is the central place for quick and easy management of all your A1 services. With the new interface, it’s even easier to keep track of your usage, bills, and active services. Discover everything A1 has to o
bluejetty:00090468:ios.description:
Moj A1 is actually Your A1. Moj A1 is the central place for quick and easy management of all your A1 services. With the new interface, it’s even easier to keep track of your usage, bills, and active services. Discover everything A1 has to offer through new categories, send and activate free Internet, switch units, or manage your A1 TV. Because you choose what you want! The Moj A1 app is available to all users, regardless of which service you use (A1 prepaid, subscription, fixed-line, Homebox, etc.).
Features we know you’ll find useful:
• Pay your prepaid plans in advance for 3 or 6 months, directly from your bank account or by bank card.
• Send, receive, and activate 24 hours of free unlimited Internet.
• Discover security-related services and activate Home Assistance, SafeNet, Screen Insurance, or A1 Internet Protection for extra peace of mind.
• Change your mobile plan once a month in just a few clicks, with no additional charge.
• Get the MOZAIK PLUS package of promotional benefits, bringing together additional digital services covering security, insurance, streaming, and other content.
• Keep track of your current usage and remaining units.
• Easily view your monthly bills from the past 6 months and pay by credit or debit card at no additional charge.
• Buy a top-up using your subscription account or through the webshop, and top up your own prepaid account or any other prepaid account.
• Switch less, get more! In the Moj A1 app, exchange minutes or SMS messages for megabytes — and vice versa.
• Buy digital gaming vouchers and pay for them through your A1 bill, without using a credit card.
• Activate A1 Xplore TV and easily change your basic Mini or Maxi TV package or activate additional packages. Find content that’s just right for you and manage the number of screens you want to watch TV on.
• Choose what you want to watch with Pick&Play, which lets you select the streaming service that suits you best at a lower price.
• Activate streaming services (Netflix, SkyShowtime, YouTube Premium, …) to suit your needs and enjoy award-winning series and movies wherever and whenever you want.
• Having trouble with your fixed-line services? With the help of the Digital Technician within the Moj A1 app, you can troubleshoot issues yourself without calling Customer Service. For questions about plan activation, usage, or other services, simply ask our chatbot.
• Surprise! Whenever we get the chance, we love to surprise you with special discounts and benefits.
• Connect different services and keep track of various additional benefits through MOZAIK.
How to get started?
1. Download and install the Moj A1 app.
2. Switch to mobile data if you are connected to Wi-Fi.
3. Log in automatically using your mobile number.
4. If you are not a mobile customer, enter your username and password.
5. Go through our introductory screens and discover everything you can do within the Moj A1 app.
When you are connected to the A1 network, using the Moj A1 app does not consume your mobile data. And finally, the features available to you depend on the A1 service you use.

bluejetty:00183638:ios.description:
ScotiaMóvil® es la app bancaria de Scotiabank México que te permite gestionar tus finanzas desde tu celular de forma fácil, rápida y segura. Accede a tu banca móvil cuando lo necesites y realiza operaciones digitales desde un solo lugar.
Administra tu dinero desde donde estés:
-Maneja tus cuentas y tarjetas en un solo lugar.
-Realiza transferencias, pagos, consulta y descarga tus movimientos.
-Organiza tu dinero y controla tus finanzas desde la app.
-Crea Apartados para organizar tu dinero.
-Compra de forma más segura con tu CVV dinámico y tu Tarjeta digital.
-Revisa el detalle de tus inversiones.
Otras operaciones que también puedes realizar utilizando ScotiaMóvil son la consulta de saldos, movimientos y estados de cuenta en tiempo real, transferencias entre cuentas, pagos de servicios, pagos de tarjetas y operaciones bancarias cuando lo necesites. Puedes guardar pagos frecuentes para hacer tus operaciones más rápidas y prácticas.
Usa la app de Scotiabank para retirar efectivo sin tarjeta utilizando códigos temporales y realiza pagos o cobros con CoDi® usando códigos QR. Además, puedes recargar tiempo aire y acceder a herramientas digitales para administrar tu dinero desde tu app bancaria.
Abre tu cuenta desde la app y comienza a usar tu tarjeta digital de inmediato.
Conoce más sobre ScotiaMóvil en scotiabank.com.mx/scotiamovil

bluejetty:00183164:ios.description:
Experience the Ultimate Fishing Adventure in 2023 - Download uCaptain Now!
Embark on a fishing journey like no other, where boats, crabs, and the vast ocean await your exploration. Say goodbye to boredom and dive into the excitement today!
uCaptain: The Definitive Fishing Game for 2023
Unleash your inner angler with uCaptain - the premier fishing game of the year. Get ready for a game that offers unparalleled customization, a diverse array of marine life, thrilling challenges, and an expansive open-world environment that empowers you to navigate the ocean on your terms.
Craft Your Dream Boat
Shape your maritime destiny by designing your very own boat. With uCaptain, the power is in your hands. Customize every inch of your vessel, from equipping shrimp nets, scallop dredges, crab pots, to lobster traps and beyond. The choices are limitless!
Conquer Legendary Fish
Immerse yourself in the most realistic fishing simulator available on mobile. Tailor your fishing experience by adjusting drag settings on casting reels and selecting specific lures to target your desired catch. From largemouth bass to swordfish, uCaptain boasts a whopping 60+ fish species for you to reel in.
Venture into the Treacherous Waters
Summon your courage and gear up for the perilous Bering Sea. Navigate your course, deploy traps, and seize the ocean's most coveted crabs and fish. Triumph over challenges and claim your rich rewards in this high-stakes maritime adventure.
Unveil an Expansive Ocean
Sail across a sprawling map spanning over 250 square miles, a feat unmatched in mobile gaming. Traverse the globe's renowned fishing hubs, from the sun-soaked waters of Venice, Louisiana, to the frigid depths of Dutch Harbor, Alaska.
Your Ticket to Wealth and Adventure
uCaptain caters to fishing enthusiasts, action gamers, and imulator lovers alike. Whether you relish competition, outdoor exploration, or simply casting a line, this is the ultimate fishing experience you've been waiting for. Don't miss out on the journey of a lifetime!
The Pinnacle of Ship imulator
Engage with the world's oceans like never before in our 3D ship simulator. Immerse yourself in stunning fishing locales, from serene narrow boats to powerful steam vessels. Each ship type has been meticulously recreated to provide the most authentic ship simulator encounter.
Tailored for Fishing Aficionados
Crafted with passionate anglers in mind, uCaptain combines fishing imulator, outdoor escapades, and sports gameplay. With options for sport fishing, bass fishing, saltwater fishing, and more, this is your chance to land that big catch. Download now and embrace the epitome of fishing game realism!

bluejetty:00064925:ios.description:
Easy and secure banking on the go with the Fremont Bank mobile app.
• One Stop Shop: Anything you can do on online banking, you will be able to do on the Fremont Bank mobile app
• Get The Big Picture: With visual tools that track spending and budgeting, our Personal Finance Management widget allows you to link your accounts from other banks so you can get the full financial picture*
• Control: Search, review, set alerts and even dispute a transaction right from your transaction history
• Swift, Simple Deposits: Get your funds when you need them. Mobile check deposits submitted until 7:00 pm PT will typically be available the next day
• A Better Way to Pay: Instantly transfer from your personal accounts and pay your family and friends with ease using Zelle®*
• Stronger Safety: From facial and fingerprint login to two factor authentication, security has never been tighter and easier to manage
About Fremont Bank
Fremont Bank (www.fremontbank.com) is a leading California retail and commercial bank, mortgage lender, award winning philanthropic business and consistently ranks as a Top Bay Area Workplace. Founded in 1964, Fremont Bank is one of the oldest independent family owned and managed banks in the state. Fremont Bank focuses on personalized service for clients, with 21 branches across the Greater San Francisco Bay Area and the County of Monterey. Connect with us on social media at @FremontBank.

bluejetty:00159239:ios.summary: Take control of your financial future anytime, anywhere through the modern and intuitive design of the OneAmerica Financial app. The app provides access to financial wellness resources and allows you to complete the retirement account manag
bluejetty:00159239:ios.description:
Take control of your financial future anytime, anywhere through the modern and intuitive design of the OneAmerica Financial app. The app provides access to financial wellness resources and allows you to complete the retirement account management transactions and activities that are most important to you. Additionally, OneAmerica Financial meets you where you are by providing the app experience in English and Spanish, depending on your language preference.
Using the app, you can:
· Register and enroll
· Use biometrics to log-in
· View current account balance
· View and change contribution amount
· View and change investment allocations
· View quarterly statements
We understand that account security is top-of-mind, and we take the safety and security of your data very seriously. We invest significant resources in people, processes, and technologies to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your data. Our information security program helps ensure that your data is well managed and protected at all times.
Please note, the OneAmerica Financial app only supports retirement plan participants. If you participate in, or own, other OneAmerica Financial products, such as life insurance, employee benefits or annuities, you will not be able to access your account via the app.
For app support, contact us at support@oneamerica.com or visit www.oneamerica.com/contactus.
OneAmerica Financial® is the marketing name for the companies of OneAmerica Financial. Products issued and underwritten by American United Life Insurance Company® (AUL), a OneAmerica Financial company. Administrative and recordkeeping services provided by AUL and OneAmerica Retirement Services LLC, which are not broker/dealers or investment advisors.

bluejetty:00129990:android.name: LoveNest - Anime Character Sim
bluejetty:00129990:android.summary: There's a battle between Heaven and Hell, and their spoil of war is you! Are you ready to choose between an innocent angel, or a sinful demon? Blast everything in the Match-3 Puzzles to unlock new heavenly pick up lines, exchange pictures a
bluejetty:00129990:android.description:
There's a battle between Heaven and Hell, and their spoil of war is you! Are you ready to choose between an innocent angel, or a sinful demon? Blast everything in the Match-3 Puzzles to unlock new heavenly pick up lines, exchange pictures and uncover the mystery of celestial meetings. When it comes to LoveNest - Anime Character Sim, the only capital sin is to miss out!
Anime games aren't that easy. Before your choices, you will play unique puzzle games. The higher you score in the anime games, the more choices for your next message for your angel or demon you'll have!.
There are more than 400 levels in our anime character games, designed by hand and a lot of unique anime mechanics, don’t expect basic match-3 puzzles slapped on top of angels or demons. If you don’t adapt your games choices strategies to the anime games, you won’t unlock your true anime character games potential and uncover the secrets as you solve them.
LoveNest allows you to meet, talk and uncover secrets of a multitude of interesting characters, from a cheeky lawyer, through high-aspiring corporate to a party rocking DJ - each with their own personality and story.
Explore the app and try your chances with various angels & demons and try to win them over, but remember - not everything is as it seems at times...
LoveNest assures of one: there are definitely waifus and husbandos to claim, the only thing that stands in your way is a question of how good is your pickup game.
Got a question? Contact us at support@vividgames.com
By downloading the game you accept our End User License Agreement, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: http://support.vividgames.com/policies
Q: I’m a VN Anime veteran, how much can I expect?
A: Each route has 30 choices with several answers leading to short branches, and between 5,000 and 10,000 words overall.
Q: How many characters?
A: At the time of launch, there are 6 angels and demons in our anime character sim.
Q: And CGs?
A: Five per character, currently.
Q: How many anime puzzle games levels?
A: Over 400 (new levels constantly being released!) and each is designed by hand - no auto-generated levels.
Q: Does the app include live chat functionality?
A: No, it doesn't. All messages and stories are carefully written by story writers.

bluejetty:00159440:ios.name: Focus Habits - Daily Streaks
bluejetty:00159440:ios.summary:
Focus Habits is a free, unlimited, simple but powerful habit tracker that helps you to form positive habits with ease. Set personal goals, track your progress and make every day your best day. Achieve your personal best.
Are you looking to
bluejetty:00159440:ios.description:
Focus Habits is a free, unlimited, simple but powerful habit tracker that helps you to form positive habits with ease. Set personal goals, track your progress and make every day your best day. Achieve your personal best.
Are you looking to do regular meditation, do a daily workout, learn a new language, eat better, be more grateful, or exercise regularly? The Focus Habits app can help you train your willpower and receive the rewards of doing so.
The Focus Habits app is more than a habit tracker, it's here to help you be the best version of yourself. Creating new habits, breaking bad habits or creating a routine. Keep on track with reminders and daily routines. Achieve your personal ambition.
What can you do with the Focus Habit tracker?
*** Plan your habits with an intuitive user interface
*** Schedule habits and tasks for any time of the day
*** Set smart reminders for the days, you need them
*** Stay motivated with insights and statistics
CLEAN & FOCUSED
The minimalist and straightforward user interface will help you build new personalized habits, set goals and get in the flow of mastering new routines.
MAKE IT YOURS
You can customize your habits. Give your habit a name, choose a color, set a recurring reminder and choose the days you want to exercise the habit. The app makes it easy to create a list of practices customized for you.
STREAKS
Regular practice makes a habit stick. Create beautifully motivating streaks. Don't break the chain of habits done. Each day you stay on it, your streak will grow and create motivating chains of completed tasks.
REMINDERS
Set a smart reminder for each habit. The app will send you a notification when a habit is due. On days you want to rest notifications will stay silent.
TIMELINE
See what you have done and how you are doing. The app records your activity in a visually pleasing timeline. A simple way to see your effort and achievements.
DASHBOARD
Want to see how you did today or yesterday? Easy, just swipe through your week and see your progress.
FOCUS RINGS
Progress is shown as rings just the way you know it from the Fitness app.
ACHIEVEMENT RING
This progress ring helps you to stay on track. Try to keep it at 100%.
FILTER & SORT
Simple yet powerful sorting and filtering allows you to see your habits the way that works best for you.
GROUPS
Use categories such as Fitness, Health, Mindfulness, Work and Food so you can focus on aspects of your life.
NOTES:
Take notes for each habit and day.
BETTER THAN A TO DO MANAGER
This app is about developing the power of habit through consistent repetition, tracking, motivation using the latest in cognitive behavioural psychology.
START WITH THE 66-DAY CHALLENGE
Each habit has a 66-day challenge to encourage you to stick to your goal. The day grid will be your best tool to track, check, and reflect on your progress. You can just keep going beyond 66 days. The app does track any habit for as long as you need to.
FREE AND UNLIMITED
Tracking habits is free, with no limit on how many. Smart reminders, statistics and streaks included.
FOCUS HABIT PRO (OPTIONAL)
Want more? Pro adds iCloud sync, habits you do multiple times a day, anytime habits, custom colors and family sharing. Monthly, annual or lifetime. Everything else stays free.
USEFUL
The best way to be more productive and to achieve any goal is to develop a habit that will support your goal. Let's say your goal is to be more active. Then why not form a habit of doing a 7 Minute Workout every morning before breakfast. Once the habit sticks, it will be effortless, and you will sail toward your goal without even noticing.
All these features are free:
- Today view
- Daily reminders
- Perfect day Ring
- Streaks: Current, longest and total progress
- Statistics: to see how your habits are growing
- Reward popups
- Choose a different color for each habit
- Widgets
Standard End User License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

listings.name: Focus Habits - Daily Streaks
listings.description:
Focus Habits is a free, unlimited, simple but powerful habit tracker that helps you to form positive habits with ease. Set personal goals, track your progress and make every day your best day. Achieve your personal best.

Are you looking to do regular meditation, do a daily workout, learn a new language, eat better, be more grateful, or exercise regularly? The Focus Habits app can help you train your willpower and receive the rewards of doing so.

The Focus Habits app is more than a habit tracker, it's here to help you be the best version of yourself. Creating new habits, breaking bad habits or creating a routine. Keep on track with reminders and daily routines. Achieve your personal ambition.

What can you do with the Focus Habit tracker?

*** Plan your habits with an intuitive user interface
*** Schedule habits and tasks for any time of the day
*** Set smart reminders for the days, you need them
*** Stay motivated with insights and statistics

CLEAN & FOCUSED
The minimalist and straightforward user interface will help you build new personalized habits, set goals and get in the flow of mastering new routines.

MAKE IT YOURS
You can customize your habits. Give your habit a name, choose a color, set a recurring reminder and choose the days you want to exercise the habit. The app makes it easy to create a list of practices customized for you.

STREAKS
Regular practice makes a habit stick. Create beautifully motivating streaks. Don't break the chain of habits done. Each day you stay on it, your streak will grow and create motivating chains of completed tasks.

REMINDERS
Set a smart reminder for each habit. The app will send you a notification when a habit is due. On days you want to rest notifications will stay silent.

TIMELINE
See what you have done and how you are doing. The app records your activity in a visually pleasing timeline. A simple way to see your effort and achievements.

DASHBOARD
Want to see how you did today or yesterday? Easy, just swipe through your week and see your progress.

FOCUS RINGS
Progress is shown as rings just the way you know it from the Fitness app.

ACHIEVEMENT RING
This progress ring helps you to stay on track. Try to keep it at 100%.

FILTER & SORT
Simple yet powerful sorting and filtering allows you to see your habits the way that works best for you.

GROUPS
Use categories such as Fitness, Health, Mindfulness, Work and Food so you can focus on aspects of your life.

NOTES:
Take notes for each habit and day.

BETTER THAN A TO DO MANAGER
This app is about developing the power of habit through consistent repetition, tracking, motivation using the latest in cognitive behavioural psychology.

START WITH THE 66-DAY CHALLENGE
Each habit has a 66-day challenge to encourage you to stick to your goal. The day grid will be your best tool to track, check, and reflect on your progress. You can just keep going beyond 66 days. The app does track any habit for as long as you need to.

FREE AND UNLIMITED
Tracking habits is free, with no limit on how many. Smart reminders, statistics and streaks included.

FOCUS HABIT PRO (OPTIONAL)
Want more? Pro adds iCloud sync, habits you do multiple times a day, anytime habits, custom colors and family sharing. Monthly, annual or lifetime. Everything else stays free.

USEFUL
The best way to be more productive and to achieve any goal is to develop a habit that will support your goal. Let's say your goal is to be more active. Then why not form a habit of doing a 7 Minute Workout every morning before breakfast. Once the habit sticks, it will be effortless, and you will sail toward your goal without even noticing.

All these features are free:
- Today view
- Daily reminders
- Perfect day Ring
- Streaks: Current, longest and total progress
- Statistics: to see how your habits are growing
- Reward popups
- Choose a different color for each habit
- Widgets

bluejetty:00166706:ios.description:
Designed by learning experts and used by millions of students worldwide, StudyFetch turns your own course materials into a study plan built around how you learn. Upload your lectures, PDFs, slides, or videos and get flashcards, quizzes, notes, and a personal AI tutor in seconds.
Learning should meet you where you are, not the other way around. Every feature is built for lasting understanding so it is still there when exam day comes.
How it works:
Drop in your material and Sparky, your personal AI tutor, creates a comprehensive study plan and breaks it into the formats proven to help you remember. You are always learning in the way that works for you.
What you get:
 · Flashcards, quizzes, and detailed notes generated from anything you upload
 · Sparky, a voice-to-voice AI tutor you can talk with anytime, on any topic
 · Real-time lecture recording that transcribes and turns class into notes as you go
 · Progress tracking that shows what you have down and what needs more focus
 · Achievements and daily streaks to keep you consistent
 · Support for 20+ languages
Why students trust StudyFetch:
92% of students who use StudyFetch report improved grades. Millions of students worldwide use it to prep for exams, master course content, and build knowledge that lasts. Whether you are in high school, university, or learning on your own, StudyFetch adapts to you.
StudyFetch is backed by Owl Ventures and The College Board and built to help you actually learn, not to hand you the answer and move on.
Your future is in your hands. StudyFetch is here to help you see it.

bluejetty:00050240:android.description:
Accurate local forecast and storm radar with Weather & Radar Pro - ad free
Get everything you need to stay weather-ready with your free Weather & Radar app:
• Accurate hourly and daily weather forecast
• Innovative all-in-one weather maps 
• Rain radar, snow radar, wind radar, lightning radar 
• Android Auto compatible
• Weather alerts, rain and thunderstorm tracker
• Local air quality forecasts (AQI)
• Detailed ski reports
• Personalized notifications for your area 
• Weather widget
🌞 Weather App
Be ready for everything with Weather & Radar’s app, with accurate current conditions, forecasts and storm alerts at your exact location in the US and around the world.
☔ Weather Map
Discover our industry-leading all-in-one weather radar, helping you to track rain, snow and storms coming your way. The enhanced weather maps allow you to view real-time and future weather conditions down to city and county level. Track lightning strikes in real-time when thunderstorms approach your location.
🌦 Weather Forecast
Local, national and global rain, snow, temperature and wind maps. Get free, detailed hourly and daily forecasts, including for feels-like temperature, UV index and rain amounts. Plan ahead with the 14-day forecast trend. 
❄ Snow forecasts / Winter sports info
Access all ski and other winter sport info for major ski locations in the United States.
🚗 Android Auto Compatible
Know what to expect on the road by checking the WeatherRadar and RainfallRadar as you travel using Weather & Radar on Android Auto. See rain, snow, and thunderstorms in the immediate area and drive safe.
🌩 Weather Alerts
Using the latest weather modelling and storm tracking technology, our weather alert service will always keep you updated about dangerous severe weather, snow, ice and hurricane threats in or close to your area.
📰 Personalized notifications
Stay ahead of the weather with personalized, local notifications. Get timely updates tailored to your exact location, helping you plan your day with confidence. From sudden downpours to sunny breaks, we keep you prepared—wherever you are!
🌊 Coastal Conditions
You can rely on Weather & Radar's free app to get the latest lake and ocean temperatures as well as frequently updated beach and nearshore weather, wind, wave and tide conditions. 
⛈️ 90-Minute Trend
Our 90-minute nowcast gives you all the time-critical data you need, using a blend of local observations and high-resolution forecast models to pinpoint the movement and timing of rain or storms around your location. 
🌤️ UV-Index and Air Quality info
Find UV-Index levels and forecasts, plus AQI in your area. Weather & Radar provides localized UV and air quality information for your location.
🌞 Weather Widget
The weather widget displays the weather forecast for your current location in a compact format on the home screen of your device. Choose from 4 different widget formats and scale it according to your preference.
🌎 World Weather
Save any location and see current conditions for any number of global locations in our weather app. Global weather and radar at your fingertips! 
if you have any queries or comments, please contact us at info@weatherandradar.com

bluejetty:00046291:ios.name: ZBrush - 3D Model Maker
bluejetty:00046291:ios.summary: ZBrush for iPad. Create stunning 3D models, digital sculptures, concept art, and detailed characters with ZBrush for iPad—the award-winning, industry-leading digital sculpting app trusted by professional artists across film, AAA games, coll
bluejetty:00046291:ios.description:
ZBrush for iPad. Create stunning 3D models, digital sculptures, concept art, and detailed characters with ZBrush for iPad—the award-winning, industry-leading digital sculpting app trusted by professional artists across film, AAA games, collectibles, toy design, jewelry, illustration, and 3D design.
ZBrush for iPad brings unrivaled desktop-grade digital sculpting and 3D painting power into an intuitive, touch-first mobile environment optimized for Apple Pencil. Take complete creative freedom on the go with high-poly mesh density, proprietary digital clay brushes, procedural detailing, and seamless cross-platform interoperability.
Subscribers to Maxon One or ZBrush desktop can download the iPad app and sign in to activate full access instantly. A comprehensive free tier is also available to start sculpting immediately.
NEW FOR IPAD
• Spotlight Integration: Seamlessly load reference images directly onto the canvas, apply projection painting and texture mapping across complex mesh surfaces, and extract custom 3D geometry from 2D source imagery.
• 3D Layers: Store high-resolution sculpting details, PolyPaint color channels, and masking non-destructively. Effortlessly toggle layer visibility, blend sculpt deformations, and refine feature intensity with precise slider controls.
CORE SCULPTING & MODELING FEATURES
• 200+ Sculpting Brushes: Pressure-sensitive digital brushes engineered for Apple Pencil and Apple Pencil Pro, supporting squeeze, roll, hover, double-tap gestures, and haptic feedback.
• Sculptris Pro & Dynamic Tessellation: Add local mesh detail on the fly without manual topology management.
• DynaMesh Digital Clay: Re-topologize mesh density evenly during early concept exploration.
• ZRemesher: Industry-standard automatic retopology for clean, optimized edge flow.
• Live Boolean: Non-destructive real-time union, subtraction, and intersection modeling.
• PolyPaint: High-resolution 3D painting directly on vertex geometry without preliminary UV unwrapping.
• Advanced Detailing: VDM Brushes, Surface Noise, Retopo Brush, Subdivision Modeling, NanoMesh, and ArrayMesh.
DESKTOP INTEROPERABILITY & EXPORT
• One-Click GoZ: Seamless transfer of ZTool and ZProject files between iPad and desktop ZBrush.
• 3D Print Hub: Direct export for additive manufacturing and 3D printing workflows.
HIGH-PERFORMANCE HARDWARE OPTIMIZATION
Handles up to 90+ million polygons per mesh on M4 iPad hardware. Optimized for multi-touch gestures, custom hotkey bars, rapid undo/redo touch shortcuts, and real-world photogrammetry base mesh imports for high-end digital asset creation.
TARGET CREATIVE USE CASES
1. Game Developers: Hero character modeling, creature design, and environment asset creation.
2. Collectibles & Toy Designers: High-detail prototyping and precise 3D print preparation.
3. Film & VFX Artists: Production-grade concept sculpting and digital asset creation.
4. Industrial & Jewelry Designers: Precision organic detailing for consumer products, apparel, and hardware.
5. 2D Illustrators & Concept Artists: Fast 3D block-outs and visual design expansion.
LANGUAGE SUPPORT
English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, German, French, and Portuguese (BR).

bluejetty:00120592:ios.description:
• • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • •
10-YEAR ANNIVERSARY EDITION
AS FEATURED IN PARENTS LATINA MAGAZINE
WITH NEW MEGA MUSIC VIDEO FROM LATIN GRAMMY ARTISTS
Quickly learn basic Spanish vocabulary with exciting, colorful, and addictive game play through Spanish School Bus for Kids! The Spanish School Bus is the beloved learning tool that has been used by families and teachers for more than a decade, reaching over 1 million users worldwide. 
Inspired by Award-winning instructor Yvette Montalvo and her Montessori-based approach, this app is perfect to help young learners expand their world knowledge while strengthening their Spanish vocabulary. Complete the entire curriculum while unlocking fun-filled achievements along the way!
This product goes well beyond the instruction of basic vocabulary, and aims to inspire a passion for the beautiful Spanish language through introduction of historical figures, landmarks, and catchy songs that kids and parents alike can sing along to. Relevant to any beginning Spanish audience, with special emphasis on accelerating language learning potential in children from Pre-K to 6th grade, this app puts your child on the fast-track to becoming bilingual.
After completing the Vocab Course and Numbers Course for young learners, try the Verbs Course for middle school students and above. Give the Spanish School Bus a try, and see why Parents Latina Magazine has named the Spanish School Bus platform one of the top 5 apps to learn Spanish!!!
Note: This product is now offered as a monthly subscription product, with content updates throughout the year, cancel anytime. (existing customers maintain all existing in-app purchases)
• • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • •
APP FEATURES:
• For Beginning Learners, achieve mastery of 300 of the most commonly used nouns, verbs, and adjectives while having a blast doing it! Continue to the Numbers course to master counting in Spanish!
• For Intermediate Learners, the Verbs Course offers a special emphasis on learning verb tenses that correspond to an Intro to Spanish level course at the middle, high, or college level.
• 240+ levels including basic vocab topics such as Numbers, Colors, Animals, Food, and more; and a verb topics like AR, ER, and IR verbs in the Present and Past Tense.
• Addictive game play consisting of four modes: Learning and Memorization, Quick Choice, Matching, and Piñata Mode!
• 75+ unlockable achievements to track your progress, each including interesting and relevant Fun Facts about Spanish and Latin American culture, along with national treasures and iconic animals.  
• 12 engaging and educational Spanish music songs included in a single MEGA MUSIC VIDEO, which can be enjoyed on your iPad or iPhone, or shared via Apple TV in a classroom setting!
• Verb conjugation tool to look-up the most common verbs and how to apply them.
• Two-player mode to allow more than one user on a single app install and track progress separately.
• • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • •
ABOUT SPANISH SCHOOL BUS LLC AND INSTRUCTOR YVETTE MONTALVO:
The Spanish School Bus LLC is a family-owned children’s publishing company based in Austin, Texas. We pride ourselves on delivering meaningful and educational content for children to expand their knowledge, imagination, and passion for learning. We are committed to providing high quality products for families looking to learn together.
Spanish School Bus for Kids was developed with 20+ years of teaching insight from certified Montessori instructor Yvette Montalvo, founder of Mariposas Spanish School in Austin. Profesora Montalvo is a native of the southern US and Monterrey, Mexico.
• • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • •
Website
www.spanishschoolbus.com
Product Feedback and Support:
hello@spanishschoolbus.com
Privacy Policy: 
Protecting your private information is our priority. To read our App Privacy Policy, please go to http://www.spanishschoolbus.com/privacy

bluejetty:00015532:ios.description:
Features available to all users
• Sign in securely with Touch ID or Face ID
• Verify National Registry status for any provider by name or registry number.
• Contact the Registry using the Contact Us feature
• The National Registry store is available via the app for the first time. Now you can purchase patches, decals, challenge coins and more from inside the app. 
As a provider, easily maintain your National Registry certification and account from anywhere 
• Manage your profile, including address, phone number and email updates
• Check your Initial Application status as a candidate
• View, add and remove your agency affiliations
• Add courses, add attachments for courses and view your transcript
• Manage your education for recertification, submit your recertification application and check on the status of your recertification application. 
Add courses on the go
• Easily add courses to your Professional Transcript as you complete them. 
• Never misplace paper certificates: the National Registry Mobile app offers the ability to take a picture or upload a file of any supporting documentation to attach to a course you completed. 
Track your recertification cycle and submit your recertification application
• Easily check your expiration date and recertification application status with just a couple taps on your mobile device. 
• Manage your education for recertification, fill out, pay for and submit your recertification application all securely from your mobile device.
As a Training Officer, access your agency information and keep up to date with your providers
• View your agency’s roster and which providers are due to recertify for the upcoming season
• Sign off on provider’s skills and education
• Approve affiliation requests for your agency
• Review Medical Director actions taken against providers in your agency
• Approve Inactive to Active requests
• Add courses for your agency and assign attendees to the courses
As a Medical Director, access your agency information and keep up to date with your providers
• View your agency’s roster and which providers are due to recertify for the upcoming season
• Sign off on provider’s skills 
• Approve Inactive to Active requests
Disclosure
Some features are available for certain accounts only. 
There is no charge for the National Registry app, but message and data rates may apply. Such charges include those from your communications service provider. 
For any concerns or issues with the mobile application, please visit https://www.nremt.org/rwd/mobile.

bluejetty:00118951:ios.description:
Qaabka is diiwaangalinta
-Darawalka sido kale ayuu isu diiwan galinaya balse waxuu sugaya inta laga so aqbalayo darwalnimadiisa kadib ayuu isticmaali karaa.
Warbixin dhamestiran o ku saabsan siduu u shaqeeyo dhaweeye 
1-Macaamiilka ayaa dooran kara meesha uu rabo in la geeyo , kadib ayuu arki doona masaafada lagu tagi karo meeshas iyo lacagta lagu geynayo , kadib ayuu dooran karaa nuuca gaari u rabo inuu raaco hadii ay online yihiin kadib waxuu ku xirmi doona darawalka ugu dhaw ee dhaweeye.
2-Dalabkada waxaa arki doono darwalka kuugu dhaw ee nuuca gaari aad dalbatay , isaga ayaaana ku aqbali kara ama ku diidi kara.
3-Dalbadaha ayaa heli doono fariin ku saabsan in la diiday ama in la aqbalay.
4-Darawalka ayaa u dhaqaaqaya dhanka dalbadaha siyuu u raadiyo meesha u ku suganyahy.
5-Dalbadaha ayaa heli doono fariin ah in darwalka usoo socdo dhankiisa.
6-Dalbadaha ayaa heli doono fariin ah in darawalka soo gaaray.
7-Kadib waxaa bilaabanaya safarkii marka uu macaamiilka soo raaco gaariga.
8-Darawalka waxuu arki doona jidka u ku socdo iyo sida ugu dhaw u ka tagi karo meesha u dalbaday macaamiilka.
9-Marki la gaaro meeshi u dalbaday macaamiilka waxay heli doonan labadaba warqad ay ku qoranthay warbixin ku saabsan lacagti safarka.
10-Ugu danbeen labadaba waxay aqbali doonan warqada lacagta , sido kale mid walba kan kale ayuu qiimeen ku samen doona intii ay safarka ku wada jireen.

bluejetty:00119942:ios.description:
NOUVELLE VERSION : nouveau design + Nono débarque : ton coach de révision et d'orientation :)
RÉUSSITE ANNÉE SCOLAIRE 26-27
L'App ULTIME pour réussir ton année et tes examens (BREVET 2027, BAC 2027, PARTIELS Licence, BTS, BUT...) : Primaire, Collège, Lycée et Études Sup' !
Quiz expliqués
Fiches de révision
Exercices
Coach Nono, ton coach de révision
Espace Orientation
+ de 10 MILLIONS D'ÉLÈVES accompagnés
3 POINTS DE MOYENNE gagnés
1 APP, 400 DIPLÔMES
Lauréate FRENCH TECH 2030 - Entreprise à Mission
Contenu 100% réalisé par 300 professeurs de l'Éducation Nationale.
NOUVEAU DANS CETTE VERSION :
+ Design repensé : plus simple, plus rapide, plus agréable au quotidien
+ Coach Nono : ton coach de révision et d'orientation
Tout pour réussir ton année et ta scolarité :
+ de 20 000 mini-cours et fiches de révisions
+ de 120 000 QCM corrigés
+ Coach Nono, ton espace coaching pour gagner 3 points de moyenne (statistiques de progression, moyenne générale, objectif de révision...)
+ Toutes les matières au programme (maths, français, SVT, physique chimie, philo, histoire-géo, anglais, allemand, italien, espagnol...)
DISPONIBLE ÉGALEMENT : ACCÈS PARENTS !
Découvrez les programmes de vos enfants pour mieux les accompagner.
PROFILS INCLUS :
- PRIMAIRE : CP, CE1, CE2, CM1, CM2
- COLLÈGE : 6ème, 5ème, 4ème et 3ème (contenus de préparation au Brevet 2027 !)
- LYCÉE : Seconde Générale et Technologique, STHR, Seconde Professionnelle
Première générale, professionnelle et ses 12 spécialités, technologiques (STI2D, STL, STD2A, ST2S, STMG, STHR, STAV)
Terminales générale, professionnelle et technologique (BAC STI2D, STL, STD2A, ST2S, STMG, STHR, STAV)
- Tous les CAP (200 spécialités)
- BTS, 1ère et 2ème années (84 BTS disponibles : BTS MCO-MUC, BTS NDRC, BTS SAM, BTS CI, BTS CG, BTS GPME, BTS MHR…)
- DUT / BUT, 1ère et 2ème années (24 DUT / BUT disponibles : GACO, GEA, Informatique, Technique de Commercialisation, GEII)
- DCG, 12 UE
- 30 LICENCES : Licence Droit, Licence Psycho, Licence Éco-Gestion AES, Licence STAPS, Licence Histoire, Licence Physique-Chimie, Licence Maths, Licence LEA, Licence SVT, Licence Infocom, Licence Histoire de l'Art & Archéologie, Licence Pro, Licence Socio, Licence Informatique, Licence Sciences Sociales, Licence Sciences pour la Santé, Licence Géographie et Aménagement, Licence Sciences de l'Éducation, Licence Lettres, Licence Sciences du Langage, Licence Philo, Licence Art du Spectacle, Licence LLCER Espagnol, Licence LLCER Anglais...)
- PRÉPAS :
Prépa Ingénieurs Maths Sup Maths Spé : MPSI, MP2I, PCSI, PTSI, BCPST, TPC, MP, PC, PSI, PT, TB, TSI, ATS
Prépa Commerce : ECS, ECE, ECG et ECT
Prépa Littéraire : Hypokhâgne et Khâgne
- PASS / LAS : réussir médecine
- IFSI et concours infirmiers
- DN MADE
...
ORIENTATION
Tout pour faire les bons choix pour ton avenir :
- Test d'Orientation pour trouver les études et métiers qui te correspondent
- Découverte des écoles par thème (vidéo, engagements, témoignages d'étudiants, débouchés)
- Découverte des Métiers et des Secteurs
- Découverte des Diplômes du Supérieur et des cursus (350 diplômes du Sup disponibles dans l'app)
NOMAD+, POUR ALLER PLUS LOIN DANS LA RÉUSSITE :
Pack MENTION BREVET :
- Oral du Brevet : décryptage épreuve, conseils et module d'auto-évaluation en vidéo avec sujets tests
- Annales du Brevet corrigées
- 100 Fiches PDF imprimables "LES ESSENTIELS DU BREVET 2027"
Pack MENTION BAC :
- Grand Oral du Bac : décryptage, conseils et module d'auto-évaluation en vidéo avec sujets tests
- Annales du Bac corrigées
- Épreuves Spécialités
- Bac Philo : sujets et tests
- Bac Français : épreuves et préparation
- 150 Fiches PDF imprimables "LES ESSENTIELS DU BAC 2027"
- PARCOURSUP 2027 : fiches conseils de candidature et découverte des parcours Post Bac
Conditions d'utilisation : https://nomadeducation.fr/conditions-d-utilisation/

bluejetty:00033248:ios.description:
Help Shamaness Ina save her apprentice Jessie from dark magic.
Play the new hidden objects game, solve the mystery puzzles and brain teasers! 
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to uncover the mystery of Knight Cats: Whisper of the Universe? Immerse yourself in the puzzle adventure, solve engaging puzzles, explore unusual locations and learn all secrets of the evil dark shaman.
Having stopped for a rest, Nika Monroe's crew asks to tell a story around the fire. Nika remembers the legend about a bright shamaness named Ina and her apprentice Jessie, who was consumed by dark magic. What trials will Ina have to go through in search of her sworn daughter? How will the threads of destinies intertwine? And what mysterious enemy did the cat goddess warn Ina about?
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game. 
You can get the full version by means of an in-app purchase.
FIND OUT WHERE JESSIE DISAPPEARED.
Follow in Jessie’s footsteps, find the prophecy about her destiny and find out who is involved in the dark spells that consumed the apprentice of the light shamaness.
FIND OUT WHO CONTROLS THE DARK POWERS.
Solve engaging puzzles and complete fun mini-games to find out why all-consuming darkness has come to the world and why does the one who called it need Jessie.
SOLVE THE MYSTERY OF THE LIFE-DEFINING PROPHECY!
Complete engaging HO scenes and feel the thrill caused by the unexpected plot twists.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO NORIA IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play as Jessie’s daughter, Noria, and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! Earn a variety of unique achievements! Tons of collectibles and puzzle pieces to find! 
Knight Cats: Whisper of the Universe is a hidden object game where you have to search for hidden objects like a detective. Learn all secrets of the evil dark shaman and solve mysteries!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, soundtrack, concept art, and more!

bluejetty:00023085:ios.description:
Play Wherigo™ cartridges on your iPhone!
Wherigo™ cartridges are GPS-enabled adventures in the real world. Use GPS technology to guide you to physical locations and interact with virtual objects and characters.
Download cartridges for free from the official Wherigo™ web site right from the app and play at your leisure. 
Note that cartridges are retained for as long as you need them and do not expire. Time estimates given on the web site and in the cartridge description are for expected playing time.
1) With newer devices, you can download cartridges with your computer and drag and drop to the Wherigo app folder in iTunes.
2) You can also drag and drop .gws files to upload with your browser if you have trouble uploading from the app.
3) Be sure to select "PocketPC" as the device when downloading cartridges for best results, although any device should work.

bluejetty:00076099:ios.name: Myro:Home for Leviton/HAI
bluejetty:00076099:ios.summary:
Myro:Home puts your Leviton/HAI Omni or Lumina system in your pocket. It connects directly to your controller and works the same from your couch as it does from anywhere in the world, with Face ID/Touch ID, Siri and an Apple Watch app.
EVE
bluejetty:00076099:ios.description:
Myro:Home puts your Leviton/HAI Omni or Lumina system in your pocket. It connects directly to your controller and works the same from your couch as it does from anywhere in the world, with Face ID/Touch ID, Siri and an Apple Watch app.
EVERYTHING ONE TAP AWAY
• Status: a quick overview of each security area, thermostats, auxiliary sensors, unread messages and zones that are not ready.
• Security: zones organized by area. Arm and disarm (or set the mode on Lumina systems, or arm European EN 50131 controllers with a check before force arming), bypass and restore zones, and filter for zones that are not ready. The tab badge counts insecure or bypassed zones.
• Climate: every thermostat and auxiliary sensor with temperature and humidity. Full control of setpoints, mode, fan and hold.
• Control: all configured lighting units, plus outputs, flags and blinds.
• Buttons and Events: run your controller's buttons (macros) and review the event log.
• Audio: on panels with an audio interface, control every zone and source, including metadata.
• Messages: read and acknowledge system messages.
• Cameras: an unlimited number of MJPEG and RTSP cameras, plus static JPEG cameras refreshed automatically.
• Favorites, Recents and Rooms: add any controller object to Favorites for quick access, or jump back to recently used items. iBeacon and location triggers are also supported.
MYRO:HOME HELPER FOR MAC
Pair Myro:Home with Myro:Home Helper, available on the Mac App Store, to receive push notifications, log and graph data, run scripts, control your system from a web browser, and expose your Omni or Lumina devices as HomeKit accessories.
ALSO AVAILABLE: MYRO:HOME PRO
Myro:Home Pro is the next generation of Myro:Home. It brings HAI/Leviton automation together with Apple HomeKit in one app and can also run HomeKit-only, with no controller required. It adds CarPlay, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, App Intents for Shortcuts, Apple Watch complications, UniFi Protect camera import, HAI Hi-Fi 2 direct control and support for multiple controllers.
Which one is right for you? Myro:Home is the long-standing, full-featured app that many Omni and Lumina owners have relied on for more than a decade. Myro:Home Pro is the newer design with the latest Apple platform features and HomeKit. Both work with the same controllers and with Myro:Home Helper, and the Complete Bundle subscription covers both apps.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Trial length is 14 days, and a subscription can be paid monthly or yearly.
• Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified.
• Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off in your Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
HARDWARE REQUIREMENTS
Myro:Home supports Ethernet-enabled HAI/Leviton controllers, including Lumina, Lumina Pro, OmniPro II, Omni IIe and Omni LTe. Controller firmware 3.5 or later is required.
European controllers (Omni LTe-EU, Omni IIe-EU and OmniPro II-EU, EN 50131) are supported for arming and disarming, like Snap-Link. This support is new, so please report any issues to support@myrocontrol.com.
PRIVACY
Myro Control, LLC does not collect your home usage data, keys or connection details. They are stored only on your device in the iOS secure keychain. Myro:Home communicates directly with your controller using an encrypted protocol, and no home data is stored in the cloud.
Privacy Policy: https://myrocontrol.com/privacy_policy.asp
Terms of Use: https://myrocontrol.com/terms_of_use.asp

bluejetty:00184926:ios.name: Radio FM
bluejetty:00184926:ios.summary:
All the radio in one app: 10,000+ live FM, AM and internet radio stations from 130+ countries. Open, tap, listen — no clutter, no fuss.
Radio FM has been on air since 2013. Millions of listeners, a small team that reads every message, and
bluejetty:00184926:ios.description:
All the radio in one app: 10,000+ live FM, AM and internet radio stations from 130+ countries. Open, tap, listen — no clutter, no fuss.
Radio FM has been on air since 2013. Millions of listeners, a small team that reads every message, and a player that simply works — on the bus, in the car, in the kitchen and on a weak connection.
WHY LISTENERS STAY
• 10,000+ radio stations: music, news, talk and sports — from local FM to the biggest world broadcasters
• Starts in a second and keeps playing in the background, on the lock screen and with headset buttons
• Adaptive streaming: the player adjusts to your connection speed, so the station stays alive on slow mobile internet
• CarPlay and Apple Watch: pick a station from the car screen or right from your wrist
• Light and dark theme, and a design that picks up colors from the album art
FIND YOUR STATION
• Browse by country and region, or search by name
• Genres: pop, rock, jazz, classical, electronic, hip-hop, chillout, retro, 80s, 90s, dance, lounge and more
• Popular, New and Recommended — based on what you already listen to
• Save favorites to "My stations" and switch between them in one tap
ANY STATION FROM ANY WEBSITE
Can't find a station in the catalog? Paste a link to its website — the built-in scanner finds the audio stream and adds the station to the app. This way you can listen to literally any radio station — with Radio PLUS.
RADIO PLUS — MORE THAN A PLAYER
• Alarm clock: wake up to your favorite station instead of a ringtone
• Sleep timer: fall asleep to the radio, the app switches itself off
• Equalizer: auto mode plus 20+ presets, from Bass Booster to Spoken Word
• Track history and liked songs: see what was playing and find the song on Apple Music, Spotify or YouTube Music
• Album art, track info and a look that adapts to every song
• Relaxing video backgrounds and sound effects for focus and sleep
• No banners in the app
MADE BY REAL PEOPLE
We have been building this radio app for over 12 years. New stations appear every week, dead streams get replaced, and every support message gets an answer. Missing a station? Write to us: support@radiotoolkit.com
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Radio PLUS is available as an auto-renewable subscription (monthly or yearly) or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The price is shown in the app in your local currency before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://radiotoolkit.com/agreement
Privacy Policy: https://radiotoolkit.com/privacy

bluejetty:00084113:ios.description:
Play puzzles and brain-teasers in adventure games! In this one of the top mystery games, your goal is to find puzzle and interactive clues needed to become a hero!
No one likes to lose - it's more pleasant to be a winner. Dreyer Crowley has a tough time growing up: he loses his parents and ends up in an orphanage. As Dreyer grows older, he decides to put an end to an endless streak of bad luck and restore his family's reputation. But there's one problem: Dreyer's out of luck. Desperate, he decides to make a deal with Fortuna: infinite luck in exchange for loving hearts. Beatrice and Franz are Dreyer's next targets. Solve tricky puzzles, outwit the villain's henchmen, and save the lovebirds. Now the game is on! Gather your wits for an unforgettable detective story in this pulse-pounded new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure! 
· INVESTIGATE THE ABDUCTION OF THE GOVERNOR IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more exciting puzzles and hidden objects games after you finish the main story! More collectibles await you in these unique chapters, where you can find the difference and unlock all new branches of the detective story games!
· FIND ALL THE COLLECTIBLES TO LEARN MORE ABOUT DETECTIVE WORK!
Each location has a unique collection of various collectibles to help you in your hide & seek adventure interactive story! Are you ready to go on an exciting adventure quest and collect all the hidden pictures while playing puzzle solving games?
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, MUSIC, VIDEOS, AND CONCEPT ART!
Our interactive story games have tons of bonus content for you to enjoy! More hide and seek riddles need to be solved!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HOPS AND MINI GAMES AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Replay your favorite Domini Games to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Stuck on any adventure escape games? No problem - our built-in walkthrough will always help you to!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames
